chapters.title: Chapter 1651: Max’s Terror!
paragraphs: "I will give all of you one chance," Max said calmly as his gaze slowly swept across the six participants standing before the cave entrance, his expression remaining completely composed despite the tension in the atmosphere. "Leave this platform peacefully."
His tone was neither arrogant nor overbearing.
He did not shout those words loudly, nor did he release any killing intent while speaking.
Yet the calmness within his voice carried an invisible pressure that gradually caused the expressions of the six disciples to change subtly as the weight behind his words settled heavily upon them.
"Otherwise..." Max continued slowly while maintaining eye contact with them, "I will have no choice but to eliminate all of you."
The moment those words fell, silence instantly descended across the platform.

The six participants instinctively tightened their grips around their weapons while staring at Max with increasingly wary expressions. The confidence they carried earlier had clearly weakened, yet none of them spoke immediately as the atmosphere around the cave suddenly became incomparably heavy.
If those exact same words had come from someone else, they would have laughed mockingly without hesitation and attacked immediately.
However, the person currently standing before them was Max Morgan.
The same Max Morgan who had ranked first in the previous two trials.
The same Max Morgan whose name currently stood at Rank 3 within the Survival Trial rankings.
And inside this Survival Trial, rankings represented far more than simple fame or reputation.
They represented strength.
Real strength earned through countless eliminations and battles.
One of the participants subconsciously swallowed as his gaze flickered toward the floating ranking screen visible nearby.
[Rank 3: Max Morgan — 6,820 KP]
That number alone was enough to place enormous pressure upon every person standing there.
To accumulate such terrifying killing points in such a short amount of time, Max must have already eliminated a shocking number of participants within the tower.
And none of them believed those victories had been achieved through mere luck.
The six disciples quietly exchanged uneasy glances with one another.
On one hand, none of them wanted to abandon the cave before them.

The treasure hidden within a fifth-layer cave was undoubtedly extraordinary. Just the energy fluctuations leaking faintly from the cave entrance alone were enough to cause greed to burn within their hearts uncontrollably. The dense energy radiating from within clearly indicated that whatever treasure existed inside possessed immense value.
If they successfully obtained the treasure hidden there, their strength and future could improve tremendously.
However—
On the other hand—
None of them truly wanted to fight Max.
Not after hearing the increasingly terrifying rumors spreading throughout the Survival Trial.
Not after seeing his current ranking.
And certainly not after personally sensing the oppressive pressure radiating faintly from his body at this very moment.
One of the spear-wielding disciples frowned deeply as internal conflict appeared within his eyes.
"We’re six against one..." he muttered quietly, almost as though he was trying to convince himself more than anyone else.
"Yes..." another participant replied slowly while gripping his weapon tighter, but the confidence within his voice was noticeably lacking. "But this is still Max Morgan."
A heavy silence followed once more.
The hesitation on their faces became increasingly obvious as none of them seemed willing to make the first move.
Some participants unwillingly glanced toward the cave entrance while others continued staring at Max cautiously, their expressions revealing the fierce internal struggle occurring within their minds.
The treasure was extremely tempting.
But if they lost here—
Then everything would become meaningless.
Not only would they fail to obtain the treasure within the cave, but they would also be completely eliminated from the Survival Trial itself.
At that moment, one of the older-looking participants suddenly let out a long sigh that broke the silence.
The others immediately turned toward him.
He slowly lowered the weapon in his hand before shaking his head helplessly.
"This isn’t worth it," he said calmly.
His gaze shifted briefly toward the cave behind him before returning toward Max once more.
"A fifth-layer treasure is definitely valuable," he admitted honestly, "but it’s not valuable enough for me to risk elimination against someone like you."
A bitter laugh escaped his mouth afterward.
"If I get eliminated here, then I leave with absolutely nothing."
The participant slowly stepped backward while loosening his grip on his weapon.
"It’s better to let you have this cave than lose everything trying to fight over it."
After speaking those words, he directly turned around and left the platform without any hesitation.
The remaining participants fell silent once again.
However, his departure had clearly affected them heavily.
The hesitation within their expressions deepened further.
Soon afterward, another disciple sighed heavily.
"He’s right," she admitted unwillingly while lowering her guard slightly. "There are still other caves inside this tower."
Her expression became complicated as she looked toward Max.
"But there’s only one life in this trial."
After saying those words, she also stepped away from the platform and began retreating.
Seeing two people leave consecutively instantly weakened the resolve of the remaining participants completely.
One of the disciples clicked his tongue in frustration before lowering the sword in his hand unwillingly.
"Tch. Fine."
"I didn’t climb this far just to get eliminated fighting over a single cave."
Another participant nodded slowly in agreement.
"Fighting you now would simply be too risky."
One after another, the remaining participants gradually backed away from the cave platform while maintaining cautious gazes toward Max.
None of them looked happy about the situation.
The unwillingness within their expressions was extremely obvious.
Yet despite their frustration, none of them dared challenge Max directly.
After all, the man standing before them currently ranked third within the entire Survival Trial.
And nobody believed such a ranking could possibly be achieved without possessing terrifying strength.
Soon, all six participants had completely left the platform.
The previously tense and chaotic atmosphere instantly became silent.
Only Max remained standing calmly before the cave entrance while the heavy pressure of the tower continued descending from above like an invisible mountain.
The participants who retreated glanced back at him one final time before finally disappearing into the distance in search of other caves deeper within the tower.
Meanwhile, Max calmly watched them leave without making any move to stop them.
Then slowly—
His gaze shifted toward the cave behind him.
A faint smile gradually appeared on his face.
"Good choice," he murmured quietly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1652: Good Treasure!
paragraphs: With the six participants having completely retreated from the platform, the atmosphere surrounding the cave gradually returned to silence once more.

The violent clashes and chaotic battles occurring across the other sections of the tower could still be heard faintly in the distance as muffled explosions and occasional shockwaves echoed throughout the enormous structure, yet the platform Max now stood upon had already become completely calm.
The tension from earlier had disappeared entirely, leaving only shattered stone, scattered spiritual fluctuations, and the oppressive pressure of the ancient tower descending endlessly from above.
Max did not waste any time lingering outside.
After briefly glancing toward the direction the six participants had departed, he calmly turned around and walked toward the cave entrance behind him with steady steps.
The moment he crossed into the cave, a faint wave of spiritual energy immediately brushed across his body.
Max’s eyes narrowed slightly.

The interior of the cave was not particularly large, yet the environment within clearly differed greatly from the outside world. Dark stone walls surrounded the entire interior while ancient symbols and mysterious runic markings glowed faintly across the surfaces, illuminating the cave with a dim silver radiance that gave the place an ancient and mysterious atmosphere.
The pressure within the cave also felt noticeably denser than outside.
Even the energy floating through the air seemed purer and more concentrated, causing the surroundings to feel far more oppressive despite the cave’s relatively small size.
At the very center of the cave—
There was a chest.
Max’s gaze immediately focused upon it as he slowly walked closer.

The chest itself appeared ancient, forged from some kind of black metallic material covered entirely in strange runic carvings that faintly pulsed with spiritual light. Dense spiritual energy continuously leaked from within it, making it immediately obvious that whatever treasure was hidden inside was definitely no ordinary item.
"So this is how the rewards are stored..." Max muttered quietly while observing the chest carefully.
Without wasting any time, he directly reached forward and opened it.
The moment the lid lifted—
A burst of dazzling golden light erupted outward instantly, illuminating the entire cave.
At the same time, an astonishing wave of dense vitality energy flooded outward like a tidal wave, causing even Max’s expression to shift slightly in surprise.
Inside the chest rested a dark crimson crystal fruit roughly the size of a fist.

Golden veins spread throughout its surface like flowing rivers of molten gold while powerful fluctuations of blood energy continuously radiated from within it in rhythmic pulses. The fruit almost appeared alive, and merely staring at it caused the blood flowing through Max’s body to stir faintly.
"What strong body cultivation energy..." Max said softly while observing the fruit closely.
At that exact moment, a translucent notification suddenly appeared before his eyes.
[Discovered Treasure: Heavenly Titan Blood Fruit]
[Treasure Grade: Low Divine]
[Description: A rare body cultivation treasure capable of strengthening flesh, bones, and blood essence. Long-term consumption can significantly improve physical strength and bodily endurance.]
[The treasure has been recorded and will be awarded to Max Morgan after the trial ends.]
Max’s eyes immediately brightened after reading the notification.
A body cultivation treasure.
And clearly not an ordinary one either.

The Heavenly Titan Blood Fruit possessed astonishingly powerful effects specifically suited toward strengthening the physical body. Even for someone like Max, whose body had already reached terrifying levels due to the Black Dragon Chaotic Bloodline, Dragon Scales Transformation, and the Vein of Strength, this treasure would still provide considerable benefits.
The mere fact that such a valuable treasure existed within only a fifth-layer cave immediately made Max realize something important.
"If treasures of this level already exist on the fifth layer..."
His gaze instinctively lifted upward as though he could see directly through the cave ceiling toward the higher sections of the tower.
"Then what kind of treasures are hidden above?"
A faint excitement gradually surfaced within his eyes.
The higher layers of the tower likely contained treasures far beyond this.
Perhaps High Divine Tier resources.
Perhaps ancient inheritances left behind by terrifying experts.
Or perhaps treasures so valuable that even top geniuses within the Divine Realm would fight desperately over them.
The more Max thought about it, the more interested he became.
Then suddenly—
Another thought surfaced within his mind.
His eyes narrowed faintly as the idea formed completely.
"If I can sweep through enough of the higher caves..." Max muttered slowly to himself.
A faint crackle of seven-colored lightning unconsciously flickered around his body.
"Then I might finally gather enough resources..."
The light within his eyes sharpened immediately afterward.
"To force open the Fourth Divine Vein."
The Fourth Vein among the Seven Divine Veins.
Vein of Speed.
Even after successfully opening the Third Divine Vein, the Vein of Strength, Max had never forgotten the existence of the remaining Divine Veins hidden within his body.
The Vein of Strength alone had already amplified his physical power to such a monstrous extent that he could casually crush peak Law Refinement Realm geniuses with nothing but his bare fists.
If the Fourth Vein truly amplified speed with the same terrifying intensity—
Then the increase to his combat strength would become almost unimaginable.
Especially when combined with his seven-colored lightning.
A faint smile slowly appeared across Max’s face as anticipation gradually rose within his heart.
"It seems this tower is far more valuable than I originally expected," he murmured quietly.
Then he slowly turned around and walked back toward the cave entrance.
As he stepped outside once more, his gaze instinctively lifted toward the towering upper layers stretching endlessly above him.
At that moment, the desire to climb even higher within the tower became stronger than ever before within Max’s heart.
Max did not waste any more time remaining inside the cave after obtaining the Heavenly Titan Blood Fruit.

After taking one final glance around the dimly illuminated interior, he calmly stepped back outside onto the platform before immediately lifting his gaze toward the towering upper sections of the enormous ancient tower stretching endlessly into the sky above him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1653: Terror spreading across the 6th and 7th layer!!
paragraphs: The higher layers radiated an increasingly ancient and oppressive pressure that seemed to grow heavier the farther upward one looked. Violent battles continued erupting throughout different regions of the tower while countless participants desperately climbed higher in search of treasures, inheritances, and opportunities capable of changing their futures completely.
However, now that Max finally understood the true value hidden within these caves, his interest toward the tower had increased tremendously.
If a treasure of that level could already appear within a mere fifth-layer cave, then the rewards hidden within the higher layers would undoubtedly become even more astonishing.
Crack!
Seven-colored lightning erupted violently around Max once more.
The next instant, his figure shot upward along the towering wall of the ancient structure at astonishing speed like a streak of divine lightning piercing through the sky.
As Max climbed higher, the pressure surrounding the tower became increasingly intense.

The suppression force descending from above continuously strengthened with each passing layer, enough to make ordinary participants struggle even to move properly. Yet throughout the climb, Max’s expression remained completely calm.
The Vein of Strength continuously surged within his body, allowing him to resist the terrifying pressure far more easily than ordinary cultivators ever could.
Soon—
Max arrived at the Sixth Layer.
Compared to the lower regions, the atmosphere here had changed drastically.

The number of participants had noticeably decreased while the pressure covering the tower had become significantly heavier than before. Even the battles erupting across the sixth layer carried far greater intensity because the geniuses capable of reaching this level were clearly much stronger than ordinary disciples.
However, Max did not stop moving for even a moment.
The instant he arrived upon the sixth layer, he immediately headed toward the nearest cave platform.
Several participants were already fighting fiercely outside the cave when Max arrived.
Boom!
Sharp sword energy exploded violently through the air while two disciples exchanged attacks near the cave entrance with fierce expressions.
However, the moment Max stepped onto the platform—
The battle abruptly slowed.
One participant after another instinctively turned toward him.
Then their expressions changed instantly.
"Max Morgan..."
"He reached the sixth layer already?!"
The pressure surrounding the platform immediately became tense.
Max calmly looked toward the gathered disciples before speaking in an indifferent tone.
"Leave the platform."
His voice remained calm and steady, yet carried unquestionable certainty.
"I am taking this cave."
The participants exchanged uneasy glances with one another.

Some of them clearly felt unwillingness rising within their hearts, yet after sensing the terrifying aura radiating faintly from Max’s body while recalling the increasingly horrifying rumors surrounding him, hesitation rapidly appeared upon their faces.
Several moments later, one disciple finally let out a bitter sigh.
"This cave isn’t worth risking elimination over," he admitted unwillingly.
Soon afterward, several others slowly nodded as well before retreating from the platform without resistance.
Seeing them leave, Max simply entered the cave calmly, opened the chest hidden within, recorded the treasure with his name, and immediately departed once again without wasting time.
Then he headed toward the next cave.
And then the next.
And then another.
As Max continued climbing through the sixth layer, the same scenes began repeating themselves again and again.
Whenever he arrived upon a cave platform, the ongoing battles would immediately slow down as participants recognized him.
Sometimes—
The disciples would choose to retreat instantly.
No one wished to gamble their survival against someone currently ranked among the top participants within the entire Survival Trial.
However, not everyone was willing to surrender so easily.
At another cave platform, a group of disciples refused to retreat even after Max arrived.
A tall young man wielding twin sabers sneered coldly while stepping forward.
"Max Morgan or not, this cave already belongs to us."
Another participant standing nearby nodded grimly in agreement.
"We climbed this far with our own strength," he said coldly. "Why should we hand it over simply because you appeared?"
Max calmly looked at them for several moments before finally speaking.
"So you’ve chosen to stay."
The next instant—
Boom!!!
The Vein of Strength erupted completely.
Terrifying physical power exploded outward from Max’s body while the entire platform cracked violently beneath his feet.
The expressions of the surrounding participants changed drastically.
Before they could even react—
Max moved.
Boom!
One punch shattered directly through a disciple’s defensive technique before destroying his body into countless drifting golden particles instantly.
[+520 Killing Points]
Boom!
Another participant exploded apart before he could even properly raise his weapon.
Panic immediately spread across the platform.
"He’s too strong!"
"Run!"
However, it was already too late.
Max swept across the platform like a storm of destruction.
Every punch carried overwhelming force capable of instantly erasing peak Law Refinement Realm geniuses completely.
Within mere moments, the entire platform had already fallen silent once more.
Only drifting golden particles remained floating through the air.
Afterward, Max calmly entered the cave, claimed the treasure hidden inside, and immediately continued upward again.
And just like that—
The sixth layer gradually began falling under Max’s control.
One cave after another was looted by him.
One platform after another became empty the moment he arrived.
The rumors spreading throughout the tower also became increasingly intense.
"Max Morgan is sweeping through the sixth layer!"
"He already claimed more than ten caves!"
"Anyone who resists gets eliminated instantly!"
Many participants began retreating immediately the moment they sensed Max approaching nearby.
Others still attempted to challenge him greedily, hoping to seize his killing points and treasures for themselves.
None of them succeeded.
By the time Max completely crossed through the sixth layer, his Killing Points had already skyrocketed once more.
Yet even then—
He still did not stop.
Crack!
Seven-colored lightning exploded around his body again as he continued climbing even higher.
Soon—
He arrived at the Seventh Layer.
The pressure here became even more terrifying than before.

The tower’s suppression force felt several times heavier than the lower layers, enough to make ordinary participants struggle simply to remain standing. The number of disciples present here had decreased drastically compared to the sixth layer, yet the strength of those who remained had increased sharply.
The battles occurring here were incomparably more brutal.
Participants capable of reaching the seventh layer were no longer ordinary geniuses.
Yet even here—
Max continued sweeping through the caves relentlessly.
Whenever he arrived upon a platform, he would calmly ask the participants present to leave.
Sometimes they obeyed immediately after sensing the terrifying pressure radiating from him.
Sometimes they stubbornly chose battle instead.
And every single time someone chose to fight—
They were eliminated completely.
Gradually, the entire seventh layer descended into chaos because of Max’s existence.
Warnings rapidly spread throughout the tower among the remaining participants.
"If you see seven-colored lightning approaching, leave immediately!"
"Don’t fight Max Morgan!"
"He’s a monster!"
However, Max himself remained completely calm throughout everything.
He simply continued moving from platform to platform, cave to cave, collecting treasures while steadily climbing higher and higher within the ancient tower.
By the end—
Almost every cave across both the sixth and seventh layers had already fallen into Max’s hands.

And just when he was nearing the 8th layer, Max sensed terrifying energies from high above. He immediately sensed Jonathan, Julie, Ray and many of the top ten were fighting in the same platform through his Dimensional Sovereign Body.
"Hehe this is interesting." Max muttered as his figure flashed towards that very platform in the 8th layer.

Whenever he arrived upon a cave platform, the ongoing battles would immediately slow down as participants recognized him.
Sometimes—
The disciples would choose to retreat instantly.
No one wished to gamble their survival against someone currently ranked among the top participants within the entire Survival Trial.
However, not everyone was willing to surrender so easily.
At another cave platform, a group of disciples refused to retreat even after Max arrived.
A tall young man wielding twin sabers sneered coldly while stepping forward.
"Max Morgan or not, this cave already belongs to us."
Another participant standing nearby nodded grimly in agreement.
"We climbed this far with our own strength," he said coldly.
"Why should we hand it over simply because you appeared?"
Max calmly looked at them for several moments before finally speaking.
"So you’ve chosen to stay."
The next instant—
Boom!!!
The Vein of Strength erupted completely.
Terrifying physical power exploded outward from Max’s body while the entire platform cracked violently beneath his feet.
The expressions of the surrounding participants changed drastically.
Before they could even react—
Max moved.
Boom!
One punch shattered directly through a disciple’s defensive technique before destroying his body into countless drifting golden particles instantly.
[+520 Killing Points]
Boom!
Another participant exploded apart before he could even properly raise his weapon.
Panic immediately spread across the platform.
"He’s too strong!"
"Run!"
However, it was already too late.
Max swept across the platform like a storm of destruction.
Every punch carried overwhelming force capable of instantly erasing peak Law Refinement Realm geniuses completely.
Within mere moments, the entire platform had already fallen silent once more.
Only drifting golden particles remained floating through the air.
Afterward, Max calmly entered the cave, claimed the treasure hidden inside, and immediately continued upward again.
And just like that—
The sixth layer gradually began falling under Max’s control.
One cave after another was looted by him.
One platform after another became empty the moment he arrived.
The rumors spreading throughout the tower also became increasingly intense.
"Max Morgan is sweeping through the sixth layer!"
"He already claimed more than ten caves!"
"Anyone who resists gets eliminated instantly!"
Many participants began retreating immediately the moment they sensed Max approaching nearby.
Others still attempted to challenge him greedily, hoping to seize his killing points and treasures for themselves.
None of them succeeded.
By the time Max completely crossed through the sixth layer, his Killing Points had already skyrocketed once more.
Yet even then—
He still did not stop.
Crack!
Seven-colored lightning exploded around his body again as he continued climbing even higher.
Soon—
He arrived at the Seventh Layer.
The pressure here became even more terrifying than before.
The tower’s suppression force felt several times heavier than the lower layers, enough to make ordinary participants struggle simply to remain standing.
The number of disciples present here had decreased drastically compared to the sixth layer, yet the strength of those who remained had increased sharply.
The battles occurring here were incomparably more brutal.
Participants capable of reaching the seventh layer were no longer ordinary geniuses.
Yet even here—
Max continued sweeping through the caves relentlessly.
Whenever he arrived upon a platform, he would calmly ask the participants present to leave.
Sometimes they obeyed immediately after sensing the terrifying pressure radiating from him.
Sometimes they stubbornly chose battle instead.
And every single time someone chose to fight—
They were eliminated completely.
Gradually, the entire seventh layer descended into chaos because of Max’s existence.
Warnings rapidly spread throughout the tower among the remaining participants.
"If you see seven-colored lightning approaching, leave immediately!"
"Don’t fight Max Morgan!"
"He’s a monster!"
However, Max himself remained completely calm throughout everything.
He simply continued moving from platform to platform, cave to cave, collecting treasures while steadily climbing higher and higher within the ancient tower.
By the end—
Almost every cave across both the sixth and seventh layers had already fallen into Max’s hands.
And just when he was nearing the 8th layer, Max sensed terrifying energies from high above.
He immediately sensed Jonathan, Julie, Ray and many of the top ten were fighting in the same platform through his Dimensional Sovereign Body.
"Hehe this is interesting." Max muttered as his figure flashed towards that very platform in the 8th layer.

chapters.title: Chapter 1654: Ray’s Announcement!
paragraphs: Seven-colored lightning crackled wildly around Max’s body as he moved through the air at astonishing speed, leaving behind flashes of dazzling light while the already terrifying pressure surrounding the tower continued increasing rapidly with every layer he crossed.
Soon—
Max finally arrived near the Eighth Layer.
The atmosphere here was completely different from anything below.

The suppression force radiating from the ancient tower had reached an absurd level, so overwhelming that even the stone beneath one’s feet felt incomparably heavy. The pressure covering the surroundings resembled an invisible mountain descending endlessly from above, causing ordinary participants to struggle even to breathe properly.
Compared to the lower floors, the number of participants here had drastically decreased.
However, the remaining geniuses were all terrifying individuals capable of standing above countless others.
Every person who managed to climb this far possessed extraordinary strength.
And directly ahead—
A massive platform stretched outward from the wall of the ancient tower.
Violent battles were erupting throughout the entire area.
Boom!

Sharp sword energy and powerful spiritual techniques collided continuously as terrifying shockwaves exploded outward across the battlefield. Several peak geniuses fought fiercely against one another while desperately attempting to force everyone else away from the enormous cave located behind them.
The cave itself radiated astonishing spiritual fluctuations.
Dense waves of energy continuously leaked outward from within it, causing even the surrounding air to distort faintly.
The moment Max sensed those fluctuations, his eyes narrowed slightly.
Even he could immediately tell that the treasure hidden inside that cave was likely far beyond anything found within the lower layers.
Then—
The moment Max stepped onto the platform—
Everything changed instantly.
Several participants immediately sensed his arrival.
One after another, their expressions shifted drastically.
"That aura..."
"Seven-colored lightning?"
"Max Morgan!"
The previously chaotic battlefield slowed noticeably as countless eyes turned toward the newly arrived figure standing calmly near the edge of the platform.
Jonathan Myres was the first to react.
At that moment, he had just forced back another genius using a fierce spear strike before suddenly noticing Max’s arrival from the side of the battlefield.
Then—
A grin immediately appeared across Jonathan’s face.
"So even you made it here already?" he said while laughing lightly.
Instead of annoyance or hostility, excitement could clearly be seen within his eyes. He wanted to fight Max and there was no better playground than this where they could go all out.
Not far away, Julie also noticed Max’s arrival.
Her beautiful eyes widened slightly before a faint smile slowly appeared on her face as well.
"He is here," she said calmly while brushing away a strand of hair moved by the violent winds constantly sweeping across the battlefield.
Her gaze briefly shifted toward the cave behind them before returning toward Max once more.
Unlike the other participants present, neither Jonathan nor Julie appeared bothered by Max’s arrival in the slightest.
Instead—
They seemed genuinely excited.
After all, people capable of reaching the eighth layer already possessed absolute confidence in their own strength. To them, stronger opponents did not represent fear.
They represented challenge.
And challenge made the competition far more thrilling.
However—
Ray Willer’s reaction was completely different.
The instant his eyes landed upon Max—
A terrifying killing intent immediately flashed through them.
The atmosphere surrounding his body visibly grew colder.
Unlike Jonathan and Julie, Ray did not smile at all.
He simply stared silently toward Max while dark emotions churned deep within his gaze.
"So you finally came..." Ray muttered quietly as his cold gaze locked directly onto Max from across the chaotic battlefield.
The killing intent hidden within his voice was so intense that even several nearby participants instinctively distanced themselves from him the moment they heard those words.
The violent battle that had engulfed the platform only moments earlier gradually began slowing down as more and more people noticed the atmosphere changing rapidly.
Max calmly looked back toward Ray without the slightest trace of fear appearing on his face.
Seven-colored lightning flickered faintly around his body while his expression remained completely relaxed, as though the terrifying hostility directed toward him did not affect him in the slightest.
For a brief moment—
The two simply stared silently at one another across the battlefield.
Yet despite the silence between them, the surrounding participants could clearly feel the invisible pressure violently colliding in the air between the two monsters standing opposite each other.
The atmosphere instantly became incomparably tense.
Jonathan Myres slightly narrowed his eyes while observing the scene with visible interest.
Julie’s expression also gradually turned serious.
Even the other top geniuses present on the platform unconsciously stopped fighting temporarily as their attention shifted completely toward Max and Ray.

After all, everyone standing here already knew that hostility existed between the two. It wasn’t a secret that Ray Willer wanted to teach Max a lesson and in fact almost every of the top ten geniuses here knew this fact.
Ray Willer had announced this openly when Max ranked 1st in the first trial.
And now—
That hostility had finally surfaced openly before everyone.
Ray slowly raised his head while a faint smile gradually appeared across his face.
However, unlike Jonathan’s carefree grin, Ray’s smile carried coldness and danger that caused nearby participants to instinctively feel uneasy.
His eyes never left Max even for a single second.
Then suddenly—
Ray stepped forward.
Boom!
A violent aura erupted instantly from his body as terrifying sword intent exploded outward across the entire platform.
Several nearby participants immediately frowned after sensing the horrifying sharpness hidden within his aura.
It felt as though invisible blades had suddenly spread through the air itself.
Ray slowly swept his gaze across everyone present before speaking coldly.
"Everyone..."
His voice echoed clearly throughout the entire platform despite not being particularly loud.
"Stay where you are."
The nearby participants immediately frowned after hearing those words.
Ray continued calmly,
"This cave..."
His gaze shifted back toward Max once more.
"...I don’t want it but I do want to battle Max."
The instant those words fell, the expressions of many participants changed visibly.
Jonathan slightly raised an eyebrow.
Julie narrowed her eyes thoughtfully.
Meanwhile, Ray slowly lifted the sword in his hand before directly pointing it toward Max.
"So none of you interfere," he said coldly. "This fight is between us."
The surrounding atmosphere instantly became even heavier than before.
One participant frowned deeply while looking toward Ray.
"You want us to stop fighting simply because you said so?"
Another genius sneered coldly afterward.
"Who exactly do you think you are to order everyone around?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1655: Max’s Caution!
paragraphs: However, before the complaints could continue any further—
Boom!!!
A terrifying wave of sword intent exploded violently from Ray’s body.
The sharp pressure sweeping across the platform caused several participants’ expressions to change instantly.
Ray’s eyes turned incomparably icy cold.
"Anyone who interferes..."
His voice became chilling to the extreme.
"...will die first."
Silence immediately descended afterward.
No one doubted the seriousness hidden behind those words.
Ray Willer currently stood at Rank 2 within the Survival Trial.
And unlike ordinary participants from the lower layers, everyone standing upon the eighth layer clearly understood just how terrifying someone capable of reaching such a ranking truly was.
Jonathan suddenly burst into laughter from the side.
"Hahaha! Interesting!"
He casually rested his spear across his shoulder while looking back and forth between Max and Ray with obvious excitement.
"So you finally want to settle things openly?"
Julie also slowly stepped backward while brushing away the spiritual energy surrounding her body.
"This platform is already chaotic enough," she said calmly. "Watching the two of you fight might actually be more entertaining."
Several other top geniuses exchanged glances afterward.
Although some of them clearly appeared dissatisfied at being forced to stop competing over the cave, none of them truly wished to get caught between Max and Ray at this moment.
The killing intent radiating between the two had already become far too intense.
Soon afterward, one participant after another gradually stopped fighting before retreating toward the outer edges of the platform.
The center of the battlefield slowly became completely empty.
Only Max and Ray remained standing opposite one another.

Violent winds continuously swept across the eighth layer while both of their robes fluttered sharply in the air. Terrifying pressure spread constantly between the two as though the space around them itself had become unstable.
Ray’s sword intent grew sharper and sharper while he continued staring directly at Max.
Meanwhile, Max simply smiled faintly.
"So impatient?" Max asked calmly.
Ray’s eyes narrowed dangerously afterward.
"You should know by now," he replied coldly, "that I’ve been waiting for this moment since the trial began."
The killing intent within his voice no longer remained hidden in the slightest.
It erupted openly without restraint.
At that moment—
Everyone standing upon the platform clearly understood something.
This was no ordinary battle over a cave treasure.
This was a clash between two monsters standing at the very peak of the Survival Trial.
Max silently stared toward Ray with narrowed eyes while faint strands of seven-colored lightning flickered continuously around his body like restless dragons coiling through the air.
For some reason, Ray was giving him an unusually dangerous feeling.

It was not simply because of Ray’s strength, nor was it merely because of his terrifying ranking within the Survival Trial. Max had already faced many powerful geniuses before, including opponents whose combat ability far surpassed ordinary cultivators within the same realm. Throughout his journey, he had encountered countless monstrous talents and terrifying enemies.
Yet the feeling Ray gave him was completely different.
There was something hidden beneath the surface.
Something dangerous enough to make even Max instinctively cautious.
The memory of Ray’s earlier words gradually resurfaced within Max’s mind once more.
Hunter and prey.
Ray had openly declared from the very beginning that he intended to kill him inside the Survival Trial.
And the more Max thought about it, the more serious the situation gradually became in his mind.
Inside the Soul Sealing Painting, death was not supposed to be real.
Under normal circumstances, once a participant was defeated, their soul would simply be expelled from the painting before safely returning to their original body outside.
That was the fundamental rule governing the trial.
Yet despite knowing this clearly, Ray still spoke with absolute confidence about taking Max’s life.
"Does he truly possess some method capable of killing me inside this place?" Max wondered inwardly.
His expression gradually became more serious afterward.
Max had never underestimated the major powers of the Divine Realm.
Especially not a terrifying existence like the Sword God Palace.

That force stood at the absolute peak of sword cultivation within the entire Divine Realm. Their foundations were unimaginably deep while their methods and inheritances were so ancient and mysterious that ordinary people could never fully comprehend them.
And Ray Willer—
Clearly possessed connections with them.
That fact alone was already enough reason for Max to remain vigilant.
Even if Ray himself was not the true danger, the methods, treasures, and hidden cards connected to the Sword God Palace absolutely could be.
At that moment, Ray noticed that Max still had not attacked immediately.
A cold smile slowly appeared across his face afterward.
"What?" Ray asked mockingly. "Are you backing down already?"
His voice carried obvious ridicule and disdain.
The nearby participants immediately focused even more intensely upon the confrontation between the two monsters standing at the center of the platform.
Ray slowly lifted the sword in his hand while his gaze remained locked firmly upon Max.
"You know..." he said calmly, although the hatred hidden beneath his voice was becoming increasingly obvious with every passing second, "I have wanted to teach you a lesson for a very long time."
Sharp sword intent gradually spread outward from Ray’s body while violent spiritual energy continuously swirled around him like a gathering storm.
"I hated watching someone like you become famous overnight."
His tone became colder and colder with every word he spoke.
"You appeared out of nowhere, picked up the sword left behind by the Sword Sovereign, and suddenly the entire Divine Realm started talking about you."
The grip around Ray’s sword tightened faintly.
"And meanwhile..."
A dangerous look slowly surfaced within his eyes.
"I spent centuries fighting, cultivating, bleeding, and clawing my way upward."
His voice gradually rose as the emotions within him became increasingly unstable.
"I worked harder than countless people."
"I trained endlessly."
"I defeated genius after genius."
The sword intent erupting from his body gradually became sharper and more violent.
"But not once..."
The killing intent surrounding Ray intensified drastically.
"Not once did the world ever acknowledge me the same way they acknowledged you."
The surrounding atmosphere became increasingly tense as everyone silently listened to his words.
Even Jonathan Myres’ expression gradually turned thoughtful.
Meanwhile, Ray’s gaze toward Max grew colder and colder, almost as though years of resentment and frustration were finally exploding outward openly.
"To them, you are the rising genius of this generation."
"To them, you are the successor of the Sword Sovereign."
A sneer gradually appeared upon his face afterward.
"But to me..."
Boom!!!
His sword intent exploded violently across the entire platform.
"You are nothing more than a lucky thief who happened to take away a sword!"

Terrifying pressure erupted outward instantly as the stone beneath Ray’s feet shattered apart while sharp sword intent spread through the surroundings like invisible blades slicing across the air itself.
The nearby participants instinctively retreated even farther away after sensing the horrifying sharpness erupting from his body.
"And today..." Ray continued coldly while slowly pointing his sword directly toward Max, "I am going to expose the truth to everyone."
His eyes flashed with deadly killing intent.
"I will show the world exactly how weak you truly are."

chapters.title: Chapter 1656: Pseudo Cosmic Path
paragraphs: "Come on then," Max said with a faint smile as he slowly drew his sword from its sheath, allowing the cold metallic blade to catch the surrounding light while strands of seven-colored lightning began crackling around his body like restless currents of divine destruction.
Violent energy surged silently through the platform, but Max’s expression remained calm as he raised his sword and pointed its tip straight toward Ray without the slightest hesitation.
"Show me what you’ve got."
Ray’s lips curled into a cold sneer after hearing those words, and his gaze became filled with unconcealed contempt.
"As you wish."
The next moment, a long crimson spear appeared in his hand.

The spear was dark red, almost like flowing blood that had been forged into solid metal, while sharp scarlet runes spread across its surface like burning veins. The instant the weapon appeared, an oppressive aura swept outward from it, making the surrounding air grow heavier.
Several nearby participants immediately frowned after sensing the pressure coming from the spear.
Ray slowly circled Max while dragging the spear tip across the stone platform beneath his feet.
A piercing screech echoed through the battlefield as the sharp spearhead tore through the stone floor with frightening ease, leaving long cracks behind while sparks scattered into the air.
A mocking smile appeared on Ray’s face as he continued moving around Max like a predator calmly studying prey that had already fallen into its trap.
"You do realize something, don’t you?" Ray said calmly while keeping his eyes fixed on Max. "Among everyone currently standing on this platform, your cultivation is the weakest."
The surrounding participants fell silent as Ray’s voice echoed clearly throughout the battlefield.

"You performed well during the first and second trials because those trials tested talent, comprehension, and skill," Ray continued, slowly lifting the crimson spear in his hand. "But this is different."
A dangerous smile gradually surfaced on his face.
"This is an actual battlefield."
The atmosphere around Ray began to change, and the pressure surrounding his spear grew heavier with every passing breath.
"And on a battlefield," he said coldly, "your weakness will finally be exposed for everyone here to see."
The instant those words fell, a terrifying pressure erupted violently from Ray’s spear.
It was sharpness.
Pure sharpness.

An overwhelming concept of sharpness spread outward from the crimson spear like an invisible storm sweeping across the entire eighth layer. The pressure became so intense that even the surrounding participants instinctively stepped backward in shock.
The stone platform beneath Ray’s feet cracked apart continuously while violent energy fluctuations spread rapidly through the battlefield.
Even the enormous ancient tower itself trembled faintly.
The expressions of many participants changed instantly.
"What terrifying sharpness!"
"This pressure..."
"It is only the fifth-level concept of sharpness, so why does it feel this overwhelming?"
The atmosphere around the platform became heavier as the concept emanating from Ray’s spear intensified rapidly.
Max narrowed his eyes slightly.

He could immediately sense that something about Ray’s concept of sharpness was fundamentally different from ordinary concepts. It felt deeper, more complete, and almost as if it had already begun transforming into something far beyond the level of a mere concept.
At that exact moment, Jonathan Myres’ expression changed drastically.
His pupils contracted as he stared toward Ray in disbelief.
"This..."
A deeply shocked look appeared on his face.
"This is a Pseudo Cosmic Path!"
The moment those words were spoken, the expressions of the surrounding participants changed immediately.
Even Julie’s previously calm face finally lost composure.
"Pseudo Cosmic Path?" she repeated in visible shock before quickly turning back toward Ray.
Her beautiful eyes widened.
"No way..."
The surrounding geniuses instantly erupted into commotion.
"A Pseudo Cosmic Path?"
"How is that even possible?"
Meanwhile, Ray stood there calmly while the terrifying aura surrounding him continued becoming sharper with every passing second.

At that moment, the pressure emanating from his spear no longer resembled the aura of a mere fifth-level concept. It already carried traces of something much higher, something that was slowly approaching the level of a true Cosmic Path.
Jonathan stared at Ray solemnly before speaking in a low voice.

"A Pseudo Cosmic Path is the stage where someone has already stepped onto the road toward comprehending a true Cosmic Path," he explained, his expression extremely serious. "It means that person has already achieved significant mastery over the foundation of that path, even if they have not fully completed it yet."
Julie’s eyes trembled faintly as she listened.
In simple terms, a Pseudo Cosmic Path represented someone who had already walked halfway toward the realm of true Cosmic Path comprehension.
And that was absolutely terrifying.

One had to understand that comprehending a true Cosmic Path was something cultivators normally pursued only after reaching the Divine Lord Realm. Only after arriving at that level would cultivators begin transforming their concepts into complete Cosmic Paths in order to continue advancing further along the cultivation road.
Yet now, Ray Willer had already touched the threshold of that power while still only standing at the peak of the Law Manifestation Realm.
This level of comprehension was absurd.
It completely surpassed the standards of ordinary geniuses from third-rate forces.
"How did he even accomplish this?" Julie muttered softly while staring at Ray in deep shock.
Her gaze gradually became more serious.

She understood very clearly that even among first-rate forces, only the absolute top geniuses occasionally managed to touch the threshold of a Pseudo Cosmic Path while still within the Law Awakening Realm. That fact alone was enough to classify them as monsters among monsters.
Yet Ray, a genius originating from a third-rate force, had somehow accomplished it as well.
The more Julie thought about it, the more unbelievable the situation became.
Jonathan slowly narrowed his eyes.
"I have heard rumors before," he said solemnly. "Ray Willer has connections with the Sword God Palace."
Julie immediately turned toward him.

Jonathan continued quietly, "If I had to guess, then some elder from the Sword God Palace probably guided him personally. Otherwise, there is no possible way a genius from a third-rate force could comprehend a Pseudo Cosmic Path this early."
At that moment, the atmosphere throughout the entire eighth layer had completely changed.
The surrounding participants no longer looked at Ray with ordinary caution or wariness.
Now, they looked at him with genuine fear.

chapters.title: Chapter 1657: Crazy Max!
paragraphs: "You heard them correctly, didn’t you?" Ray said as an arrogant smile slowly spread across his face while the crimson spear within his hand radiated increasingly terrifying pressure.

The sharpness surrounding his body continuously tore through the air like countless invisible blades while the oppressive aura emanating from him became heavier with every passing second. Nearby participants instinctively retreated farther away from the battlefield as the pressure sweeping from Ray’s body grew increasingly difficult to endure.
"This..." Ray continued proudly while slightly lifting the crimson spear upward, "is a Pseudo Cosmic Path."
His eyes gleamed with absolute confidence and superiority as though he already stood far above everyone present.
"I am already only a few steps away from comprehending a true Cosmic Path."
The surrounding participants immediately felt their hearts tremble once again after hearing those words directly from Ray himself.
Even Jonathan Myres and Julie remained completely silent afterward.
After all, the significance behind a Pseudo Cosmic Path was simply too terrifying.
Ray slowly pointed the crimson spear toward Max while sneering coldly.
"So tell me..."
His voice carried obvious ridicule.
"Do you truly believe you stand a chance against someone like me?"
The pressure radiating from his body intensified once more.

The surrounding space distorted faintly while the concept of sharpness fused together with traces of the incomplete Cosmic Path, causing everyone nearby to feel overwhelming suffocating pressure descending upon them like a mountain.
Then suddenly, Ray laughed.
The reason was simple.
He had noticed the solemn expression appearing upon Max’s face.
Clearly, in Ray’s eyes, Max had finally realized the terrifying gap separating the two of them.
"How about this?" Ray said mockingly while casually spinning the crimson spear within his hand. "Follow me quietly toward some isolated corner of this tower..."
A dangerous smile gradually surfaced on his face afterward.
"And I might choose to spare you there."
His tone suddenly became colder.
"Otherwise..."
The killing intent hidden within his eyes intensified sharply.
"You’ll be eliminated here in front of everyone."
The surrounding participants remained silent while staring toward Max.
Many of them subconsciously believed Ray’s words were not merely empty arrogance.
After all, the pressure of a Pseudo Cosmic Path was genuinely overwhelming.
However, at that exact moment, Max suddenly spoke softly.
"Pseudo Cosmic Path..."
His eyes remained fixed steadily upon Ray while he appeared to sink briefly into deep thought.
Then slowly, a smile appeared on Max’s face.
"I truly didn’t expect you to walk this far along the road toward a Cosmic Path."
Ray’s sneer deepened slightly after hearing those words.
However, before he could respond, the smile upon Max’s face suddenly widened further.
Then, a trace of genuine excitement gradually surfaced within his eyes.
"I never thought I would actually get an opportunity like this," Max said honestly while tightening his grip around his sword.
The seven-colored lightning surrounding his body crackled far more intensely afterward as violent divine energy fluctuations spread faintly throughout the battlefield.
"To fight someone who has already reached the Pseudo Cosmic Path stage..."
His voice now carried unmistakable excitement.
"So stop wasting time and come fight me already."
The moment those words fell, several nearby participants became completely stunned.
Even Jonathan blinked slightly in surprise.
Julie’s beautiful eyes widened faintly while staring toward Max.
None of them had expected such a reaction from him.
Faced against someone who had already stepped halfway into the realm of Cosmic Paths, Max should have felt pressure, caution, or perhaps even fear.
Instead, he looked excited.
Genuinely excited.
And the more terrifying Ray’s comprehension appeared to be, the brighter the excitement within Max’s eyes became.
This was because Max clearly understood the true value hidden behind this battle.
Perhaps he still remained inexperienced regarding many matters within the Divine Realm.
Perhaps there were still countless hidden powers, ancient inheritances, and terrifying secrets that he did not fully understand yet.
But when it came to laws, concepts, and Cosmic Paths, Max’s understanding was absolutely not lacking.
He fully understood just how terrifying someone like Ray truly was.
A Pseudo Cosmic Path was not simply a stronger concept.
It represented someone who had already begun transforming their understanding into an entirely higher existence.
Someone who had already stepped onto the road leading toward the absolute peak of cultivation.
And precisely because Max understood this, he became even more excited.
Deep within him, Max’s own Severing Sword Concept faintly stirred.
Unlike Ray, Max had not yet reached the Pseudo Cosmic Path stage himself.

However, his mastery over the Severing Sword Concept had already advanced to an extremely high level. Although still incomplete, faint traces of the future Cosmic Path hidden within it had already begun forming silently.
Because of this, Max immediately realized the enormous opportunity standing directly before him.

If he exchanged blows against someone like Ray, if he personally experienced the pressure, structure, and transformation process of a Pseudo Cosmic Path during battle, then perhaps he could gain insight into how to push his own Severing Sword Concept even further.
Perhaps this battle itself would become the stepping stone allowing him to approach the Pseudo Cosmic Path stage in the future.
The more Max thought about it, the more excited he became.
Battles against ordinary geniuses no longer interested him much anymore.
But a battle against someone standing halfway toward a true Cosmic Path was completely different.
That was not merely a fight.
That was an opportunity.
A rare and precious opportunity capable of directly benefiting his future cultivation path.
The seven-colored lightning surrounding Max gradually intensified while the fighting spirit within his eyes rose sharply.
Meanwhile, Ray slowly frowned.
For the very first time since meeting Max, Ray genuinely felt that something was wrong with him.
No.
Not wrong.
Insane.

Any normal genius standing before a Pseudo Cosmic Path would feel pressure weighing down upon them like a mountain. They would hesitate after realizing the terrifying gap separating themselves from someone who had already stepped halfway onto the road of Cosmic Paths.
Yet Max was completely different.
Instead of fear, excitement had appeared within his eyes.
The more Ray revealed his strength, the brighter the fighting spirit radiating from Max became.
That reaction alone gradually caused the sneer on Ray’s face to disappear.
Then slowly, a cold smile returned.
"Fine," Ray said while his eyes sharpened dangerously. "Since you’re so eager to die..."
The crimson spear in his hand suddenly trembled violently.
"I’ll show you the true power of my Pseudo Cosmic Path."
Boom!!!
The moment those words fell, an overwhelming pressure erupted violently from Ray’s body once more.
The entire eighth layer shook violently.

Cracks spread rapidly across the platform beneath his feet while sharp scarlet energy exploded outward in every direction like a raging storm. Nearby participants instinctively retreated farther away as the terrifying aura surrounding Ray continued climbing higher and higher.
The crimson spear within his hand began radiating blinding red light.
At the same time, the concept of sharpness surrounding him transformed completely.
Before, it had merely felt sharp.
Now, it felt as though the very space around him could be sliced apart at any moment.

Thin distortions appeared throughout the surrounding air while countless invisible cuts spread continuously across the stone platform beneath him. Even without attacking, the pressure released from Ray alone was already tearing the battlefield apart.

chapters.title: Chapter 1658: True Power of Pseudo Cosmic Path
paragraphs: Jonathan’s expression immediately became serious.
"He’s pushing the Pseudo Cosmic Path even further now..."
Julie also narrowed her eyes while staring toward Ray.
"This pressure is already approaching the level of a true Cosmic Path."
The surrounding geniuses felt their scalps grow numb after hearing those words.
Several participants had already begun retreating farther away from the platform entirely, afraid of being caught within the aftermath of the upcoming clash.
Meanwhile, Ray slowly lowered his body.
His posture resembled a predator preparing to strike down prey in a single fatal attack.

The crimson spear rotated lightly within his hand while terrifying sharpness continuously gathered around its tip. The surrounding spiritual energy was drawn uncontrollably toward the spear, causing violent whirlwinds to form around him.
Then Ray took a single step forward.
Boom!!!
The entire platform trembled violently.
A massive crater instantly formed beneath his feet as the overwhelming pressure of the Pseudo Cosmic Path erupted outward without restraint.
The killing intent within Ray’s eyes intensified sharply while his gaze remained locked onto Max alone.
At that moment, there was only one thought within his mind.
Crush him completely.
Humiliate him completely.
Destroy the so-called genius who had stolen all the attention that should have belonged to him.
The crimson spear gradually emitted an ear-piercing hum as its pressure continued rising higher and higher.
Even the surrounding space itself seemed unable to endure the terrifying sharpness gathering around the spear any longer.
Thin black lines gradually began appearing throughout the air around Ray.
Spatial tears.
The surrounding participants immediately felt their hearts shake after seeing that sight.

One had to understand that only attacks possessing terrifying power and comprehension could damage space itself within the Divine Realm. Yet now, before Ray had even launched an attack, the pressure gathering around his spear was already beginning to tear apart the surrounding space.
Jonathan’s expression darkened further.
"He’s serious now..."
Julie remained silent while staring fixedly toward Ray.
Even she could no longer deny how terrifying Ray’s current strength had become.
Then slowly, Ray raised the crimson spear.
The spear tip pointed directly toward Max’s forehead.
A cold smile appeared on his face afterward.
"Try surviving this first," he said quietly.
The next moment, the terrifying power of the Pseudo Cosmic Path exploded completely.
The moment Ray released his attack, the entire eighth layer seemed to darken beneath the overwhelming pressure erupting from the crimson spear.
Boom!!!

A terrifying scarlet beam exploded forward as overwhelming sharpness tore violently through the battlefield. The attack moved so quickly that many participants could barely follow it with their eyes. Wherever the spear light passed, the surrounding space distorted violently while deep cuts spread across the stone platform beneath it like countless invisible blades had carved through the battlefield.
This was no longer merely the power of a concept.
This was the terrifying might of a Pseudo Cosmic Path.

Even before the attack fully arrived, Max could already feel horrifying pressure crushing toward him from every direction. The sharpness contained within the spear strike was so overwhelming that it felt capable of severing everything standing in its path.
Yet Max did not retreat.
Instead, the excitement burning within his eyes only intensified further.
"Good!" Max shouted as seven-colored lightning exploded violently around his body.
The next moment, he raised his sword directly toward the incoming spear attack.
Boom!!!
Sword and spear collided head-on.
For a brief instant, the entire battlefield froze.
Then—
Crack.
A clear breaking sound echoed across the platform.
Jonathan’s eyes widened instantly.
Julie’s expression changed sharply.
The sword in Max’s hand shattered apart.
The moment the blade touched Ray’s spear attack, countless cracks spread across its surface instantly before the entire sword exploded into countless fragments.
Boom!!!
The terrifying spear force continued pressing forward without slowing down even slightly.
The surrounding participants immediately inhaled sharply.
"It shattered his sword instantly?!"
"That’s the power of a Pseudo Cosmic Path?!"
Even Jonathan’s expression became solemn after witnessing that scene.
However, to everyone’s shock, Max did not panic.
Not even slightly.
Instead, he smiled.
"Amazing!" Max laughed excitedly as shattered sword fragments scattered around him like falling stars.
The fighting spirit burning within his eyes erupted upward crazily.
At that moment, Max finally stopped holding back completely.
Boom!!!
A terrifying aura erupted violently from his body.
The First Divine Vein, the Vein of Origin, opened completely.

An overwhelming surge of raw power exploded from deep within Max’s body as his physical strength increased explosively once again. The muscles throughout his body tightened violently while terrifying force surged through every inch of his flesh.
At the same time, the Second Divine Vein, the Vein of Vitality, opened fully as well.
Boom!!!

Terrifying vitality surged throughout Max’s body like a raging ocean. His blood roared violently while endless life force erupted from every cell within him. The pressure radiating from his physical body alone began distorting the surrounding air.
Then the Third Divine Vein, the Vein of Strength, opened completely.
Crack!!!
The seven-colored lightning surrounding Max instantly became several times more violent.
The surrounding participants only saw the space around Max distort faintly as terrifying speed fluctuations erupted outward from him like a collapsing storm.
At that moment, all three Divine Veins operated simultaneously.
The increase in power was horrifying.

The raw physical strength surging from Max’s body instantly reached an absurd level. The surrounding platform cracked violently beneath his feet while the pressure erupting from him collided directly against Ray’s Pseudo Cosmic Path.
Jonathan’s expression changed completely.
"This aura..."
Julie’s beautiful eyes widened visibly.
"How can his body withstand this much power?!"
Even Ray’s confident expression shifted slightly for the first time.
He could clearly sense the explosive increase in Max’s physical abilities.
However, his spear attack had already descended completely.
The terrifying crimson spear light pierced directly toward Max.
And this time, Max did not use a sword.
Instead, he raised his bare hands.
Boom!!!
The moment Max grabbed the incoming spear force, the entire eighth layer exploded violently.

Terrifying shockwaves spread outward in every direction as the surrounding platform shattered continuously beneath the pressure. Countless participants were forced backward while nearby tower walls cracked apart violently from the impact alone.
Jonathan immediately retreated several meters.
Julie’s expression became incomparably serious.
"This monster..."
At the center of the collision, Max stood there with both bare hands gripping the terrifying spear attack directly.
The sharpness of the Pseudo Cosmic Path continuously tore through his body while violent scarlet energy exploded around him like countless blades trying to slice him apart.
Blood immediately burst from Max’s hands.
Then—
Crack!
Crack!
Crack!
Countless crack marks suddenly spread across Max’s body.
The surrounding participants immediately stared in shock.

The cracks spread rapidly across his arms, shoulders, chest, and neck like shattered porcelain. At first glance, it looked as though Max’s entire body would collapse apart at any second beneath the overwhelming force of the Pseudo Cosmic Path.
Even Jonathan’s pupils contracted sharply.
"He blocked it with his bare hands?!"
The terrifying pressure of the Pseudo Cosmic Path continued crushing against Max violently.
Yet Max still did not retreat even a single step.
The crack marks covering his body became deeper and deeper while blood continuously leaked from them.
However, something even more shocking happened next.
The moment the destruction reached its peak—
Boom!!!
The Vein of Vitality erupted fully.
An overwhelming life force exploded throughout Max’s body instantly.
The countless crack marks covering him began healing at terrifying speed.
Shattered flesh regenerated rapidly.
Broken skin recovered instantly.
Even the blood leaking from his body disappeared almost immediately.
Within only a few breaths, Max’s body returned completely to normal.
Not a single crack remained.
Not a single injury remained.
The surrounding battlefield fell into absolute silence.
Everyone stared at Max as though they were looking at a monster wearing human skin.
Even Jonathan and Julie remained frozen momentarily after witnessing such terrifying regenerative ability.
Meanwhile, Max slowly lifted his head while still gripping the terrifying spear attack tightly with his bare hands.
A wild smile gradually spread across his face.
"This..."
His eyes burned with overwhelming excitement and battle intent.
"This is the kind of battle I wanted!"
