Thin black lines gradually began appearing throughout the air around Ray.
Spatial tears.
The surrounding participants immediately felt their hearts shake after seeing that sight.
One had to understand that only attacks possessing terrifying power and comprehension could damage space itself within the Divine Realm.
Yet now, before Ray had even launched an attack, the pressure gathering around his spear was already beginning to tear apart the surrounding space.
Jonathan’s expression darkened further.
"He’s serious now..."
Julie remained silent while staring fixedly toward Ray.
Even she could no longer deny how terrifying Ray’s current strength had become.
Then slowly, Ray raised the crimson spear.
The spear tip pointed directly toward Max’s forehead.
A cold smile appeared on his face afterward.
"Try surviving this first," he said quietly.
The next moment, the terrifying power of the Pseudo Cosmic Path exploded completely.
The moment Ray released his attack, the entire eighth layer seemed to darken beneath the overwhelming pressure erupting from the crimson spear.
Boom!!!
A terrifying scarlet beam exploded forward as overwhelming sharpness tore violently through the battlefield.
The attack moved so quickly that many participants could barely follow it with their eyes.

Wherever the spear light passed, the surrounding space distorted violently while deep cuts spread across the stone platform beneath it like countless invisible blades had carved through the battlefield.
This was no longer merely the power of a concept.
This was the terrifying might of a Pseudo Cosmic Path.
Even before the attack fully arrived, Max could already feel horrifying pressure crushing toward him from every direction.
The sharpness contained within the spear strike was so overwhelming that it felt capable of severing everything standing in its path.
Yet Max did not retreat.
Instead, the excitement burning within his eyes only intensified further.
"Good!" Max shouted as seven-colored lightning exploded violently around his body.
The next moment, he raised his sword directly toward the incoming spear attack.
Boom!!!
Sword and spear collided head-on.
For a brief instant, the entire battlefield froze.
Then—
Crack.
A clear breaking sound echoed across the platform.
Jonathan’s eyes widened instantly.
Julie’s expression changed sharply.
The sword in Max’s hand shattered apart.
The moment the blade touched Ray’s spear attack, countless cracks spread across its surface instantly before the entire sword exploded into countless fragments.
Boom!!!
The terrifying spear force continued pressing forward without slowing down even slightly.
The surrounding participants immediately inhaled sharply.
"It shattered his sword instantly?!"
"That’s the power of a Pseudo Cosmic Path?!"
Even Jonathan’s expression became solemn after witnessing that scene.
However, to everyone’s shock, Max did not panic.
Not even slightly.
Instead, he smiled.
"Amazing!" Max laughed excitedly as shattered sword fragments scattered around him like falling stars.
The fighting spirit burning within his eyes erupted upward crazily.
At that moment, Max finally stopped holding back completely.
Boom!!!
A terrifying aura erupted violently from his body.
The First Divine Vein, the Vein of Origin, opened completely.
An overwhelming surge of raw power exploded from deep within Max’s body as his physical strength increased explosively once again.
The muscles throughout his body tightened violently while terrifying force surged through every inch of his flesh.
At the same time, the Second Divine Vein, the Vein of Vitality, opened fully as well.
Boom!!!
Terrifying vitality surged throughout Max’s body like a raging ocean.
His blood roared violently while endless life force erupted from every cell within him.
The pressure radiating from his physical body alone began distorting the surrounding air.
Then the Third Divine Vein, the Vein of Strength, opened completely.
Crack!!!
The seven-colored lightning surrounding Max instantly became several times more violent.
The surrounding participants only saw the space around Max distort faintly as terrifying speed fluctuations erupted outward from him like a collapsing storm.
At that moment, all three Divine Veins operated simultaneously.
The increase in power was horrifying.
The raw physical strength surging from Max’s body instantly reached an absurd level.
The surrounding platform cracked violently beneath his feet while the pressure erupting from him collided directly against Ray’s Pseudo Cosmic Path.
Jonathan’s expression changed completely.
"This aura..."
Julie’s beautiful eyes widened visibly.
"How can his body withstand this much power?!"
Even Ray’s confident expression shifted slightly for the first time.
He could clearly sense the explosive increase in Max’s physical abilities.
However, his spear attack had already descended completely.
The terrifying crimson spear light pierced directly toward Max.
And this time, Max did not use a sword.
Instead, he raised his bare hands.
Boom!!!
The moment Max grabbed the incoming spear force, the entire eighth layer exploded violently.
Terrifying shockwaves spread outward in every direction as the surrounding platform shattered continuously beneath the pressure.
Countless participants were forced backward while nearby tower walls cracked apart violently from the impact alone.
Jonathan immediately retreated several meters.
Julie’s expression became incomparably serious.
"This monster..."
At the center of the collision, Max stood there with both bare hands gripping the terrifying spear attack directly.
The sharpness of the Pseudo Cosmic Path continuously tore through his body while violent scarlet energy exploded around him like countless blades trying to slice him apart.
Blood immediately burst from Max’s hands.
Then—
Crack!
Crack!
Crack!
Countless crack marks suddenly spread across Max’s body.
The surrounding participants immediately stared in shock.
The cracks spread rapidly across his arms, shoulders, chest, and neck like shattered porcelain.
At first glance, it looked as though Max’s entire body would collapse apart at any second beneath the overwhelming force of the Pseudo Cosmic Path.
Even Jonathan’s pupils contracted sharply.
"He blocked it with his bare hands?!"
The terrifying pressure of the Pseudo Cosmic Path continued crushing against Max violently.
Yet Max still did not retreat even a single step.
The crack marks covering his body became deeper and deeper while blood continuously leaked from them.
However, something even more shocking happened next.
The moment the destruction reached its peak—
Boom!!!
The Vein of Vitality erupted fully.
An overwhelming life force exploded throughout Max’s body instantly.
The countless crack marks covering him began healing at terrifying speed.
Shattered flesh regenerated rapidly.
Broken skin recovered instantly.
Even the blood leaking from his body disappeared almost immediately.
Within only a few breaths, Max’s body returned completely to normal.
Not a single crack remained.
Not a single injury remained.
The surrounding battlefield fell into absolute silence.
Everyone stared at Max as though they were looking at a monster wearing human skin.
Even Jonathan and Julie remained frozen momentarily after witnessing such terrifying regenerative ability.
Meanwhile, Max slowly lifted his head while still gripping the terrifying spear attack tightly with his bare hands.
A wild smile gradually spread across his face.
"This..."
His eyes burned with overwhelming excitement and battle intent.
"This is the kind of battle I wanted!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1659: A Fierce Battle!
paragraphs: "How can your body possibly be this strong?!" Ray’s voice exploded across the battlefield as he staggered backward slightly, his crimson spear trembling faintly within his grasp.

The disbelief on his face was impossible to hide anymore. Ever since the battle had begun, he had maintained absolute confidence in himself, especially after revealing the terrifying power of his Pseudo Cosmic Path.
He had expected fear. He had expected hesitation. He had expected the surrounding geniuses to look at him with awe and despair.
And they did.

Every participant standing on the eighth layer had already realized how monstrous Ray’s comprehension truly was. Even Jonathan and Julie, two individuals acknowledged as monsters among monsters, had turned serious the moment Ray revealed traces of the Pseudo Cosmic Path.
Yet the person standing directly before him now had completely shattered all of Ray’s expectations.
Max had not retreated.
He had not used some profound defensive treasure.
He had not relied on any mysterious heaven defying shield or ancient protective art.
Instead, he had blocked the terrifying spear strike of a Pseudo Cosmic Path with nothing except his own flesh and blood.
The sight alone felt absurd beyond reason.

Ray could still clearly remember the moment his spear collided against Max’s body. He had felt the terrifying resistance behind those bare hands. It was as though his spear had not struck flesh at all but had instead smashed against an indestructible divine mountain.
What horrified him even more was what happened afterward.
The injuries.
The torn flesh.
The shattered skin.
All of it had regenerated instantly before everyone’s eyes.
That was what truly shook Ray to his core.

The surrounding participants were equally speechless. Many of them were still staring blankly at Max as though they could no longer understand what kind of existence he truly was. The expressions of the geniuses nearby had long since changed from shock to genuine fear.

Meanwhile, Max slowly loosened his grip on the crimson spear before calmly taking a step backward. Fresh blood still dripped from his fingers, yet his expression remained completely relaxed. In fact, the excitement within his eyes only seemed to grow stronger.
"That attack..." Max said honestly while slowly flexing his slightly bloodstained fingers, "might be the strongest strike I have ever received from someone of my generation."
His voice carried no mockery.
No arrogance.
Only genuine excitement.
Then his gaze locked directly onto Ray once more.
The smile on his face widened further as seven colored lightning exploded violently around his body, illuminating the entire battlefield with dazzling brilliance.
"So come on..." Max said while lightning crackled around him like divine punishment descending from the heavens. "Show me more of this so called Pseudo Cosmic Path, Ray Willer."
The moment those words entered Ray’s ears, the entire battlefield seemed to freeze briefly.
Ray’s expression stiffened.
Then slowly, his face darkened completely.
Humiliation surged through him like burning poison.
A deep and unbearable humiliation.

He had revealed the terrifying power of the Pseudo Cosmic Path before countless geniuses. He had shaken the entire eighth layer with his overwhelming comprehension. Everyone present understood how terrifying his future potential truly was.
Yet Max was not looking at him with fear.
Instead, Max was looking at him with excitement.
That was what Ray could not accept.
The way Max spoke.
The anticipation burning within his eyes.
It felt as though Max was not fighting for survival at all.
Instead, it felt as though Max was simply enjoying the opportunity to experience the power of the Pseudo Cosmic Path firsthand.
As though Ray himself had become nothing more than a tool for Max’s growth.
That realization instantly ignited the rage buried deep within Ray’s heart.

"You..." Ray growled as his fingers tightened violently around the crimson spear. Veins bulged across his arm while terrifying spear energy exploded outward uncontrollably. "You’ll regret saying those words."
Boom!!!
A far more terrifying pressure erupted from Ray’s body.

The sharpness surrounding him instantly intensified to an astonishing degree as scarlet spear energy swept violently across the entire battlefield. The surrounding participants immediately retreated farther away, their expressions changing drastically as the atmosphere became incomparably dangerous.
"You want to see more of my Pseudo Cosmic Path?" Ray’s bloodshot eyes burned with fury.
"Fine..."
The crimson spear suddenly emitted a piercing shrill cry that echoed across the eighth layer.
"I’ll show you enough to make you despair!"
Boom!!!
Ray vanished instantly.

The next moment, a terrifying scarlet spear light descended directly toward Max from above like heavenly judgment itself. The speed was so overwhelming that many ordinary participants could not even follow the attack with their eyes.
"Crimson Heaven Piercer!"
Boom!!!

The spear strike tore through the air like a falling scarlet meteor while terrifying sharpness exploded outward from every direction simultaneously. The surrounding space distorted violently under the pressure alone.
However, Max did not retreat.
He did not dodge.
Instead, he simply raised his bare hand once more.
Boom!!!
His palm collided directly against the descending spear attack.

The violent impact caused the entire platform to tremble violently while terrifying shockwaves exploded outward in every direction. Deep cracks spread across the battlefield beneath Max’s feet as blood immediately burst from his palm.
Yet despite the horrifying force behind the attack—
He blocked it.
Using nothing but the power of the three Divine Veins.
Ray’s expression twisted violently.
Without giving Max even a single moment to breathe, he attacked again.
Boom!!!
The crimson spear swept horizontally across the battlefield while scarlet light sliced through the surrounding space like a divine blade.
"Blood Severing Sky!"
Max calmly crossed both arms before his chest.
Boom!!!
The spear strike slammed into him violently.
Crack marks instantly spread across Max’s arms while blood exploded outward from the impact. The sheer force behind the attack pushed him backward across the platform.
Yet immediately afterward—
The Vein of Vitality erupted.
The crack marks healed instantly.
Fresh flesh regenerated before everyone’s eyes.
The surrounding participants stared numbly at the unbelievable sight.
"He blocked it again..."
"He’s using his body like a weapon..."
Ray’s eyes grew increasingly furious.
Then he attacked again.
And again.
And again.
Boom!!!
Boom!!!
Boom!!!

Terrifying spear attacks continuously exploded across the eighth layer one after another. Every strike carried overwhelming sharpness fused together with the terrifying pressure of the Pseudo Cosmic Path itself. The surrounding tower walls began cracking apart while violent shockwaves swept across the battlefield endlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1660: Comprehending...
paragraphs: Ray’s furious roars echoed throughout the platform alongside the names of his techniques.
"Scarlet Soul Splitter!"
"Heaven Slaughtering Spear!"
"Crimson Void Collapse!"
Each attack was stronger than the previous one.
Each strike possessed enough power to instantly annihilate ordinary peak Law Manifestation Realm geniuses.
Yet Max blocked every single attack.
Sometimes he used his bare fists to smash apart the spear light directly.
Sometimes he crossed his arms to endure the attacks head on.
Sometimes he simply relied entirely on the terrifying durability of his body and allowed the spear strikes to collide against him directly.
The three Divine Veins operated at full capacity continuously.
The Vein of Origin amplified his raw physical strength to monstrous levels.
The Vein of Strength pushed his raw strength beyond ordinary comprehension.
And the Vein of Vitality regenerated his damaged body endlessly.
Again and again, Ray’s spear attacks tore apart Max’s flesh.
Again and again, cracks spread across his body like shattered porcelain.
Yet every single time—
His body healed instantly afterward.
The scene gradually became more horrifying with every exchange.
Jonathan’s expression had already turned extremely solemn as he watched the battle unfold.

"He’s adapting..." Jonathan muttered quietly, unable to hide the seriousness in his voice anymore. He could feel that Max was adapting to more and more of Pseudo Cosmic Path of Ray and was getting less and less injured as the battle went on.
Julie’s beautiful eyes trembled faintly as she stared at Max.
"No..." she whispered softly.
Her gaze remained locked firmly onto him.
"He’s enjoying it."
That was the truly terrifying part.
The more Ray attacked, the brighter the excitement within Max’s eyes became.
At this moment, Max no longer resembled someone struggling desperately within a fierce battle.
Instead, he looked like a madman enthusiastically welcoming stronger and stronger attacks with his own body alone.
Meanwhile, Ray’s fury continued growing uncontrollably.
No matter how many attacks he unleashed...
No matter how terrifying his spear strikes became...
Max simply refused to fall.
"Hahaha! More!" Max’s loud laughter echoed across the shattered battlefield as he charged directly toward Ray once again without the slightest hint of fear upon his face.
The seven colored lightning surrounding his body exploded wildly while terrifying physical force radiated from every movement he made.
At this point, Max no longer looked like an ordinary cultivator at all. Instead, he resembled an ancient beast that had finally found an opponent capable of enduring his madness.
The surrounding participants could only stare at the battlefield with completely numb expressions.
None of them even knew how to react anymore.
What was unfolding before their eyes had already surpassed the level of a normal clash between geniuses. The eighth layer of the tower had long since become a scene of destruction.
Massive cracks spread endlessly across the platform while shattered debris floated throughout the air under the influence of the terrifying shockwaves erupting from every collision.
Boom!!!
Ray’s crimson spear descended once more like divine punishment itself, carrying overwhelming sharpness capable of splitting apart heaven and earth.
Yet Max directly met it head on with his bare fist.
The collision instantly caused the surrounding space to distort violently. The air exploded outward while enormous cracks spread beneath both of them across the already devastated platform.
Neither side retreated.
Instead, the battle only became fiercer.
Ray’s expression had already twisted from rage and disbelief as he continuously unleashed one terrifying spear technique after another.

The pressure radiating from his Pseudo Cosmic Path became increasingly violent with every attack he launched. Scarlet spear energy swept across the battlefield endlessly, tearing apart everything nearby.
Meanwhile, Max fought him directly without the slightest intention of avoiding the attacks.
He simply charged forward again and again using nothing except the monstrous physical strength granted by the three Divine Veins and his terrifying body.
Again and again, Ray’s sharpness tore apart Max’s flesh.
Again and again, blood exploded from Max’s body as horrifying wounds spread across him.
Yet every single time—
His flesh regenerated instantly afterward.
The Vein of Vitality continuously surged with endless life force, restoring his damaged body at a terrifying speed that left everyone speechless.
The more the battle continued, the brighter the excitement within Max’s eyes became.
However, beneath that excitement—
Something else had quietly begun changing.
As Max continuously clashed directly against Ray’s spear attacks, he gradually began sensing something hidden deeper within the structure of the Pseudo Cosmic Path itself.
At first, all he could feel was overwhelming sharpness.
An absolute sharpness capable of severing everything in existence.
But now—
The more attacks he exchanged with Ray, the clearer the structure behind the Pseudo Cosmic Path gradually became.
The sharpness surrounding Ray’s spear was not chaotic.
It was ordered.
Every movement.
Every fluctuation.
Every strand of spear energy.
All of it was connected together by a deeper foundation.
A strange and mysterious connection linked every attack into something far greater than an ordinary concept.
Max’s eyes gradually sharpened.
"So this is how it works..." he muttered inwardly.
Deep within him, the Severing Sword Concept trembled faintly but it was his emotion severing cosmic path that was violently reacting as if threatening to take over him.

As Max continued experiencing the Pseudo Cosmic Path firsthand, his own understanding began evolving rapidly. Every spear strike from Ray felt like a lesson. Every collision revealed another layer hidden behind the so called Pseudo Cosmic Path.
Gradually, Max began realizing something terrifying.
A true Cosmic Path was not simply a stronger concept.
It was the complete integration of one’s comprehension, intent, laws, and existence into a single unified whole.
And the Pseudo Cosmic Path—
Was the halfway point toward that transformation.

At that moment, countless insights flashed rapidly through Max’s mind like streaks of lightning. His Severing Sword Concept began evolving subtly while his terrifying comprehension accelerated at an astonishing speed.
Even Jonathan eventually noticed the strange changes occurring around Max.
"Wait..." Jonathan muttered suddenly, his expression shifting into visible shock.
Julie immediately turned toward him.
Jonathan’s eyes remained locked firmly onto Max as disbelief slowly appeared within them.
"He’s comprehending Ray’s Pseudo Cosmic Path during the battle."
Julie’s expression changed completely afterward.
"What?!"
The surrounding geniuses immediately stared toward Max in disbelief after hearing Jonathan’s words.
Comprehending a Pseudo Cosmic Path during battle?
That was complete madness.
Meanwhile, Max himself had become increasingly immersed in the battle.
The surrounding world gradually faded from his awareness.
The shattered battlefield.
The surrounding geniuses.
The collapsing eighth layer.
None of it mattered anymore.
Only Ray’s spear remained within his vision.
Only the structure hidden behind the Pseudo Cosmic Path remained within his mind.
He was beginning to understand it.
Beginning to glimpse the road beyond ordinary concepts.
His comprehension surged wildly as his Emotion Severing Cosmic Path continuously evolved deeper and deeper.
And just as Max’s rapidly advancing understanding seemed on the verge of producing a true breakthrough—

None of it mattered anymore.
Only Ray’s spear remained within his vision.
Only the structure hidden behind the Pseudo Cosmic Path remained within his mind.
He was beginning to understand it.
Beginning to glimpse the road beyond ordinary concepts.
His comprehension surged wildly as his Emotion Severing Cosmic Path continuously evolved deeper and deeper.
And just as Max’s rapidly advancing understanding seemed on the verge of producing a true breakthrough—

chapters.title: Chapter 1661: Ray’s Breakdown!
paragraphs: Ray finally lost control completely.
"Enough!!!"
Boom!!!
An incomparably terrifying aura erupted violently from Ray’s body.
The surrounding participants immediately felt their expressions change drastically as overwhelming pressure swept across the entire eighth layer.
The crimson spear within Ray’s hand emitted blinding scarlet light while violent sharpness spread uncontrollably through the surrounding space.
Ray’s face had completely darkened by now.
He could feel it clearly.
Max was using him.
Using his Pseudo Cosmic Path as a stepping stone for his own comprehension.
That realization completely shattered the final traces of calmness remaining within Ray’s heart.
"You think you can use me to improve yourself?!" Ray roared furiously as terrifying killing intent exploded from his body like a storm.
His voice shook the battlefield violently.
"I’ll kill you before that ever happens!"
Boom!!!
The entire tower trembled violently.

Terrifying crimson energy gathered endlessly around Ray while the sharpness surrounding him became increasingly unstable and destructive. The surrounding participants immediately retreated farther away with pale expressions as they sensed the horrifying power gathering around him.
Jonathan’s expression changed sharply.
"He’s using his ultimate attack!"
Julie’s face immediately became solemn.
The pressure radiating from Ray had already reached a terrifying level where even the surrounding space itself began collapsing faintly beneath it.
Then—
Ray slowly raised his spear toward the sky.
At that moment, countless scarlet cracks spread throughout the surrounding air as though the world itself was being severed apart by invisible blades.
An enormous crimson phantom gradually appeared behind Ray.
It resembled a gigantic heavenly spear capable of piercing through heaven and earth themselves.
"World Ending Crimson Heaven Spear!"
Boom!!!
The instant Ray unleashed the attack, the entire eighth layer seemed to collapse.

A world destroying scarlet beam descended directly toward Max while horrifying sharpness tore apart everything along its path. The platform shattered continuously while even the surrounding tower walls cracked violently beneath the terrifying pressure.
This attack far surpassed every previous strike Ray had unleashed.
This was his true ultimate attack.
A terrifying strike empowered fully by the power of his Pseudo Cosmic Path.
Even Jonathan’s expression changed drastically.
"If that attack lands directly..." Jonathan muttered, unable to finish his sentence.
Julie’s eyes trembled faintly.
"He’ll really die..."
Meanwhile—
At the very center of the destruction—
Max slowly raised his head.
For the very first time since the battle began, the excitement within his eyes gradually disappeared.
In its place—
A terrifying calmness emerged.
Then slowly—
Boom!!!
An overwhelming draconic aura suddenly erupted violently from Max’s body.
The surrounding participants immediately felt their bloodlines tremble instinctively beneath the terrifying pressure.
Max’s five thousand Draconic Essences exploded fully.
A faint dragon roar echoed throughout the eighth layer while monstrous physical power flooded every part of his body instantly.
The muscles across Max’s body expanded slightly while faint black dragon scales appeared beneath his skin. The surrounding air distorted violently from the sheer force radiating outward from him.
Then—
Max slowly clenched his fist.
Boom!!!
The three Divine Veins erupted simultaneously.
The Vein of Origin amplified his raw physical power explosively.
The Vein of Strength increased his strength beyond ordinary limits.
The Vein of Vitality caused endless life force to surge through him like an eternal river.
Combined together with the monstrous strength of five thousand Draconic Essences—
Max’s physical power reached an utterly horrifying level.
Then—
He punched forward.
No concepts.
No techniques.
No laws.
Only absolute strength.
The instant Max’s fist collided directly against the descending world destroying spear attack—
The world itself seemed to explode.
A terrifying shockwave swept violently throughout the entire eighth layer while countless cracks tore across the surrounding space itself.
Then—
To everyone’s horror—
Ray’s ultimate attack shattered apart completely.
The enormous scarlet spear beam exploded into countless fragments before collapsing entirely beneath the overwhelming power of Max’s fist.
Jonathan’s pupils contracted violently.
Julie froze completely.
Every surrounding participant stared at the scene in absolute disbelief.
Meanwhile—
At the center of the destruction—
Max slowly lowered his fist while overwhelming dragon aura still swirled violently around his body.
Then a faint smile gradually appeared upon his face.
"So this..." Max muttered quietly while looking directly toward Ray, "is the full power of your Pseudo Cosmic Path?"

Ray, on the other hand, looked completely devastated. His face had turned pale while disbelief filled his eyes as he stared at the destroyed remains of his attack. He simply could not accept what had just happened.

That attack had been created from the very essence of his Pseudo Cosmic Path. It was the strongest power he could currently unleash, yet Max had shattered it so easily that it almost felt unreal to him.
"How is this even possible?!" Ray roared in disbelief.
For a brief moment, hopelessness appeared within his eyes.

At that instant, memories of Mira’s warning resurfaced inside his mind. Before this trial began, she had repeatedly warned him not to underestimate Max. She had even handed him a special treasure from the Sword God Palace and told him to use it immediately to kill Max without giving him any opportunity to resist.
However, Ray had his own pride.

As one of the greatest geniuses of his generation, he never believed he would be forced into relying on an external treasure just to deal with someone at Max’s cultivation level. In his eyes, defeating Max with his own strength was the only acceptable outcome. Only after crushing Max personally did he intend to use the treasure to erase him completely.
But now, Ray finally realized how foolish that thinking had been.
In front of Max, his so-called strength no longer seemed worth mentioning. Even the pride he had always cherished so deeply felt laughable now.
"You forced me to do this!" Ray shouted furiously as madness gradually appeared across his face.
At that moment, he finally decided to use the treasure given to him by the Sword God Palace.
Ray suddenly pressed his hand against the sword-shaped rune engraved upon his palm.
The rune immediately erupted with dazzling white light.
Then, in the next instant, a sword appeared within Ray’s grasp.
The moment the sword manifested, the expressions of countless people changed drastically.

A terrifying sense of oppression swept across the entire battlefield like an invisible storm. Many participants instinctively felt their bodies grow cold as an overwhelming sensation of mortal danger flooded their minds.
Even Jonathan and Julie felt their hearts tremble after sensing the aura emitted by that weapon.

The sword itself was pure white in color, yet the energy radiating from it felt incredibly strange and unnatural. It was neither holy nor demonic. Instead, it carried an indescribable aura that made everyone feel deeply uncomfortable merely by looking at it.
"Do you really think using a sword will make any difference?" Max asked with a faint sneer on his face.
"Hahaha!" Ray suddenly burst into laughter.
However, his laughter no longer sounded normal. It carried madness, frustration, humiliation, and killing intent all mixed together.
Then Ray slowly raised the white sword toward Max.
"Tell me, Max," Ray said while grinning like a madman, "do you know the true difference between this trial and the Cosmic Ascension Conference?"
"What difference?" Max asked calmly.
He genuinely did not know the answer.

From everything he had heard, this trial had been specifically created as a perfect imitation of the Cosmic Ascension Conference so that the geniuses of the many third-rate forces could prepare themselves in advance for the real event.
Because of that, Max had always believed there should not be any real difference between the two.

chapters.title: Chapter 1662: Eternal Hourglass
paragraphs: "Let me tell you the difference." Ray laughed softly as a wicked smile slowly spread across his face.
The madness within his eyes seemed to deepen further while the strange white sword in his hand emitted an increasingly unsettling aura.
"The Cosmic Ascension Conference is held inside a supreme treasure known as the Eternal Hourglass," Ray continued slowly. "That treasure is an omnipotent artifact of unimaginable value."
As he spoke those words, even the surrounding participants revealed shocked expressions.
Clearly, many of them had heard of the Eternal Hourglass before.

"Legend says that the Eternal Hourglass has remained in the possession of the Primordials since ancient times," Ray said proudly. "It is one of the Five Primal Treasures that have existed since time immemorial itself. Because of that, the laws within the Eternal Hourglass are far stricter and far more absolute than the rules governing this Soul Sealing Painting."
Ray’s grin widened further as he continued speaking.

"Inside the Eternal Hourglass, once the rules are established, nobody can break them. No matter what happens during the Cosmic Ascension Conference, participants can never truly die within that world."
Then Ray slowly raised the white sword in his hand.
"But this place is different."
The atmosphere around him instantly became colder.
"The Soul Sealing Painting is powerful, but it is still far inferior to the Eternal Hourglass. The rules here are not absolute. Under certain conditions, they can be bypassed."
Max frowned slightly after hearing those words.

He naturally understood the significance of the Eternal Hourglass. A Primal Treasure that existed since the beginning of time itself was naturally incomparable to treasures like the Soul Sealing Painting.
However, what Max did not understand was what exactly Ray was trying to imply.
"What are you trying to say?" Max asked calmly while narrowing his eyes slightly.
Ray immediately sneered.
"You see this sword?" he said while lightly waving the white-white blade in his hand.
The moment the sword moved, countless people felt their souls tremble involuntarily.
"This sword is one of the six treasured swords of the Sword God Palace," Ray declared proudly. "Its name is the Soul Devouring Sword."
The strange energy radiating from the blade intensified further.
"Anyone killed by this sword will have their soul devoured completely. Their soul will be trapped inside the sword for eternity without any possibility of escape."
As he spoke those final words, terrifying killing intent erupted from Ray’s eyes.
Then he slowly pointed the Soul Devouring Sword directly toward Max.
"Normally, when participants die inside the Soul Sealing Painting, their souls are immediately returned safely to their original bodies outside."
Ray’s smile gradually became colder and colder.
"But if someone is killed by the Soul Devouring Sword..."
A horrifying aura suddenly spread across the battlefield.
"Their soul will be devoured before the Soul Sealing Painting can return it."
Ray stared directly into Max’s eyes as madness filled his face completely.
"And once your soul is devoured..."
"You will truly die."
"I see." Max now realized the true terror of the white sword in Ray’s hand.
"Hahaha! Now die before me, Max Morgan!" Ray’s laughter echoed wildly across the battlefield as madness completely consumed his expression.
At that moment, he tightly gripped the Soul Devouring Sword with both hands.
The instant his fingers wrapped fully around the hilt, the strange white sword suddenly erupted with blinding white light.
Then—
A terrifying pressure descended upon the entire eighth layer.
The expressions of countless participants changed drastically.

Many people instantly felt their souls trembling violently inside their bodies as though an invisible force was trying to drag their consciousness out by force. Several weaker geniuses turned pale immediately while cold sweat poured down their backs uncontrollably.
Even breathing became difficult.
The aura emitted by the Soul Devouring Sword was simply too terrifying.
It was not merely physical pressure.
Instead, it directly targeted the soul itself.
Jonathan’s pupils contracted sharply.
Julie’s face changed completely.
Even they could feel intense danger radiating from that sword.
"This sword..." Jonathan muttered with a grave expression. "It can truly harm souls."

The surrounding participants hurriedly retreated farther away in panic as fear gradually spread through the battlefield. Nobody dared remain too close to Ray anymore because the mere aura emitted from the Soul Devouring Sword made them feel as though their souls were being sliced apart little by little.
Meanwhile, the white light surrounding the sword grew brighter and brighter.
Then suddenly—
The blade began expanding rapidly.

In only a few moments, the originally normal-sized sword transformed into a gigantic white divine blade over ten times larger than before. The enormous sword radiated horrifying soul fluctuations while strange white runes flickered endlessly across its surface.
At the same time, countless miserable wails suddenly echoed faintly from within the sword itself.
Those sounds resembled the cries of tortured souls trapped in endless despair.
Hearing those screams caused many participants to feel chills spread through their entire bodies.
Ray’s grin became even more twisted after seeing everyone’s fearful reactions.
"You should feel honored, Max," Ray said coldly while raising the enormous Soul Devouring Sword high above his head. "Very few people are worthy of dying beneath this weapon."
Boom!!!
Terrifying white sword energy exploded into the sky.
The surrounding space distorted violently while the horrifying pressure emitted by the Soul Devouring Sword continued rising at an astonishing speed.
At that moment, Ray no longer held back any killing intent whatsoever.
He truly intended to kill Max here.
Then, with a crazed roar, Ray slashed the gigantic white sword downward toward Max.
The moment the attack descended, the heavens and earth themselves seemed to darken.

A colossal white sword light tore through the battlefield with unstoppable momentum while terrifying soul-devouring energy swept across the surroundings like a raging storm. Wherever the white slash passed, even space itself appeared to twist unnaturally.
The participants nearby retreated frantically once again, their faces filled with horror.
Many of them had a terrifying feeling.
If they were struck by that attack—
Not only would their bodies perish.
Even their souls would be erased forever.

chapters.title: Chapter 1663: Terror of the Soul Devouring Sword
paragraphs: Max, who stood directly at the center of the attack, felt the terrifying pressure more clearly than anyone else present.
The moment the gigantic silver sword descended toward him, an overwhelming sensation of danger exploded throughout his entire body.
His expression immediately changed.
For the first time since the battle had begun, Max genuinely felt the aura of death approaching him.
It was not the danger of physical destruction.
Instead, it was something far more terrifying.

Max suddenly felt as though an invisible force had wrapped itself around his soul and was trying to rip it out of his body by force. The strange soul-devouring energy emitted by the Soul Devouring Sword continuously invaded his consciousness while a cold and sinister aura spread through every corner of his being.
Even his Soul Palace began trembling violently.
The deeper the gigantic silver sword descended, the stronger that horrifying pulling force became.
It felt as though countless invisible hands were clawing at his soul relentlessly, attempting to drag it toward the enormous blade in the sky.
"This is bad..." Max muttered as his eyes narrowed sharply.
At that moment, the Soul Devouring Sword had not even fully reached him yet.
The gigantic silver blade was still suspended high in the air.
Yet despite that, Max already felt such overwhelming terror that even he could no longer remain completely calm.
That alone proved how horrifying this weapon truly was.

Max had faced countless dangers before. He had confronted beings far stronger than himself and survived situations that should have been impossible to escape from. However, this feeling was entirely different from anything he had experienced previously.
This sword directly targeted the soul itself.
And deep within his instincts, Max could clearly feel one terrifying truth.
If that sword truly struck him—
His soul would genuinely be devoured forever.

Having personally experienced the horrifying nature of the Soul Devouring Sword, Max immediately understood how disastrous the consequences would be if even the slightest portion of his soul was injured by that weapon.
Damage to the body could still be healed.
But damage to the soul was entirely different. Max had already experienced this before.
Once the soul was harmed, countless hidden dangers and irreversible consequences could follow afterward.
"Damn it!" Max cursed inwardly as his expression darkened heavily. "At a time like this, I truly wish I could use my real sword."
At that moment, the figure of the Dragonheart Sword immediately appeared within his mind.

If the Dragonheart Sword were in his hands right now, Max believed that no matter how terrifying the Soul Devouring Sword was, it would never be able to threaten him so easily. The Dragonheart Sword itself possessed extraordinary spirituality and overwhelming might.
Max was absolutely confident it could resist the strange soul-devouring power emitted by Ray’s weapon.
Unfortunately, the Dragonheart Sword remained with his true body outside the Soul Sealing Painting.
Inside this world, participants could only use the weapons provided by the Soul Sealing Painting itself.
Because of that restriction, Max had no choice but to rely on an ordinary sword.
However, Max was not completely without options.

At the same time that this battle was unfolding, Max’s clone had already rushed to unlock the Dimension of Soul. Max knew very clearly that if he could successfully unlock the Dimension of Soul, his control over soul-related powers would increase tremendously.
But the problem was time.
To fully unlock the Dimension of Soul, the clone first needed to pass the trial guarding it. That process could not be completed instantly.
Which meant Max only had one option right now.
He needed to stall for time.
Boom!!!

Seven colored lightning suddenly erupted violently around Max’s body as dazzling arcs of divine lightning crackled across the battlefield. The surrounding air exploded repeatedly under the overwhelming pressure released by the seven colored lightning.
Then, a sword condensed entirely from seven colored lightning appeared within Max’s grasp.
The moment the sword formed, Max’s aura rose sharply.
"Saint Origin Sword Art!"
Max’s eyes turned incomparably sharp as he unleashed the full power of the Saint Origin Sword Art without holding back anything whatsoever.
Boom!!!

A terrifying sword light instantly erupted from Max’s lightning sword as overwhelming sword intent surged into the heavens. The dazzling seven colored slash carried astonishing sharpness as it collided head-on against the gigantic silver Soul Devouring Sword descending from the sky.
For a brief instant, the entire battlefield trembled violently.
Then—
Boom!!!
A deafening explosion erupted across the eighth layer.
The seven colored sword light exploded with incredible force and actually managed to push the gigantic Soul Devouring Sword slightly upward.
The surrounding participants immediately widened their eyes in shock.
Even Ray’s expression changed faintly.
However—
Max’s expression did not improve at all.
Because although his attack had managed to repel the gigantic silver sword slightly, it had failed to destroy it completely.
The enormous Soul Devouring Sword merely trembled violently in the air before continuing its descent once again.
The terrifying soul-devouring aura radiating from it remained overwhelmingly powerful.
Seeing that scene, Max immediately understood one terrifying truth.
This weapon was far stronger than he originally expected.
"Max, your struggles are completely futile!" Ray’s laughter echoed madly across the battlefield as the gigantic Soul Devouring Sword continued descending from the sky with unstoppable force.
The silver light radiating from the enormous blade grew increasingly brighter while the horrifying soul fluctuations spreading from it became even more terrifying than before.
"You still do not understand what kind of place this is!" Ray shouted arrogantly while gripping the Soul Devouring Sword tightly with both hands.

At that moment, the strange energy surrounding the blade began absorbing the soul aura filling the Soul Sealing Painting itself. Countless silver streams of energy flowed toward the sword continuously, causing the pressure emitted by the weapon to rise further and further.
The expressions of the surrounding participants changed once again after witnessing that scene.
"This sword..." Jonathan muttered with a grave expression. "It is actually drawing strength from the Soul Sealing Painting itself."
Julie’s face also became incomparably serious.
Clearly, the Soul Devouring Sword possessed terrifying compatibility with this world.
Ray immediately laughed even louder after noticing the shocked reactions around him.
"This is a soul-type weapon!" he declared proudly. "And this entire world is governed purely by soul power. The longer this battle continues, the stronger the Soul Devouring Sword becomes!"
Boom!!!
A terrifying wave of soul pressure erupted outward once again.
Many nearby participants instinctively retreated farther away while some weaker geniuses even coughed blood after being affected by the horrifying soul aura emitted from the blade.
At that moment, the Soul Devouring Sword no longer felt like a simple weapon.
Instead, it resembled a monstrous ancient entity that was gradually awakening within the battlefield itself.
Ray stared directly at Max with madness and killing intent filling his eyes completely.
"You should stop resisting already," Ray sneered coldly. "No matter what you do, your death has already been decided."
Then his expression twisted further as he laughed viciously.
"You might as well give up and die!"

sentences.text: Max, who stood directly at the center of the attack, felt the terrifying pressure more clearly than anyone else present.
The moment the gigantic silver sword descended toward him, an overwhelming sensation of danger exploded throughout his entire body.
His expression immediately changed.
For the first time since the battle had begun, Max genuinely felt the aura of death approaching him.
It was not the danger of physical destruction.
Instead, it was something far more terrifying.
Max suddenly felt as though an invisible force had wrapped itself around his soul and was trying to rip it out of his body by force.
The strange soul-devouring energy emitted by the Soul Devouring Sword continuously invaded his consciousness while a cold and sinister aura spread through every corner of his being.
Even his Soul Palace began trembling violently.
The deeper the gigantic silver sword descended, the stronger that horrifying pulling force became.
It felt as though countless invisible hands were clawing at his soul relentlessly, attempting to drag it toward the enormous blade in the sky.
"This is bad..." Max muttered as his eyes narrowed sharply.
At that moment, the Soul Devouring Sword had not even fully reached him yet.
The gigantic silver blade was still suspended high in the air.
Yet despite that, Max already felt such overwhelming terror that even he could no longer remain completely calm.
That alone proved how horrifying this weapon truly was.
Max had faced countless dangers before.
He had confronted beings far stronger than himself and survived situations that should have been impossible to escape from.
However, this feeling was entirely different from anything he had experienced previously.
This sword directly targeted the soul itself.
And deep within his instincts, Max could clearly feel one terrifying truth.
If that sword truly struck him—
His soul would genuinely be devoured forever.

Having personally experienced the horrifying nature of the Soul Devouring Sword, Max immediately understood how disastrous the consequences would be if even the slightest portion of his soul was injured by that weapon.
Damage to the body could still be healed.
But damage to the soul was entirely different.
Max had already experienced this before.
Once the soul was harmed, countless hidden dangers and irreversible consequences could follow afterward.
"Damn it!" Max cursed inwardly as his expression darkened heavily.
"At a time like this, I truly wish I could use my real sword."
At that moment, the figure of the Dragonheart Sword immediately appeared within his mind.
If the Dragonheart Sword were in his hands right now, Max believed that no matter how terrifying the Soul Devouring Sword was, it would never be able to threaten him so easily.
The Dragonheart Sword itself possessed extraordinary spirituality and overwhelming might.
Max was absolutely confident it could resist the strange soul-devouring power emitted by Ray’s weapon.
Unfortunately, the Dragonheart Sword remained with his true body outside the Soul Sealing Painting.
Inside this world, participants could only use the weapons provided by the Soul Sealing Painting itself.
Because of that restriction, Max had no choice but to rely on an ordinary sword.
However, Max was not completely without options.
At the same time that this battle was unfolding, Max’s clone had already rushed to unlock the Dimension of Soul.
Max knew very clearly that if he could successfully unlock the Dimension of Soul, his control over soul-related powers would increase tremendously.
But the problem was time.
To fully unlock the Dimension of Soul, the clone first needed to pass the trial guarding it.
That process could not be completed instantly.
Which meant Max only had one option right now.
He needed to stall for time.
Boom!!!
Seven colored lightning suddenly erupted violently around Max’s body as dazzling arcs of divine lightning crackled across the battlefield.
The surrounding air exploded repeatedly under the overwhelming pressure released by the seven colored lightning.
Then, a sword condensed entirely from seven colored lightning appeared within Max’s grasp.
The moment the sword formed, Max’s aura rose sharply.
"Saint Origin Sword Art!"
Max’s eyes turned incomparably sharp as he unleashed the full power of the Saint Origin Sword Art without holding back anything whatsoever.
Boom!!!
A terrifying sword light instantly erupted from Max’s lightning sword as overwhelming sword intent surged into the heavens.
The dazzling seven colored slash carried astonishing sharpness as it collided head-on against the gigantic silver Soul Devouring Sword descending from the sky.
For a brief instant, the entire battlefield trembled violently.
Then—
Boom!!!
A deafening explosion erupted across the eighth layer.
The seven colored sword light exploded with incredible force and actually managed to push the gigantic Soul Devouring Sword slightly upward.
The surrounding participants immediately widened their eyes in shock.
Even Ray’s expression changed faintly.
However—
Max’s expression did not improve at all.
Because although his attack had managed to repel the gigantic silver sword slightly, it had failed to destroy it completely.
The enormous Soul Devouring Sword merely trembled violently in the air before continuing its descent once again.
The terrifying soul-devouring aura radiating from it remained overwhelmingly powerful.
Seeing that scene, Max immediately understood one terrifying truth.
This weapon was far stronger than he originally expected.
"Max, your struggles are completely futile!" Ray’s laughter echoed madly across the battlefield as the gigantic Soul Devouring Sword continued descending from the sky with unstoppable force.
The silver light radiating from the enormous blade grew increasingly brighter while the horrifying soul fluctuations spreading from it became even more terrifying than before.
"You still do not understand what kind of place this is!" Ray shouted arrogantly while gripping the Soul Devouring Sword tightly with both hands.
At that moment, the strange energy surrounding the blade began absorbing the soul aura filling the Soul Sealing Painting itself.
Countless silver streams of energy flowed toward the sword continuously, causing the pressure emitted by the weapon to rise further and further.
The expressions of the surrounding participants changed once again after witnessing that scene.
"This sword..." Jonathan muttered with a grave expression.
"It is actually drawing strength from the Soul Sealing Painting itself."
Julie’s face also became incomparably serious.
Clearly, the Soul Devouring Sword possessed terrifying compatibility with this world.
Ray immediately laughed even louder after noticing the shocked reactions around him.
"This is a soul-type weapon!" he declared proudly.
"And this entire world is governed purely by soul power.
The longer this battle continues, the stronger the Soul Devouring Sword becomes!"
Boom!!!
A terrifying wave of soul pressure erupted outward once again.
Many nearby participants instinctively retreated farther away while some weaker geniuses even coughed blood after being affected by the horrifying soul aura emitted from the blade.
At that moment, the Soul Devouring Sword no longer felt like a simple weapon.
Instead, it resembled a monstrous ancient entity that was gradually awakening within the battlefield itself.
Ray stared directly at Max with madness and killing intent filling his eyes completely.
"You should stop resisting already," Ray sneered coldly.
"No matter what you do, your death has already been decided."
Then his expression twisted further as he laughed viciously.
"You might as well give up and die!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1664: Blocking the Soul Devouring Sword!
paragraphs: Max could clearly feel that Ray was not lying.
The strength of the Soul Devouring Sword was truly increasing with every passing moment.

The longer the weapon remained within the Soul Sealing Painting, the more terrifying its aura became. Vast amounts of soul energy continuously flowed toward the gigantic silver blade from every direction, causing the pressure emitted by the sword to rise at an alarming speed.
At the same time, the pressure bearing down upon Max’s soul also intensified drastically.

The invisible pulling force trying to drag his soul out of his body became stronger and stronger. Max could even feel his sea of consciousness trembling violently as the horrifying soul-devouring aura invaded him relentlessly.
His instincts screamed danger continuously.
Max understood one thing with absolute certainty.
If that gigantic Soul Devouring Sword even touched him slightly—
His soul would immediately be devoured into the blade.
There would be no second chance afterward.
"Just die already!" Ray roared furiously as madness filled his face completely.
Boom!!!

Terrifying sword energy erupted from Ray’s body as he poured all of his strength into the Soul Devouring Sword once again. The gigantic silver blade instantly radiated blinding light before slashing downward toward Max with overwhelming destructive force.
The heavens and earth themselves seemed to shake violently.
The pressure released by the descending sword was so terrifying that cracks spread wildly across the battlefield beneath Max’s feet before the attack had even fully arrived.
Max’s expression immediately turned serious.
Without the slightest hesitation, seven colored lightning exploded violently around his body once again.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The dazzling lightning illuminated the entire battlefield as terrifying destruction energy surged outward from Max like an erupting storm.
Then Max tightly gripped the seven colored lightning sword in his hand.
At that moment, he no longer held back anything whatsoever.
The Vein of Strength erupted completely.
The Vein of Origin unleashed its full power.
The Vein of Vitality surged violently throughout his body.
At the same time, all 5000 Draconic Essences within Max awakened together.
Boom!!!

A terrifying draconic aura exploded from Max’s body as countless golden dragon patterns appeared faintly across his skin. The surrounding space trembled violently beneath the monstrous physical strength erupting from him.
Even the nearby participants widened their eyes in shock after sensing the overwhelming pressure radiating from Max.
"This aura..." Jonathan’s expression changed drastically.
Julie’s eyes also trembled slightly.
At that moment, Max’s physical strength had reached an absolutely horrifying level.
The muscles throughout his body bulged slightly while seven colored lightning and golden draconic energy intertwined around him like raging divine storms.
Then Max raised the seven colored lightning sword with both hands and directly faced the descending Soul Devouring Sword head-on.
He knew very clearly that retreating was meaningless.
If that sword touched him even slightly, his soul would be devoured instantly.
Because of that, Max poured every ounce of strength he possessed into this clash.
"Saint Origin Sword Art!"
Max roared as overwhelming sword intent erupted toward the heavens.
Then, with all of his power, Max swung the seven colored lightning sword upward toward the gigantic silver blade descending from the sky.
Boom!!!
The moment the seven colored lightning sword collided against the gigantic Soul Devouring Sword, a deafening explosion shook the entire eighth layer violently.

Terrifying shockwaves swept across the battlefield in every direction as silver soul energy and seven colored lightning intertwined fiercely in the sky. The surrounding space distorted repeatedly under the overwhelming pressure generated by the collision.
Then—
To everyone’s shock—
The gigantic Soul Devouring Sword actually stopped descending.
The enormous silver blade trembled violently in the air while Max’s seven colored lightning sword blocked it head-on from below.
For a brief moment, the two terrifying powers remained locked in stalemate.
The surrounding participants instantly widened their eyes in disbelief.
"What?!" someone shouted involuntarily.
Even Jonathan’s usually calm expression changed sharply.
Julie’s eyes trembled slightly as she stared at the unbelievable scene unfolding before her.
After all, everyone present had already sensed how horrifying the Soul Devouring Sword truly was. The pressure emitted by that weapon alone was enough to make countless geniuses feel despair.
Yet now—
Max had actually managed to stop it.

The dazzling seven colored lightning surrounding Max’s body exploded wildly while golden draconic energy surged continuously through his arms. Veins bulged across his muscles as he used every ounce of his terrifying physical strength to hold back the gigantic silver blade pressing down upon him.
The ground beneath Max’s feet shattered layer after layer from the overwhelming pressure.
However—
He still did not retreat even a single step.
Ray’s eyes widened completely after witnessing that scene.
Disbelief filled his face instantly.
Nobody understood the terrifying nature of the Soul Devouring Sword better than him.
This was one of the six treasured swords of the Sword God Palace.
A terrifying soul-type divine weapon capable of devouring souls directly.

Even among powerful treasures, the Soul Devouring Sword possessed an extremely terrifying reputation. Once its soul-devouring power was unleashed fully, ordinary geniuses would not even possess the courage to resist it directly.
Blocking the Soul Devouring Sword head-on should have been impossible for someone of Max’s level.
Yet Max had done exactly that.
At that moment, Ray finally realized something terrifying.
The strength Max possessed was far beyond anything he had originally imagined.
This realization caused Ray’s killing intent toward Max to rise even further.
Because the more terrifying Max appeared, the more Ray understood that he absolutely could not allow Max to continue growing.
Otherwise—
Once Max truly matured, even the Sword God Palace might no longer be capable of suppressing him.
"You monster..." Ray muttered unconsciously as his expression gradually twisted.
Then madness surged within his eyes once again.
"No matter what..." Ray growled furiously while tightening his grip on the Soul Devouring Sword even harder. "You must die here today!"
Boom!!!
A far more terrifying wave of soul power erupted from Ray’s body.

The silver light surrounding the Soul Devouring Sword intensified drastically as countless soul-devouring runes lit up across the gigantic blade. The horrifying pressure pressing downward instantly multiplied.
Ray had begun pouring even more of his strength into the Soul Devouring Sword.
The gigantic silver blade descended lower once again.
Crack! Crack! Crack!
The seven colored lightning sword in Max’s hands trembled violently under the overwhelming pressure while the surrounding lightning exploded chaotically across the battlefield.
At the same time, the pressure assaulting Max’s soul rose to an even more terrifying level.

chapters.title: Chapter 1665: Dimension of Soul - Unlocked!
paragraphs: As the pressure emitted by the Soul Devouring Sword continued rising higher and higher, even Max gradually began finding it difficult to withstand it completely.

The gigantic silver blade pressed downward relentlessly while terrifying soul-devouring energy flooded the entire battlefield like an endless storm. The invisible force trying to tear Max’s soul out of his body became increasingly overwhelming with every passing second.
Even his sea of consciousness trembled violently under that horrifying pressure.

The seven colored lightning sword within Max’s grasp shook continuously as crackling lightning exploded wildly around him. Veins bulged across his arms while the power of the Three Divine Veins surged frantically through his body. At the same time, all 5000 Draconic Essences roared violently inside him as golden draconic energy erupted endlessly outward.
Yet despite all of that power—
Max was still gradually being suppressed.
The gigantic Soul Devouring Sword descended lower inch by inch while the ground beneath Max’s feet shattered repeatedly under the overwhelming pressure.
Ray noticed this immediately.
The madness within his eyes intensified further.
"Hahaha!" Ray laughed arrogantly as he poured even more strength into the Soul Devouring Sword. "That’s right! Struggle all you want! In the end, you still cannot resist the Soul Devouring Sword!"
Boom!!!
The gigantic silver blade released another terrifying wave of soul pressure.

The surrounding participants retreated even farther away while their expressions became increasingly pale. Some weaker geniuses even felt blood leaking from the corners of their mouths after being affected by the horrifying soul aura spreading throughout the battlefield.
At that moment, Max’s expression had already become extremely serious.
He understood very clearly that continuing like this would eventually lead to his defeat.
Then suddenly—
A familiar mechanical voice echoed inside his mind.
[Congratulations Host.]
[The Dimension of Soul has successfully been unlocked.]
[You have gained authority over the Dimension of Soul.]
The instant Max saw those notifications, the seriousness within his eyes disappeared completely.
Then slowly—
A smile appeared across his face.
That smile immediately caused Ray to frown.
However, before anyone could understand what Max was planning to do—
Max suddenly withdrew all of his defenses entirely.
The seven colored lightning sword instantly dispersed into countless sparks of lightning.
The terrifying aura erupting from the Three Divine Veins gradually faded.
Even the overwhelming draconic energy released from the 5000 Draconic Essences began calming down.
Seeing this scene, the surrounding participants widened their eyes in disbelief.
Jonathan’s expression changed sharply.
Julie looked completely stunned.
Even Ray himself was momentarily caught off guard before a crazed grin spread across his face.
"Hahaha!" Ray burst into wild laughter. "So you finally gave up!"
Without Max resisting it anymore, the gigantic Soul Devouring Sword descended completely.
Boom!!!
The enormous silver blade slammed directly onto Max.

Terrifying soul-devouring energy exploded outward instantly as dazzling silver light engulfed the entire battlefield completely. The horrifying soul aura surged violently in every direction while the surrounding space distorted repeatedly from the overwhelming pressure.
At that moment, countless participants instinctively believed the battle had already ended.
After all, nobody believed someone could survive being struck directly by the Soul Devouring Sword.
However—
A few moments later—
The silver light slowly began fading away.
Then the expressions of everyone present froze completely.
Max was still standing there.
The gigantic Soul Devouring Sword was pressing directly against his shoulder with terrifying force while endless soul-devouring energy continuously surged into his body.
Yet—
Nothing happened.
Max’s soul had not been devoured.
His body had not collapsed.
In fact, Max simply stood there calmly as though the terrifying sword pressing against him possessed no threat whatsoever.
The horrifying soul energy continuously entered his body, yet it vanished completely without causing any damage, almost like rivers flowing into an endless abyss.
Silence instantly descended across the battlefield.
Every participant stared blankly at Max with expressions filled with disbelief and confusion. Their minds could no longer comprehend the scene unfolding before them.
Jonathan’s pupils contracted violently.
Julie’s lips parted slightly in shock.
Even the nearby geniuses who had been retreating earlier now stood frozen in place.
Nobody could understand what they were seeing.
The Soul Devouring Sword was one of the six treasured swords of the Sword God Palace.
It was a terrifying weapon specifically designed to devour souls.
Yet now—
Its soul-devouring power had completely failed against Max.
Ray’s laughter disappeared instantly.
The crazed smile on his face froze completely while disbelief slowly spread across his expression.
His eyes widened more and more as he stared at Max like he had just witnessed something impossible.
"That..." Ray muttered unconsciously as his grip around the Soul Devouring Sword trembled faintly. "How is this possible?"
"Since you brought such a good weapon here..." Max said calmly while looking at the gigantic Soul Devouring Sword pressing against his shoulder. "Then let me have it."
The moment those words fell, Max slowly raised his right hand and touched the enormous silver blade directly.
Then—
The gigantic Soul Devouring Sword suddenly disappeared.
It vanished so abruptly that everyone present froze completely.

The terrifying soul-devouring pressure flooding the battlefield disappeared instantly along with it. The overwhelming silver light faded rapidly while the horrifying aura that had made countless geniuses tremble moments ago vanished without leaving behind even the slightest trace.
Silence descended across the eighth layer once again.
Ray’s eyes widened so much that they almost seemed ready to burst out of their sockets.
"What?!" Ray shouted in disbelief.
His face twisted completely as panic and shock exploded within his eyes.
The Soul Devouring Sword was one of the six treasured swords of the Sword God Palace. It was an incomparably precious soul weapon personally entrusted to him for this mission.
Yet now—
It had simply disappeared.
"What did you do to the Soul Devouring Sword?!" Ray roared furiously while staring at Max like a madman.
Max merely smiled faintly.
"It belongs to me now," Max replied calmly.
The moment his voice fell, seven colored lightning erupted violently around his body once again.
Crackling divine lightning exploded across the battlefield while a dazzling seven colored lightning sword condensed instantly within Max’s grasp.
The surrounding participants immediately felt their hearts tremble.
Because the moment Max summoned the lightning sword again, the aura around him changed completely.
The relaxed expression from earlier disappeared entirely.
What replaced it instead was cold killing intent.
Then Max slowly raised the seven colored lightning sword toward Ray.
"Now..." Max said softly while looking directly into Ray’s terrified eyes. "It’s your turn to die."

chapters.title: Chapter 1666: A new Sword for Max!
paragraphs: The instant those words entered Ray’s ears, fear exploded inside his heart for the very first time.
"No!" Ray shouted frantically.
Boom!!!

Terrifying sharpness erupted from his body once again as he desperately tried to mobilize the power of his Pseudo Cosmic Path. Scarlet spear energy exploded wildly around him while he attempted to launch another attack.
However—
He was too late.
Before Ray could even fully gather his strength, Max’s figure suddenly disappeared from where he originally stood.
Ray’s pupils contracted violently.
Then, in the next instant—
Max appeared directly beside him.
So fast that Ray could not even react properly.
The seven colored lightning surrounding Max’s body illuminated the battlefield brilliantly while terrifying sword intent surged into the heavens.
"Saint Origin Sword Art," Max muttered softly.
At the same time, traces of the half-formed Emotion Severing Cosmic Path fused directly into the sword strike.
The atmosphere around the blade changed instantly.

A terrifying severing aura erupted from the seven colored lightning sword while emotionless sword intent spread outward like an unstoppable tide. It felt as though the sword strike itself had become capable of severing everything in existence.
Ray’s eyes widened completely.
Before he could even defend himself—
Slash!!!
A dazzling sword light flashed across the battlefield.
For a brief moment, everything became silent.
Then Ray’s body froze completely.
The scarlet spear energy surrounding him dispersed instantly while the expression on his face stiffened forever in disbelief and terror.
A thin bloody line slowly appeared across the center of his body.
Then—
His body split apart completely.
Blood exploded into the air as Ray was sliced cleanly into two halves by Max’s sword strike.
The surrounding participants immediately felt chills spread throughout their entire bodies after witnessing that horrifying scene.
Ray Willer—
One of the greatest geniuses present within the Soul Sealing Painting—
Had been killed instantly.
At the same time, countless fragments of light erupted from Ray’s severed body as the rules of the Soul Sealing Painting activated.
Because his soul had not truly been destroyed, Ray’s consciousness was immediately expelled from the Soul Sealing Painting itself.
In the next instant, Ray’s shattered figure disappeared completely from the battlefield.
He had been eliminated.
Max had intentionally chosen not to kill Ray using the Soul Devouring Sword that now rested within his Dimension of Soul.

Although he now possessed complete control over that terrifying weapon, Max understood very clearly what the consequences would be if he truly used it to devour Ray’s soul in front of so many witnesses.

The Soul Devouring Sword was one of the six treasured swords of the Sword God Palace. If Ray’s soul had truly been destroyed here, the force behind him would undoubtedly investigate the matter thoroughly afterward.
At that point, the situation would become troublesome even for Max and for the Black Dragon Clan.
Because of that, Max deliberately chose a different method.
He merely eliminated Ray from the Soul Sealing Painting instead of truly killing him.
However—
That did not mean Max intended to let Ray continue living peacefully afterward.
The moment Max learned that Ray had already joined hands with the Sword God Palace to target him, Max had silently decided Ray’s fate long ago.
Someone who carried such intense killing intent toward him while also possessing terrifying talent and background was not someone Max could afford to leave alive indefinitely.
Especially not after today’s battle.
After this confrontation, Ray’s hatred toward him would only deepen further.
Max naturally understood this clearly.
Which meant there was only one possible outcome waiting for Ray in the future.
Death.
A faintly wicked smile slowly appeared across Max’s face as countless thoughts flashed through his mind silently.
"I could not kill you in front of so many people today," Max thought inwardly while looking at the place where Ray had disappeared moments ago. "But once we leave the Soul Sealing Painting..."
The smile on Max’s face deepened slightly.
"You had better hide well."
Max slowly raised his hand.
Then, in the next instant, the Soul Devouring Sword appeared within his grasp once again.

The pure white blade radiated faint silver light while strange soul fluctuations continuously spread from the sword itself. Even after Ray’s elimination, the weapon still emitted an unsettling aura capable of making ordinary geniuses feel instinctive fear deep within their souls.
Max casually waved the sword through the air several times while carefully sensing the terrifying power hidden within it.
Then a faint smile appeared across his face.
"This really is a good sword," Max muttered softly.
The moment he placed the Soul Devouring Sword inside the Dimension of Soul earlier, everything had changed completely.

Within the Dimension of Soul, Max possessed absolute authority over soul-related powers and objects. Because of that overwhelming authority, the ownership connection between Ray and the Soul Devouring Sword had been forcefully severed.
Now, the sword belonged entirely to Max.
Naturally, such a thing should have been impossible under normal circumstances.

The Sword God Palace had long ago engraved an extremely powerful ownership rune upon the Soul Devouring Sword. That rune existed specifically to prevent others from stealing or using the weapon freely.
As long as the rune remained intact, nobody besides Ray should have been capable of controlling the Soul Devouring Sword.
Even if someone managed to snatch the sword away physically, the weapon would still recognize only Ray as its true owner.
However—
For Max, such restrictions no longer mattered.

Inside the Dimension of Soul, the authority he possessed over soul-related laws and connections was simply too overwhelming. The ownership rune left behind by the Sword God Palace had been completely suppressed and erased the moment the sword entered that dimension.
Max slowly examined the silver-white blade once more as thoughtful light flickered through his eyes.
"The Sword God Palace really seems to possess quite an impressive collection of swords," Max muttered with a faint smile.
The first example was naturally the Dragonheart Sword.
Although the sword had once belonged to the legendary Sword Sovereign, the Sword God Palace’s obsession with retrieving it from him had always felt somewhat unusual to Max.
The lengths they were willing to go merely to reclaim that weapon were simply too excessive.
Because of that, Max had gradually developed a suspicion deep within his heart.
Perhaps—
Even the Dragonheart Sword originally belonged to the Sword God Palace as well.
