Hatred and killing intent immediately filled his bloodshot eyes the moment he looked at Max.
"Who exactly from the Sword God Palace ordered you to kill me?" Max asked calmly.
The moment those words entered Ray’s ears, his expression changed slightly.
Although the change was brief, Max still noticed it clearly.
However, that hesitation quickly disappeared and was replaced by a cold sneer afterward.
"You think I would tell you something like that?" Ray laughed hoarsely while glaring at Max hatefully.
Even in his miserable state, arrogance still remained deeply rooted within him.
"You really have no idea what kind of existence the Sword God Palace truly is," Ray continued coldly.
His face gradually twisted more and more while hatred filled his voice.
"If I die here, the Sword God Palace will never let you go."
"The people standing behind me are existences far beyond your imagination."
Ray continued threatening Max repeatedly while relying entirely upon the reputation and power of the Sword God Palace.
"The moment they discover what happened to me, your fate will become worse than death."
"You actually think someone like you can oppose the Sword God Palace?"
Ray suddenly burst into crazed laughter.
"You are nothing in front of them!"
However, throughout the entire exchange, Max’s expression remained completely calm.
He simply observed Ray quietly while pondering silently in his mind.
Since Ray refused to reveal the truth willingly, Max could only speculate himself.
Deep down, Max already possessed a strong suspicion regarding the identity of the person behind all this.
Mira.
The daughter of the Sword God Palace.
From the beginning, she had shown obvious hostility toward him, especially after the matter involving the Dragonheart Sword and what had happened between them in Orion.
Everything pointed toward her.
However—
Another possibility suddenly surfaced within Max’s mind.
Could there perhaps be someone else involved as well?
Someone else within the Sword God Palace who also wanted him dead?
That thought caused Max’s eyes to narrow slightly.
Then slowly, a faint smile appeared across his face.
"If you refuse to answer," Max said calmly, "then I will simply find the answer myself."
Before Ray could properly understand what Max meant, Max suddenly raised his right hand and directly placed it upon Ray’s head.
The moment Max touched him, Ray’s expression changed drastically.
An overwhelming sense of danger exploded within his heart instantly.
"What are you doing?!" Ray shouted instinctively.
However, before he could react further—
Boom!!!
A terrifying wave of soul force erupted violently from Max’s body.
The entire underground chamber trembled faintly while strange soul fluctuations spread throughout the surroundings.
Even the torch flames along the walls flickered chaotically beneath the pressure.
Then suddenly—
Ray screamed.
"AAAAAAHHHHHH!!!"
An incomparably painful scream echoed throughout the underground prison as a translucent figure was forcefully dragged out from within Ray’s body.
It was his soul.
Ray’s soul struggled frantically while emitting terrified screams, but it was completely unable to resist the overwhelming authority of the Dimension of Soul.
At that moment, Max’s eyes glowed faintly while terrifying soul laws silently activated around him.
The next instant, Ray’s soul was directly pulled into the Dimension of Soul.
Inside that mysterious dimension, everything immediately changed.
The moment Ray’s soul entered the Dimension of Soul, it became completely suppressed by the laws governing that place.
Invisible soul chains instantly wrapped around it while terrifying refining power descended from every direction.
Ray’s soul struggled desperately.
He screamed.
He begged.
However, nothing could stop the refining process.
Soon afterward, the Dimension of Soul began breaking Ray’s soul apart gradually and refining it into pure soul force.
At the same time, Max immediately felt enormous amounts of refined soul energy flowing directly into his sea of consciousness.
His soul force began increasing rapidly.
The strength of his soul became noticeably more powerful while pure soul energy continuously nourished every corner of his consciousness.
However, that was not the only thing Max obtained.
As Ray’s soul continued being refined completely, countless memories suddenly flooded directly into Max’s mind.
Scenes began flashing rapidly one after another.
Conversations.
Orders.
Hatred.
Plans.
Killing intent.
Max silently watched through all of Ray’s memories while searching for the answer he wanted.
Then eventually—
He saw her.
Mira.
The daughter of the Sword God Palace.
Inside Ray’s memories, Max clearly witnessed Mira personally instructing Ray to kill him during the Smelting Trial.
The hatred within her eyes while speaking about Max was unmistakable.
The moment Max saw those memories, a cold smile slowly appeared across his face.
"So it truly was you," Max muttered quietly.
Knowing that the person behind everything was indeed Mira, Max did not feel particularly surprised.
From the very beginning, he had already suspected her involvement.
After witnessing the memories extracted from Ray’s soul, that suspicion had merely been confirmed completely.
Because of that, Max no longer wasted any further thought on the matter.
Instead, his gaze slowly shifted toward Ray’s lifeless body lying on the cold stone floor.
Then—
Black flames suddenly erupted from Max’s hand.
The dark flames radiated terrifying devouring energy as they instantly engulfed Ray’s corpse completely.
The moment the flames touched the body, Ray’s flesh, blood, bones, and even remaining spiritual energy began rapidly disintegrating.
Within only a few moments, Ray’s body was completely devoured into nothingness.
At the same time, a dense stream of energy immediately surged back into Max’s body through the black flames.

chapters.title: Chapter 1677: Julie’s Plan
paragraphs: Max calmly closed his eyes briefly while sensing the enormous amount of energy flowing throughout his meridians.
That energy was extremely pure.
After devouring Ray completely, Max could clearly feel his cultivation drawing even closer toward another breakthrough.
Several moments later, the flow of energy gradually stabilized.
Only after the final traces of Ray’s body turned into dust did the devouring process completely end.
A faint smile slowly appeared across Max’s face afterward.
"With this," he muttered softly, "I am truly very close to reaching the tenth level of the Law Awakening Realm."
Then Max calmly turned around and walked out of the underground chamber.
Soon afterward, he arrived back outside the prison area where Jonathan and Julie were already waiting for him silently.
The moment Jonathan saw Max emerge alone, he immediately understood the outcome.
"You dealt with him?" Jonathan asked quietly.
Max nodded calmly.
"He is gone."
Jonathan simply nodded after hearing that.
There was neither pity nor hesitation within his expression.
After everything Ray had attempted to do during the Smelting Trial, Jonathan no longer cared what happened to him anymore.
Meanwhile, Julie also remained completely silent.
Then Jonathan looked toward Max once again before asking seriously, "Now that we have agreed to join your secret force, how exactly are we supposed to contact you or the others afterward?"
"We cannot exactly move openly together without attracting attention."
Hearing that, Max remained thoughtful for a brief moment before speaking calmly.
"Extend your hand."
Jonathan looked slightly confused after hearing those words.
However, he still trusted Max enough by now not to question him further.
Soon afterward, Jonathan slowly extended his right hand toward Max.
The next instant, Max activated the Dimensional Sovereign Body silently.
Invisible dimensional power instantly gathered around his fingertips while strange spatial fluctuations spread faintly through the surroundings.
Then Max placed his finger lightly against Jonathan’s palm.
A moment later, a mysterious rune slowly began forming upon Jonathan’s hand.
The rune radiated faint silver-blue light while tiny dimensional patterns continuously shifted within it like living space laws.
After several seconds, the rune completely stabilized.
Only then did Max withdraw his hand calmly.
Jonathan immediately lowered his gaze toward the strange rune now engraved upon his palm.
His eyes filled with curiosity instantly.
"What exactly is this?" he asked while carefully observing the rune.
Max calmly explained afterward.
"This rune is an access point connected to a secret domain."
Jonathan and Julie’s expressions changed slightly after hearing that.
"That secret domain," Max continued calmly, "is where the headquarters of my force currently exists."
Then Max looked directly toward both of them.
"If you wish to enter that place, simply imbue the rune with your Divine Essence."
"The rune will automatically create a portal leading directly into the secret domain."
Jonathan’s eyes narrowed slightly while sensing the astonishing dimensional fluctuations hidden within the rune.
Clearly, this was no ordinary spatial technique.
Meanwhile, Max continued speaking.
"Come tonight."
His gaze gradually became serious afterward.
"At midnight, while everyone’s attention is focused upon the banquet."
A faint smile slowly appeared across his face.
"That will be your first time entering the secret domain."
"How many members does your secret force currently have?" Julie asked curiously after hearing Max’s explanation about the secret domain.
The moment she asked that question, Max’s expression immediately became slightly awkward.
He coughed lightly before answering honestly.
"At the moment..." Max said while smiling helplessly, "you two are the only people I have personally recruited."
Jonathan and Julie both stared at him silently afterward.
Max continued explaining calmly.
"There is also a friend of mine managing certain matters inside the secret domain itself. So if we count everyone together, the entire force currently has only three members."
Julie immediately frowned slightly after hearing that.
"Only three?" she repeated while looking at Max strangely.
However, only a moment later, a thoughtful light suddenly flashed through her eyes.
"Actually..." Julie said slowly while smiling faintly, "I might already have a way to increase those numbers rapidly."
Max’s interest immediately rose slightly.
"And how exactly do you plan to do that?" he asked curiously.
Julie calmly answered afterward.
"The Cosmic Ascension Conference."
The moment those words were spoken, Max immediately became thoughtful.
Meanwhile, Julie continued speaking confidently.

"Right now, although your name has already spread somewhat throughout the Divine Realm because of the Sovereign Sword, most people still do not truly understand how terrifying your strength and potential actually are."
Her eyes gradually brightened slightly afterward.
"But the Cosmic Ascension Conference is different."

"That place gathers geniuses from countless forces and worlds. If you can display overwhelming talent there and truly make a name for yourself during the conference, then many people will naturally become interested in following you."
Julie smiled faintly afterward.
"At that point, countless geniuses would willingly join a force created by someone like you."
Max slowly nodded after hearing her explanation.
"That actually sounds like a very good plan," he admitted honestly.
However, shortly afterward, his expression gradually became more serious.
"There is still one major problem though."
Jonathan and Julie both looked toward him curiously.
"I have no reliable way to determine who can truly be trusted," Max explained calmly.
His eyes narrowed slightly afterward.
"I invited the two of you because I know neither of you would betray me."
"But random people are different."
"If I begin recruiting large numbers of geniuses later, there is no guarantee some of them will not secretly carry their own motives."
At that moment, Julie suddenly laughed softly.
"You really do not need to worry too much about that issue," she said calmly.
A faintly dangerous smile slowly appeared across her face afterward.
"With my poison abilities, I can place a hidden deadly poison mark on every person who joins the force."
Jonathan’s expression changed slightly after hearing that.
Meanwhile, Julie calmly continued.
"The poison would remain dormant normally, so it would not affect them at all."
"However, the moment someone attempts betrayal..."
A faint crimson poisonous flame flickered briefly within Julie’s eyes.
"The poison would immediately activate and kill them."

chapters.title: Chapter 1678: A Talk with Isabella!
paragraphs: Max’s eyes immediately brightened slightly afterward.
"Haha, that is actually a very good idea," he admitted while nodding.
Although such a method sounded somewhat ruthless, Max still understood its necessity clearly.
A secret organization like theirs absolutely could not afford betrayal from within.
Fear was sometimes the most effective method of maintaining loyalty.
Especially during the early stages while their foundations remained weak.
The more Max thought about it, the more he felt Julie’s suggestion was extremely useful.
Then suddenly, another idea surfaced within his mind.
The Dimension of Soul.
With the authority he possessed over souls now, Max realized he could potentially create something similar himself.
If future members willingly allowed it, he could directly place a soul mark upon them through the Dimension of Soul.
That soul mark could remain dormant normally without affecting the target at all.
However—
The moment someone attempted betrayal, the soul mark could instantly activate.
At that point, their soul would collapse directly from within.
And once the soul shattered—
Death would become inevitable.
"Alright," Max said while looking toward Julie with a faint smile appearing across his face. "We will proceed according to your plan."
A thoughtful light gradually appeared within his eyes afterward.
"If things truly unfold the way you described, then the Cosmic Ascension Conference might become the perfect opportunity to expand our force rapidly."

After all, the Cosmic Ascension Conference gathered countless monstrous geniuses from across the Divine Realm. If he could truly display overwhelming talent there and make his name resound throughout the younger generation, then attracting talented individuals afterward would naturally become much easier.
Max slowly nodded to himself.
"In that case," he continued calmly, "I will do everything possible to stand out during the Cosmic Ascension Conference."
The confidence within his voice was extremely obvious.
Then Max looked toward both Jonathan and Julie once again.
"Make sure the two of you arrive at the secret domain tonight at midnight," he said seriously. "I will be waiting there personally."
Jonathan immediately nodded.
Julie also agreed calmly afterward.
With everything already settled between them, there was no reason to continue remaining inside the underground area any longer.
Soon afterward, Max turned around and began walking away from the hidden prison tunnels.
Meanwhile, Jonathan and Julie silently watched his departing figure thoughtfully.
As for Max himself, he quickly left the underground prison area completely and headed back toward the mansion assigned to the Black Dragon Clan.
After leaving the underground prison area, Max soon returned to the mansion assigned to the Black Dragon Clan.

The atmosphere throughout the mansion was noticeably lively because many disciples were still discussing the results of the Smelting Trial and preparing for the banquet that would be held later that night.
However, Max paid little attention to those conversations.
The moment he entered the courtyard, his gaze immediately found Lucia and Isabella speaking together nearby.
"Isabella," Max called out calmly. "Come meet me alone in my room for a moment."
The moment those words were spoken, Lucia immediately narrowed her eyes suspiciously.
"Alone?" she repeated while looking between the two of them carefully.
A strange expression gradually appeared across her face afterward.
Meanwhile, Isabella herself looked slightly confused as well.
However, before Lucia could begin questioning him further, Max calmly added, "There are some important matters we need to discuss."
Lucia stared at him silently for several moments afterward.
Clearly, her curiosity had already been completely aroused.
Still, after a brief pause, she eventually let out a helpless sigh.
"Forget it," Lucia muttered while waving her hand dismissively. "I still have some matters to deal with anyway."
Even though she remained suspicious, she ultimately chose not to interfere further.
Soon afterward, Lucia left the courtyard while Isabella quietly followed Max toward his room inside the mansion.
After entering the room, Isabella immediately looked toward Max curiously.
"What happened?" she asked directly.
Max did not waste time afterward.
"I recruited two more members into the force," he explained calmly.
Isabella’s eyes immediately brightened slightly after hearing that.
"Jonathan and Julie?" she asked almost instantly.
Max smiled faintly afterward.
"You guessed correctly."
Then his expression gradually became more serious.
"They will officially enter the secret domain tonight at midnight."
A thoughtful look appeared across Isabella’s face after hearing that.
Then she nodded lightly.
"That timing should work perfectly," Isabella replied calmly. "I already finished constructing a basic conference room inside the secret domain earlier."
Hearing that immediately caused Max to smile slightly.
"Good," he said while nodding.
Then suddenly, Max extended his hand toward Isabella.
"Now," he continued calmly, "extend your hand for a moment."
Isabella blinked in confusion after hearing that.
Clearly, she did not understand what Max intended to do.
However, trusting him completely by now, she still slowly extended her hand toward him without questioning further.
The next instant, Max activated the Dimensional Sovereign Body silently.
Invisible dimensional power immediately gathered around his fingertips while faint spatial ripples spread throughout the room.
Then Max lightly touched Isabella’s palm.
A moment later, a mysterious silver-blue rune slowly began forming upon her hand.
The rune radiated faint dimensional fluctuations while intricate spatial patterns continuously shifted within it like flowing space laws.
Several seconds later, the rune completely stabilized.
Only then did Max withdraw his hand calmly.
Meanwhile, Isabella immediately lowered her gaze toward the strange rune now engraved upon her palm.
Her beautiful eyes instantly filled with curiosity.
"What exactly is this?" she asked while carefully inspecting the rune.
Max calmly explained afterward.
"This is a dimensional passage rune."
His gaze gradually became serious.
"The rune acts as an access point connected directly to the Dimension of Genesis."
Isabella’s eyes widened slightly after hearing that.
Then Max continued explaining calmly.
"If you channel your Divine Essence into the rune, it will automatically open a portal leading directly into the secret domain."
A faint smile appeared on his face afterward.
"In other words..."
"You can now freely enter the Dimension of Genesis whenever necessary."
After hearing Max’s explanation, Isabella lowered her gaze toward the dimensional rune on her palm once again.
Faint silver-blue light continued flowing quietly through the intricate patterns engraved upon her skin while subtle spatial fluctuations spread from it continuously.
The more she sensed the rune carefully, the more astonished she became.
Because she could clearly feel that the rune was genuinely connected to another independent space entirely.
This was far beyond ordinary spatial transportation methods.
Eventually, Isabella slowly nodded.
"This will be extremely useful," she said honestly while a faint smile appeared across her face.
Her eyes gradually brightened slightly afterward.

"With this rune, communication and movement between members of the force will become far easier and much safer. Even if we are scattered across different places in the future, we can still gather inside the secret domain whenever necessary."
A thoughtful expression appeared on her face afterward.
"And more importantly," Isabella continued calmly, "nobody outside the force would even know such a hidden domain exists."
The more she thought about it, the more valuable the Dimension of Genesis seemed.
A completely hidden independent world capable of serving as headquarters for their growing organization was something many major forces throughout the Divine Realm would desperately desire.
Meanwhile, Max simply smiled faintly after hearing her words.
Clearly, Isabella had immediately understood just how important the Dimension of Genesis would become for them in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 1679: Night of the Banquet!
paragraphs: It was already midnight, and the entire Violet Star Palace had transformed into a magnificent sea of lights.

Every palace building, courtyard, bridge, and pavilion throughout the enormous sect grounds had been decorated beautifully for the banquet. Countless spirit lanterns floated through the sky like glowing stars while streams of colorful spiritual light illuminated the night from every direction.
The atmosphere throughout the Violet Star Palace was lively and celebratory.

Music echoed continuously across the palace grounds while disciples and elders from the various third-rate forces gathered together in large numbers. Some discussed the Smelting Trial enthusiastically while others exchanged cultivation experiences and formed new connections before the coming Cosmic Ascension Conference.
The banquet itself was grand.
Long tables filled with rare spiritual foods, wines, and precious fruits stretched across the main banquet area while beautiful spirit dancers performed beneath the glowing lights.
Everywhere one looked, laughter and conversation filled the surroundings.
However, despite the lively atmosphere, one topic remained at the center of nearly every discussion.
Max Morgan.

Many younger geniuses continued speaking about his overwhelming performance during the Smelting Trial, especially his battle against Ray Willer and the shocking display of strength he revealed inside the Tower of Treasure.
Meanwhile, Max himself had only briefly attended the banquet.

Outwardly, he maintained enough appearances to avoid attracting suspicion by disappearing entirely. He calmly exchanged a few conversations with several elders and disciples before quietly leaving the banquet grounds afterward.
Very few people noticed his departure amidst the enormous gathering.
Soon afterward, Max returned directly to the mansion assigned to the Black Dragon Clan.
The moment he entered his room, the calm expression on his face gradually became more serious.
Then, his figure disappeared completely from the room and entered the Dimension of Genesis.
After entering the Dimension of Genesis, Max did not immediately head toward the meeting hall Isabella had prepared earlier.
Instead, he first went to meet Alice and Lenavira.

The peaceful atmosphere inside the Dimension of Genesis felt completely different from the lively banquet outside the Violet Star Palace. The surrounding land was calm and quiet while dense spiritual energy flowed naturally throughout the entire dimension.
Soon, Max arrived at the area where Alice and Lenavira were currently staying.
The moment Alice noticed him approaching, her eyes immediately brightened.
"You finally came back," she said while quickly walking toward him. "Do you know how boring it gets staying here sometimes?"
Meanwhile, Lenavira simply smiled faintly from the side while looking toward Max calmly.
Max chuckled lightly after hearing Alice complain.
"The Smelting Trial only ended recently," he replied helplessly. "Naturally, I had many things to deal with outside first."
Alice immediately crossed her arms afterward.
"Still," she muttered, "you disappear for long periods every single time."
Max only smiled slightly before changing the topic.
"Actually," he said calmly, "once we return to the Black Dragon Clan, the two of you will get to meet several interesting people."
The moment those words were spoken, Alice immediately became curious.
"Interesting people?" she repeated quickly.
Even Lenavira’s gaze shifted toward Max with slight interest afterward.
Max nodded lightly.
"They are indeed very interesting people."
However, despite saying that much, Max did not reveal anything else afterward.

The interesting people were of course his spirit Lily and the little dragon Vormir. Max hadn’t got the time to introduce Alice and Lenavira to Lily and Vormir because of the Smelting Trial but now that this trial had ended, Max felt that it was time they finally meet each other.
Alice immediately narrowed her eyes suspiciously.
"Who exactly are they?" she asked quickly.
Max merely smiled calmly.
"That," he replied casually, "is still a secret for now."
Alice instantly became dissatisfied after hearing that answer.
"A secret again?" she complained immediately. "Why do you keep making everything sound mysterious lately?"
Then she quickly stepped closer toward Max while continuing to question him endlessly.
"Are they strong?"
"Are they from the Violet Star Palace?"
"Are they geniuses from the Smelting Trial?"
"Are there many of them?"
However, no matter how many questions Alice asked continuously, Max never directly answered any of them.
Instead, he simply smiled faintly every single time.
"You will find out soon enough," he replied calmly.
Alice immediately pouted in frustration afterward.
"You are doing this on purpose," she muttered unhappily.
Meanwhile, Lenavira quietly watched the exchange between the two with amusement visible within her eyes.
Clearly, she already understood that Max deliberately intended to keep the matter hidden for now.
Eventually, after speaking with the two of them for some time longer, Max finally turned toward the direction of the meeting hall Isabella had prepared earlier.
Tonight—
The first true gathering of his secret force was about to begin.
"Alright," Max said while lightly patting both Alice and Lenavira on the head. "I still have some important matters to deal with first, so I will see the two of you later."
Alice immediately looked slightly dissatisfied again.
"You always say that," she muttered quietly.
Meanwhile, Lenavira simply smiled gently afterward.
"That is fine," she said calmly. "Dinner is almost ready anyway. Once you finish your work, come eat with us."
The moment those words entered his ears, a genuinely warm smile slowly appeared across Max’s face.
"That sounds perfect," he replied while nodding lightly. "I should be back within a few hours."
As he spoke those words, a faint sense of warmth quietly rose within Max’s heart.

Ever since Alice and Lenavira had arrived inside the Dimension of Genesis, the atmosphere here had gradually begun changing little by little. What was once merely an empty independent world had slowly started feeling more alive.
And although Max remained extremely busy most of the time with cultivation, battles, and endless responsibilities, he still tried his best to spend time with them whenever possible.
In fact, after returning to the Dimension of Genesis repeatedly over time, Max had gradually developed a habit.
Whenever he was free, he would eat dinner together with Alice, Lenavira, and Isabella.
Sometimes they simply talked casually.
Sometimes Alice complained endlessly about how boring cultivation was.
Other times Isabella discussed matters related to the secret domain while Lenavira quietly listened nearby.
They were simple moments.
Yet strangely—
Max found himself valuing those moments more and more.
Because despite all the dangers surrounding him constantly, those peaceful dinners inside the Dimension of Genesis made the place genuinely begin feeling like home.
Even if he could not remain beside them all the time, Max still tried his best not to completely neglect them.
At the very least, whenever he returned to the Dimension of Genesis, he wanted to spend some time together with them normally.
Meanwhile, after hearing Max agree to return for dinner later, Lenavira’s smile deepened slightly.
"We will wait for you then," she said softly.
Max nodded one final time afterward before finally turning around and heading toward the meeting hall prepared by Isabella deeper within the Dimension of Genesis.
By the time Max arrived at the meeting hall inside the Dimension of Genesis, Isabella, Jonathan, and Julie were already waiting there.

The meeting hall itself was surprisingly refined despite being created recently. A large circular table stood at the center of the room while faint silver lights illuminated the surroundings softly. Intricate dimensional patterns could be seen engraved across portions of the walls, causing the entire hall to carry a mysterious atmosphere.
The moment Max entered, the attention of everyone inside immediately shifted toward him.
A faint smile appeared across Max’s face afterward.
Then he slowly walked toward the center of the hall before looking directly at Jonathan and Julie.
"First of all," Max said calmly, "welcome to the Crown."
The moment those words were spoken, Jonathan and Julie’s expressions changed slightly.
Clearly, this was the first time they had heard the actual name of the secret force.

chapters.title: Chapter 1680: First Meeting of Crown!
paragraphs: "The Crown?" Jonathan repeated thoughtfully.
Max nodded lightly.
"That is the name of this organization."
His voice remained calm, yet the atmosphere inside the hall gradually became more serious afterward.
Then Max gestured toward Isabella standing nearby.
"This is Isabella," he introduced calmly. "She currently handles many matters related to the secret domain itself."
The moment Jonathan and Julie looked toward her, Isabella calmly nodded toward the two of them.
"It is good to finally meet both of you properly," Isabella said with a faint smile.
Jonathan also nodded politely afterward.
Likewise, Julie greeted Isabella calmly as well.
After the brief introductions were finished, the atmosphere inside the hall quickly became much more serious.
Max did not waste unnecessary time afterward.
He directly walked toward the large table at the center of the hall before speaking calmly.
"Now that everyone is here," Max said slowly, "it is time to discuss the true purpose behind the Crown."
The moment those words were spoken, the expressions of Jonathan and Julie gradually became solemn once again.
Meanwhile, Max’s gaze slowly swept across everyone present.
Then he continued quietly.
"The purpose of this organization is simple."
A faint coldness gradually appeared within his eyes afterward.
"The Crown exists to stand against the Elf Race."
Silence instantly filled the meeting hall.
Neither Jonathan nor Julie spoke immediately after hearing those words again.
After all, even now, the idea of directly opposing the Elf Race still sounded unbelievable.
However, unlike earlier, neither of them questioned Max anymore.
Meanwhile, Max himself did not explain further. He did not mention why he possessed hostility toward the elves. He did not explain what kind of connection existed between him and the Elf Race.
Nor did he reveal the true depth of the hatred hidden within his heart.
Those matters remained buried completely within him for now.
Instead, Max simply continued calmly.
"The Crown will continue growing stronger quietly from the shadows. We will gather resources, we will grow in number and once...."
A faintly terrifying pressure unconsciously spread from Max’s body.
"We are strong enough, we will declare war on the Elf Race."
Max looked toward the three of them calmly before continuing further.

"Even though the eventual enemy of the Crown is the Elf Race, none of you need to worry too much about that right now because I have no intention of provoking them recklessly while we are still weak. The current Crown does not even possess the qualifications to stand openly before a race like the elves yet, and I would never drag all of you into a meaningless death. Until we possess enough strength, everything we do will remain hidden in the shadows."
The atmosphere inside the meeting hall gradually became more serious afterward.

"We will quietly continue building our foundations," Max continued while his gaze swept across everyone present. "We will gather resources, connections, influence, and talented people while expanding slowly from the shadows. I will only move against the Elf Race once I am absolutely certain that we possess enough strength to face them directly."
Jonathan and Julie silently nodded after hearing those words.
Then Max leaned slightly against the table before continuing calmly.

"For now, the most important thing for the Crown is growth. If possible, I want all of you to quietly recommend this organization to people you genuinely trust. However, do not recruit random geniuses carelessly. I only want talented people who are capable of keeping secrets and who would never betray us."
Jonathan slowly folded his arms while thinking deeply for several moments.

"That should not be impossible," he said thoughtfully. "I still know several people I trust completely. However, we will need to be extremely cautious because one wrong person could expose everything before the Crown is ready."
Julie also nodded lightly afterward.

"I know a few suitable people as well," she said calmly. "Most of them already possess dissatisfaction toward the current balance of power within the Divine Realm, so convincing them might not be too difficult. Still, I agree that secrecy must remain our highest priority for now."
A faint smile slowly appeared across Max’s face after hearing their responses.

"Good," he replied calmly. "Then from today onward, all of you should begin quietly laying the foundation for the Crown. We may only have a few members right now, but one day this organization will become powerful enough that even the major forces of the Divine Realm cannot ignore us."
Max continued discussing several additional matters with them after that.

The four of them talked about how future communication inside the Crown would work, how carefully they needed to handle recruitment, and how they should avoid drawing unnecessary attention toward themselves before the Cosmic Ascension Conference began.
The atmosphere inside the meeting hall gradually became much more relaxed compared to earlier.
Eventually, after nearly everything that needed to be discussed had already been settled, the first official meeting of the Crown finally came to an end.
Jonathan and Julie soon prepared to leave the Dimension of Genesis and return back to the Violet Star Palace before anyone noticed their absence for too long.
However, just as the two of them were about to leave the meeting hall, Max suddenly spoke once again.
"One more thing."
Jonathan and Julie both stopped before turning back toward him curiously.
Max calmly looked toward the dimensional passage runes engraved upon their hands before speaking.
"You are free to enter the Dimension of Genesis whenever you want," he said calmly. "There are no restrictions placed upon either of you."
The moment those words entered their ears, both Jonathan and Julie looked slightly surprised.
Meanwhile, Max continued explaining further.

"This place is now the headquarters of the Crown, but it is also a safe place for all members of the organization. Whether you need a place to hide, cultivate peacefully, or discuss important matters privately, you may freely come here anytime."
A faint smile appeared across his face afterward.
"You do not need my permission every single time."
Jonathan slowly looked around the meeting hall once more after hearing that.
Even now, he still found the existence of this secret independent dimension unbelievable.
A hidden world completely isolated from the outside.
The value of something like this was immeasurable.
Meanwhile, Julie lightly touched the dimensional rune on her palm while speaking softly.
"This really is an incredible place."
Max simply smiled faintly afterward.
"In the future," he replied calmly, "the Crown will continue growing here."
Jonathan eventually nodded seriously afterward.
"Understood," he said calmly. "We will make good use of it."
Julie also nodded lightly before the two of them finally activated the dimensional passage runes on their palms.
Soon afterward, dimensional portals silently opened before them.
The next moment, Jonathan and Julie stepped through the portals and disappeared from the meeting hall completely, leaving only Max and Isabella behind inside the Dimension of Genesis once again.

chapters.title: Chapter 1681: A Peaceful Dinner
paragraphs: After Jonathan and Julie left the Dimension of Genesis, the meeting hall gradually became quiet once again.
Only Max and Isabella remained there now.
The faint silver lights illuminating the hall reflected softly across the large circular table while the surrounding dimensional patterns continued glowing quietly in the background.
For a while, the two of them continued discussing several remaining matters related to the Crown.

They spoke about possible future recruits, how the organization should remain hidden during its early stages, and how the Dimension of Genesis would gradually need to expand if the number of members continued increasing later.
Isabella also briefly reported several things she had already arranged inside the secret domain, including the construction of temporary living areas and additional meeting spaces for future use.
Max listened carefully to everything before eventually nodding in satisfaction.
"You handled things very well," he said calmly.
A faint smile appeared across Isabella’s face afterward.
"Someone has to manage things properly while you keep disappearing everywhere," she replied lightly.
Max chuckled softly after hearing that.
Eventually, after discussing a few more matters, Max slowly stood up from his seat.
"That should be enough for tonight," he said calmly afterward.
Then his gaze shifted toward Isabella.
"You should go rest as well."
Isabella nodded lightly after hearing that.
Clearly, even she had spent most of the day busy handling various matters both inside and outside the Dimension of Genesis.
Soon afterward, she also stood up from her seat.
"Alright," Isabella replied calmly. "Then I will leave the remaining matters to you."
Max nodded lightly in response.
The next moment, Isabella activated the dimensional rune on her hand before calmly leaving the meeting hall as well, leaving Max alone inside the quiet headquarters of the Crown.
"Mother... Father..."
Max quietly muttered those words to himself after Isabella left the meeting hall as well.
The calm expression on his face gradually became heavier afterward while countless thoughts silently surfaced within his mind.
Now that the Crown had finally begun taking shape and more people were slowly gathering around him, Max could already feel himself gradually moving closer toward the path he truly wanted to walk.
A path toward strength.
Toward revenge.
And toward eventually finding the truth behind everything connected to his parents.
"It will not be much longer before I come for the two of you," Max whispered softly.
After remaining silent for several moments longer, Max finally turned around and quietly left the meeting hall as well.
Soon afterward, he returned toward the living area inside the Dimension of Genesis where Alice and Lenavira had been waiting earlier.
The moment Max arrived there, he immediately smelled the fragrance of food filling the surroundings.

Warm spiritual lights illuminated the small dining area softly while several dishes filled with spirit beast meat, spiritual vegetables, and fragrant soup had already been prepared neatly across the table.
Meanwhile, Alice immediately noticed him approaching.
"You finally came back," she said while looking at him suspiciously. "At this point I was starting to think you forgot about dinner entirely."
Max chuckled lightly afterward before taking a seat nearby.
"I told you earlier that I would return," he replied calmly.
Lenavira smiled gently from the side while placing another dish onto the table.
"At least you still remembered in the end," she said softly.
The atmosphere around the table gradually became warm and peaceful afterward.
Unlike the tense discussions inside the meeting hall earlier, the dinner felt completely relaxing.
Alice continuously talked about random things while complaining occasionally about how boring staying inside the Dimension of Genesis could become sometimes.
Meanwhile, Lenavira quietly listened most of the time while occasionally smiling at Alice’s endless chatter.
As for Max—
He simply enjoyed the peaceful atmosphere silently.
For a brief period, he no longer needed to think about the Sword God Palace, the Crown, the Cosmic Ascension Conference, or the countless dangers waiting for him outside.
Instead, he simply ate dinner together with them quietly like an ordinary person.
Eventually, after the dinner finally ended and some more casual conversation passed between them, Max slowly stood up from his seat.
"I should leave now," he said calmly afterward.
Alice immediately looked slightly dissatisfied again.
"You are leaving already?" she asked.
Max nodded lightly.
"I need to prepare for the Cosmic Ascension Conference."
Lenavira smiled softly afterward.
"Then be careful."
Max nodded once more before lightly patting Alice’s head again.
"I will return soon."
Soon afterward, Max activated the Dimensional Sovereign Body once again.
A dimensional portal silently opened before him.
Then, after one final glance toward Alice and Lenavira, Max stepped through the portal and quietly left the Dimension of Genesis.
The next moment, Max appeared once again inside the training chamber connected to the room assigned to him within the mansion where the Black Dragon Clan members were staying temporarily.
The quiet chamber was illuminated softly by spiritual lamps placed around the walls while dense spiritual energy naturally flowed throughout the room.
After returning from the Dimension of Genesis, the atmosphere around Max gradually became much calmer.
He slowly walked toward the center of the training chamber before sitting down cross-legged quietly.
At the same time, countless thoughts surfaced within his mind once again.
"Tomorrow morning..." Max muttered softly to himself, "we will finally leave the Violet Star Palace and return to the Verdant Sky Star Realm."
A faint thoughtful expression appeared across his face afterward.
This trip to the Violet Star Palace had brought him enormous gains far beyond his expectations.

Not only had his cultivation and strength improved tremendously, he had also obtained the Saint Origin Sword Art, unlocked the Dimension of Soul, recruited the first true members of the Crown, and gained countless treasures from the Tower of Treasure.
Most importantly—
He had finally begun laying the foundations for his future plans.
However, despite all those gains, Max knew very clearly that his current strength was still far from enough.
The Cosmic Ascension Conference was only three months away.
And compared to the monstrous geniuses who would gather there from throughout the Divine Realm, his current cultivation was still too weak.
Because of that, Max no longer intended to waste any remaining time.
A sharp light gradually appeared within his eyes afterward.
"Since there are still several hours remaining before dawn," Max muttered quietly, "I might as well use this opportunity properly."
The enormous amount of treasures and resources obtained from the Smelting Trial still remained inside his storage ring untouched.
Originally, Max had delayed using them because he focused entirely upon comprehending the Saint Origin Sword Art first.
But now—
It was finally time.
A faint draconic aura slowly began rising around Max’s body while dense Divine Essence fluctuations spread throughout the training chamber.
"I should finally be able to reach the tenth level of the Law Awakening Realm tonight," Max said softly.
The moment those words fell, Max immediately took out large quantities of cultivation resources from his storage ring.
Divine crystals.
Divine stones.
Ancient medicinal herbs.
Rare spiritual fruits.
Numerous treasures rapidly appeared around him one after another, filling the entire training chamber with astonishing spiritual fluctuations.

sentences.text: After Jonathan and Julie left the Dimension of Genesis, the meeting hall gradually became quiet once again.
Only Max and Isabella remained there now.
The faint silver lights illuminating the hall reflected softly across the large circular table while the surrounding dimensional patterns continued glowing quietly in the background.
For a while, the two of them continued discussing several remaining matters related to the Crown.

They spoke about possible future recruits, how the organization should remain hidden during its early stages, and how the Dimension of Genesis would gradually need to expand if the number of members continued increasing later.
Isabella also briefly reported several things she had already arranged inside the secret domain, including the construction of temporary living areas and additional meeting spaces for future use.
Max listened carefully to everything before eventually nodding in satisfaction.
"You handled things very well," he said calmly.
A faint smile appeared across Isabella’s face afterward.
"Someone has to manage things properly while you keep disappearing everywhere," she replied lightly.
Max chuckled softly after hearing that.
Eventually, after discussing a few more matters, Max slowly stood up from his seat.
"That should be enough for tonight," he said calmly afterward.
Then his gaze shifted toward Isabella.
"You should go rest as well."
Isabella nodded lightly after hearing that.
Clearly, even she had spent most of the day busy handling various matters both inside and outside the Dimension of Genesis.
Soon afterward, she also stood up from her seat.
"Alright," Isabella replied calmly.
"Then I will leave the remaining matters to you."
Max nodded lightly in response.
The next moment, Isabella activated the dimensional rune on her hand before calmly leaving the meeting hall as well, leaving Max alone inside the quiet headquarters of the Crown.
"Mother...
Father..."
Max quietly muttered those words to himself after Isabella left the meeting hall as well.
The calm expression on his face gradually became heavier afterward while countless thoughts silently surfaced within his mind.
Now that the Crown had finally begun taking shape and more people were slowly gathering around him, Max could already feel himself gradually moving closer toward the path he truly wanted to walk.
A path toward strength.
Toward revenge.
And toward eventually finding the truth behind everything connected to his parents.
"It will not be much longer before I come for the two of you," Max whispered softly.
After remaining silent for several moments longer, Max finally turned around and quietly left the meeting hall as well.
Soon afterward, he returned toward the living area inside the Dimension of Genesis where Alice and Lenavira had been waiting earlier.
The moment Max arrived there, he immediately smelled the fragrance of food filling the surroundings.

Warm spiritual lights illuminated the small dining area softly while several dishes filled with spirit beast meat, spiritual vegetables, and fragrant soup had already been prepared neatly across the table.
Meanwhile, Alice immediately noticed him approaching.
"You finally came back," she said while looking at him suspiciously.
"At this point I was starting to think you forgot about dinner entirely."
Max chuckled lightly afterward before taking a seat nearby.
"I told you earlier that I would return," he replied calmly.
Lenavira smiled gently from the side while placing another dish onto the table.
"At least you still remembered in the end," she said softly.
The atmosphere around the table gradually became warm and peaceful afterward.
Unlike the tense discussions inside the meeting hall earlier, the dinner felt completely relaxing.
Alice continuously talked about random things while complaining occasionally about how boring staying inside the Dimension of Genesis could become sometimes.
Meanwhile, Lenavira quietly listened most of the time while occasionally smiling at Alice’s endless chatter.
As for Max—
He simply enjoyed the peaceful atmosphere silently.
For a brief period, he no longer needed to think about the Sword God Palace, the Crown, the Cosmic Ascension Conference, or the countless dangers waiting for him outside.
Instead, he simply ate dinner together with them quietly like an ordinary person.
Eventually, after the dinner finally ended and some more casual conversation passed between them, Max slowly stood up from his seat.
"I should leave now," he said calmly afterward.
Alice immediately looked slightly dissatisfied again.
"You are leaving already?" she asked.
Max nodded lightly.
"I need to prepare for the Cosmic Ascension Conference."
Lenavira smiled softly afterward.
"Then be careful."
Max nodded once more before lightly patting Alice’s head again.
"I will return soon."
Soon afterward, Max activated the Dimensional Sovereign Body once again.
A dimensional portal silently opened before him.
Then, after one final glance toward Alice and Lenavira, Max stepped through the portal and quietly left the Dimension of Genesis.
The next moment, Max appeared once again inside the training chamber connected to the room assigned to him within the mansion where the Black Dragon Clan members were staying temporarily.
The quiet chamber was illuminated softly by spiritual lamps placed around the walls while dense spiritual energy naturally flowed throughout the room.
After returning from the Dimension of Genesis, the atmosphere around Max gradually became much calmer.
He slowly walked toward the center of the training chamber before sitting down cross-legged quietly.
At the same time, countless thoughts surfaced within his mind once again.
"Tomorrow morning..." Max muttered softly to himself, "we will finally leave the Violet Star Palace and return to the Verdant Sky Star Realm."
A faint thoughtful expression appeared across his face afterward.
This trip to the Violet Star Palace had brought him enormous gains far beyond his expectations.

Not only had his cultivation and strength improved tremendously, he had also obtained the Saint Origin Sword Art, unlocked the Dimension of Soul, recruited the first true members of the Crown, and gained countless treasures from the Tower of Treasure.
Most importantly—
He had finally begun laying the foundations for his future plans.
However, despite all those gains, Max knew very clearly that his current strength was still far from enough.
The Cosmic Ascension Conference was only three months away.
And compared to the monstrous geniuses who would gather there from throughout the Divine Realm, his current cultivation was still too weak.
Because of that, Max no longer intended to waste any remaining time.
A sharp light gradually appeared within his eyes afterward.
"Since there are still several hours remaining before dawn," Max muttered quietly, "I might as well use this opportunity properly."
The enormous amount of treasures and resources obtained from the Smelting Trial still remained inside his storage ring untouched.
Originally, Max had delayed using them because he focused entirely upon comprehending the Saint Origin Sword Art first.
But now—
It was finally time.
A faint draconic aura slowly began rising around Max’s body while dense Divine Essence fluctuations spread throughout the training chamber.
"I should finally be able to reach the tenth level of the Law Awakening Realm tonight," Max said softly.
The moment those words fell, Max immediately took out large quantities of cultivation resources from his storage ring.
Divine crystals.
Divine stones.
Ancient medicinal herbs.
Rare spiritual fruits.
Numerous treasures rapidly appeared around him one after another, filling the entire training chamber with astonishing spiritual fluctuations.

chapters.title: Chapter 1682 - 10th level of Law Awakening Realm!
paragraphs: Then Max slowly closed his eyes.
The next instant—
He began cultivating.
The moment Max began cultivating, the entire training chamber immediately trembled faintly beneath the pressure erupting from his body.
Dense Divine Essence fluctuations spread throughout the surroundings while enormous quantities of spiritual energy gathered rapidly toward him from every direction.
Meanwhile, the countless treasures placed around him continuously radiated astonishing energy.
However, Max did not absorb those resources normally.
Instead—
Black flames suddenly erupted around his body.

The dark flames burned silently while radiating terrifying devouring power capable of swallowing everything around them. The moment the flames touched the cultivation resources nearby, the treasures immediately began disintegrating rapidly.
Divine crystals shattered one after another.
Rare medicinal herbs withered instantly.
Divine stones dissolved into pure energy.
Every resource refined by the black flames was immediately transformed into incredibly pure energy before being devoured directly into Max’s body.
Boom!
The energy fluctuations within the training chamber intensified violently afterward.
Max calmly sat at the center of the chamber while continuously devouring the treasures surrounding him at an astonishing speed.
At the same time, his cultivation aura began rising steadily.
The ninth level of the Law Awakening Realm gradually approached its limits more and more.
However, Max did not stop.
More black flames spread outward.
More treasures disappeared into pure energy.
The amount of resources consumed by Max was honestly terrifying.
Ordinary geniuses would likely require months or even years to fully refine such an enormous amount of cultivation treasures safely.
Yet under the terrifying devouring ability of the black flames, Max absorbed everything forcefully with overwhelming speed.
As time slowly passed, the aura surrounding Max became increasingly frightening.
Dense seven colored lightning gradually crackled around his body while draconic pressure continuously spread outward from within him.
At the same time, the three already awakened Divine Veins inside his body began glowing brilliantly.
The Vein of Origin.
The Vein of Vitality.
The Vein of Strength.
All three Divine Veins resonated together while enormous amounts of energy surged through his meridians continuously.
Soon afterward—
Crack.
A faint breaking sound suddenly echoed deep within Max’s body.
The next instant, Max’s eyes snapped open sharply.
Boom!!!
An incomparably powerful aura exploded outward from his body instantly.
The entire training chamber shook violently while terrifying waves of Divine Essence spread across the surroundings like a storm.
Seven colored lightning erupted wildly around Max while dense draconic aura filled the room completely.
At that moment—
Max had finally broken through.
The tenth level of the Law Awakening Realm.
A faint smile slowly appeared across Max’s face while feeling the overwhelming power surging throughout his body.
Compared to before, his Divine Essence had become far denser and far more powerful.
Even his physical body had strengthened noticeably once again after absorbing such enormous amounts of refined energy.
Meanwhile, the remaining traces of black flames gradually disappeared around him.
The countless cultivation resources originally filling the room had almost completely vanished now.
Everything had been devoured entirely.
Max slowly clenched his fist afterward.
Boom!
The surrounding air exploded instantly from the sheer force alone.
Feeling the terrifying strength flowing through his body now, a sharp light gradually appeared within Max’s eyes.
"The tenth level of the Law Awakening Realm..." he muttered softly.
Then a faint smile slowly spread across his face.
His gaze gradually sharpened afterward.
"It is finally time to open the fourth Divine Vein."
After successfully reaching the tenth level of the Law Awakening Realm, Max still did not stop cultivating.
Instead, the determination within his eyes only intensified further.
The next goal waiting before him was the fourth Divine Vein of the Seven Divine Veins.
The Vein of Speed.
Without wasting any time, Max immediately waved his hand once again.

The next moment, enormous quantities of body cultivation treasures appeared throughout the training chamber one after another. Ancient beast blood sealed within crystal containers floated into the air while rare body tempering herbs, spirit fruits, essence crystals, and countless other treasures radiating dense physical energy filled the surroundings completely.
The spiritual fluctuations released by those treasures alone were already astonishing.
Ordinary cultivators would likely need years to carefully absorb such a massive amount of body cultivation resources safely.
However, Max never intended to absorb them slowly.
Boom!!!
Terrifying black flames erupted around his body once again.

The devouring flames spread rapidly throughout the chamber while instantly engulfing every body cultivation treasure nearby. The moment those flames touched the resources, violent physical energy exploded outward like a raging flood.
Ancient beast blood vaporized instantly into dense crimson energy.
Spirit fruits dissolved into pure body refining essence.
Even the extremely hard essence crystals shattered continuously beneath the terrifying power of the black flames.
Soon afterward, all that violent physical energy surged directly into Max’s body.
The pressure released from the energy was honestly horrifying.

Normally, attempting to absorb such violent body cultivation energy recklessly would instantly destroy a cultivator from within. Flesh would rupture. Meridians would collapse. Bones would shatter beneath the unbearable pressure.
Yet Max remained completely unmoved.
Dense draconic aura erupted throughout his body instantly while golden-black dragon scales gradually appeared across portions of his skin.
At the same time, the power of five thousand Draconic Essences awakened completely inside him.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Terrifying draconic energy surged throughout every corner of Max’s body while the violent body cultivation energy continuously slammed against his flesh, bones, and meridians.
However, unlike ordinary cultivators, Max’s physical body had already become unimaginably durable.
The Dragon Scales Transformation.
The five thousand Draconic Essences.
The continuous strengthening from the previous three Divine Veins.
All of it had already transformed Max’s body into something monstrous.
Because of that, although the violent energy flooding through him remained extremely dangerous, his body forcefully endured everything without collapsing.
His muscles trembled violently beneath the pressure.
His meridians glowed brilliantly while enormous amounts of energy surged through them continuously.
Yet despite all of that, his body never once showed signs of breaking apart.
Instead, it endured everything overwhelmingly.
Meanwhile, the three previously awakened Divine Veins inside Max’s body began resonating violently.
The Vein of Origin released dense foundational power throughout his body.
The Vein of Vitality continuously repaired and strengthened him simultaneously.
The Vein of Strength caused terrifying physical force to erupt from within him endlessly.
As all three Divine Veins resonated together, the hidden fourth pathway buried deep within Max’s body finally began reacting.
The Vein of Speed.
The moment Max sensed that hidden Divine Vein beginning to awaken, his eyes sharpened instantly.
More black flames erupted around him afterward while even more body cultivation treasures disappeared rapidly into pure energy.
The pressure inside the training chamber rose to an astonishing level.
The surrounding walls even began cracking faintly beneath the terrifying aura leaking from Max’s body.
At the same time, the hidden fourth Divine Vein gradually became brighter and brighter.
Then suddenly—
Boom!!!
A terrifying shockwave exploded outward from Max’s body instantly.
Silver-golden light erupted violently throughout his meridians while the hidden fourth Divine Vein finally burst open completely.
At that moment, Max suddenly felt his entire body becoming strangely lighter.
The flow of Divine Essence inside his body accelerated tremendously.
Even the movement of the surrounding spiritual energy appeared slower inside his perception.
Most importantly—
An astonishing sense of speed erupted throughout every corner of his body.
The Vein of Speed had finally awakened completely.

chapters.title: Chapter 1683: Leaving the Violet Star Palace!
paragraphs: After successfully awakening the Vein of Speed, Max did not immediately stop cultivating.
Instead, he quickly realized something important.
Although the Vein of Speed had already opened completely, he still lacked proper control over the overwhelming speed now flowing through his body.
Every movement felt unnaturally light.
Every circulation of Divine Essence moved several times faster than before.
Even his perception of the surrounding world had changed drastically.
Because of that, Max understood very clearly that if he wanted to fully utilize the true power of the Vein of Speed in battle, he first needed to become completely accustomed to it.
Without hesitation, Max immediately entered the Dimension of Time once again.
The moment he stepped into the endless training world, seven colored lightning erupted around his body while terrifying speed fluctuations spread throughout the surroundings.
Then Max began training.
At first, he merely attempted simple movements.
However, the results shocked even him slightly.
The moment Max took a single step forward, his figure instantly disappeared from his original location.
Boom!!!
Violent shockwaves exploded throughout the Dimension of Time while Max suddenly appeared hundreds of meters away almost instantly.
Even he himself nearly lost control over his own movement speed.
"So fast..." Max muttered while narrowing his eyes slightly.
The Vein of Speed was far more terrifying than he initially expected.
Not only did it drastically increase his movement speed, it also enhanced the circulation speed of his Divine Essence, reaction speed, attack speed, and even his overall perception ability.
Because of this, Max spent enormous amounts of time inside the Dimension of Time continuously practicing.
Again and again—
He repeated movements endlessly.
Sometimes he trained pure movement speed.
Other times he fused the Vein of Speed with his seven colored lightning movement techniques.
Occasionally, he even combined it with the Saint Origin Sword Art.
The results became increasingly terrifying.
At times, Max moved so quickly that dozens of afterimages filled the Dimension of Time simultaneously.
At other moments, his sword strikes became so fast that even the surrounding space split apart before the attack itself could fully be seen.
The more Max adapted to the Vein of Speed, the more terrifying his combat ability gradually became.
Most importantly—
Unlike ordinary cultivators, Max’s monstrous physical body allowed him to withstand such terrifying movement speed without collapsing.
Because of the five thousand Draconic Essences and Dragon Scales Transformation, his body remained durable enough to endure the overwhelming pressure generated by the Vein of Speed.
Otherwise, ordinary cultivators would likely tear apart their own muscles and meridians merely trying to move at such terrifying velocity.
Time passed continuously inside the Dimension of Time.
Eventually, after practicing for an unknown amount of time, Max finally managed to gain much better control over the Vein of Speed.
His movements gradually became smoother.
More precise.
More terrifying.
Then suddenly—
A voice echoed from outside the his room.
"Max, everyone is preparing to leave the Violet Star Palace."
The moment he heard those words, Max slowly stopped training.
The violent speed aura surrounding him gradually calmed afterward while the countless afterimages filling the Dimension of Time slowly disappeared one by one.
Then Max let out a slow breath.
"It is finally time to return," he muttered softly.
Soon afterward, Max left the Dimension of Time completely.
By the time he opened his eyes again, he had already returned to the training chamber inside the mansion.
Outside—
The members of the Black Dragon Clan were already preparing to depart from the Violet Star Palace and head back toward the Verdant Sky Star Realm.
Max soon met up with Lucia and Isabella after leaving the training chamber.

At that moment, many members of the Black Dragon Clan and other third rate forces were already preparing to depart from the Violet Star Palace. Numerous disciples and elders moved throughout the palace grounds while various star shuttles belonging to different forces floated high in the air nearby.
The Smelting Trial had officially ended.
And now—
Everyone was finally returning back to their respective realms and factions.
As Max walked together with Lucia and Isabella toward the departure area, Lucia suddenly looked toward him curiously.
"So," she asked while folding her arms lightly, "how was your experience here?"
A faint smile immediately appeared across Max’s face afterward.
"It was quite worthwhile," he replied honestly. "The Smelting Trial gave me much better rewards than I originally expected."
Then his eyes flashed slightly afterward.
"The three trials helped me gain a lot of things, and they also allowed my cultivation to finally reach the peak of the Law Awakening Realm."
The moment those words entered Lucia and Isabella’s ears, both of their expressions changed slightly.
"You reached the peak already?" Lucia asked with obvious surprise.
Even Isabella looked genuinely shocked afterward.
After all, Max’s cultivation speed was honestly becoming increasingly terrifying.
Max simply smiled faintly afterward without explaining further.
Naturally, he did not mention anything regarding the Vein of Speed or the terrifying gains he obtained from the Tower of Treasure.
Meanwhile, as the three of them continued walking, they eventually arrived before the enormous star shuttle belonging to the Black Dragon Clan.

The massive vessel floated majestically above the ground while ancient runes glowed brightly across its dark exterior. Dense star energy continuously circulated around the shuttle while powerful spiritual fluctuations spread outward from it endlessly.
This was the same star shuttle they originally used to travel toward the Violet Sky Star Realm.
At that moment, several elders of the Black Dragon Clan were already standing nearby while organizing the disciples preparing to board.
The moment Max and the others arrived, one of the elders immediately spoke loudly.
"Everyone, board the star shuttle immediately. We will soon depart from the Violet Sky Star Realm."
Soon afterward, disciples from the Black Dragon Clan began entering the enormous vessel one after another.
Meanwhile, just as Max prepared to board as well, his eyes suddenly shifted toward the distance.
There—
Jonathan and Julie could be seen standing quietly far away near another palace platform.
Clearly, the two of them had specifically come there to see him off before his departure.
However, neither Jonathan nor Julie approached directly.
Because with so many people present around the departure area, openly interacting too closely with Max now would only attract unnecessary attention.
Instead, the two of them simply stood silently in the distance.
Then Jonathan lightly nodded toward Max.
Julie also revealed a faint smile afterward.
It was a simple farewell.
Yet all three of them understood clearly that this would not be their final meeting.
Meanwhile, Max also smiled faintly afterward before raising his hand slightly toward the two of them.
A silent goodbye.
Jonathan and Julie quietly watched him afterward while Max finally turned around and entered the enormous star shuttle together with Lucia and Isabella.
Soon afterward—
Boom!!!
The massive star shuttle slowly rose into the sky.
Ancient runes across its surface erupted brilliantly while dense star energy gathered around the vessel continuously.
Then, under the gazes of countless people below, the enormous shuttle accelerated rapidly upward.
Within only a few moments, it pierced through the clouds above the Violet Star Palace completely.
Soon afterward, the gigantic vessel transformed into a streak of light shooting through the endless starry sky before finally disappearing into the distant stars altogether.
