The moment those words entered Lucia and Isabella’s ears, both of their expressions changed slightly.
"You reached the peak already?" Lucia asked with obvious surprise.
Even Isabella looked genuinely shocked afterward.
After all, Max’s cultivation speed was honestly becoming increasingly terrifying.
Max simply smiled faintly afterward without explaining further.
Naturally, he did not mention anything regarding the Vein of Speed or the terrifying gains he obtained from the Tower of Treasure.
Meanwhile, as the three of them continued walking, they eventually arrived before the enormous star shuttle belonging to the Black Dragon Clan.
The massive vessel floated majestically above the ground while ancient runes glowed brightly across its dark exterior.
Dense star energy continuously circulated around the shuttle while powerful spiritual fluctuations spread outward from it endlessly.
This was the same star shuttle they originally used to travel toward the Violet Sky Star Realm.
At that moment, several elders of the Black Dragon Clan were already standing nearby while organizing the disciples preparing to board.
The moment Max and the others arrived, one of the elders immediately spoke loudly.
"Everyone, board the star shuttle immediately.
We will soon depart from the Violet Sky Star Realm."
Soon afterward, disciples from the Black Dragon Clan began entering the enormous vessel one after another.
Meanwhile, just as Max prepared to board as well, his eyes suddenly shifted toward the distance.
There—
Jonathan and Julie could be seen standing quietly far away near another palace platform.
Clearly, the two of them had specifically come there to see him off before his departure.
However, neither Jonathan nor Julie approached directly.
Because with so many people present around the departure area, openly interacting too closely with Max now would only attract unnecessary attention.
Instead, the two of them simply stood silently in the distance.
Then Jonathan lightly nodded toward Max.
Julie also revealed a faint smile afterward.
It was a simple farewell.
Yet all three of them understood clearly that this would not be their final meeting.
Meanwhile, Max also smiled faintly afterward before raising his hand slightly toward the two of them.
A silent goodbye.
Jonathan and Julie quietly watched him afterward while Max finally turned around and entered the enormous star shuttle together with Lucia and Isabella.
Soon afterward—
Boom!!!
The massive star shuttle slowly rose into the sky.
Ancient runes across its surface erupted brilliantly while dense star energy gathered around the vessel continuously.
Then, under the gazes of countless people below, the enormous shuttle accelerated rapidly upward.
Within only a few moments, it pierced through the clouds above the Violet Star Palace completely.
Soon afterward, the gigantic vessel transformed into a streak of light shooting through the endless starry sky before finally disappearing into the distant stars altogether.

chapters.title: Chapter 1684: Useless Skills in the Divine Realm!
paragraphs: The return journey from the Violet Sky Star Realm did not take very long.
Inside the enormous star shuttle, most disciples spent the majority of the trip either cultivating silently or discussing everything that happened during the Smelting Trial.
The atmosphere throughout the vessel remained completely different compared to when they first departed toward the Violet Star Palace.
At that time, everyone had been filled with anticipation and curiosity regarding the Smelting Trial.
But now—
The confidence and mentality of many disciples had changed completely.
After personally witnessing countless geniuses, terrifying battles, and overwhelming talents during the trials, nearly everyone had finally realized how vast the Divine Realm truly was.
Especially after seeing monsters like Max and Ray Willer, many disciples understood very clearly that their current strength was still far from enough.
Because of that, the atmosphere inside the shuttle became unusually focused.
Many disciples were already eager to begin secluded cultivation the moment they returned.
Meanwhile, Max mostly remained inside his room quietly throughout the journey.
Although he occasionally spoke briefly with Lucia and Isabella, most of his time was spent continuing to familiarize himself with the Vein of Speed and stabilizing his recent breakthroughs.
Eventually, after traveling through the endless stars for some time, the enormous star shuttle finally returned once again to the Verdant Sky Star Realm.
Soon afterward, the massive Black Dragon Palace gradually appeared within everyone’s sight.
The moment the disciples saw the enormous palace standing majestically atop the mountains once again, many people immediately revealed emotional expressions.
After all, despite the dangers and opportunities of the Smelting Trial, returning back home still brought a sense of relief.
Boom!!!
The gigantic star shuttle slowly descended before the Black Dragon Palace while countless disciples and elders below looked upward toward it.
Soon afterward, the shuttle finally landed completely.
The moment the disciples stepped outside once again, the elders of the Black Dragon Clan quickly gathered around to question them regarding the Smelting Trial and its results.
However, despite the excitement surrounding the return, almost every disciple shared the same thought now.
Cultivation.
After all, nearly everyone who survived the Smelting Trial had obtained enormous gains.
Some obtained treasures.
Others gained cultivation resources.
A few comprehended stronger concepts through battle.
Meanwhile, individuals like Max had gained opportunities so great that even ordinary geniuses could hardly imagine them.
Because of this, after returning to the Black Dragon Palace, nearly all participating disciples immediately entered seclusion one after another.
No one wanted to waste even a single moment.
The Cosmic Ascension Conference was only three months away now.
And everyone understood very clearly that those three months would likely determine their future standing within the younger generation of the Divine Realm.
Because of that, the entire Black Dragon Palace gradually entered a strange atmosphere afterward.
The disciples who participated in the Smelting Trial almost completely disappeared from public view as they entered closed-door cultivation continuously.
Some secluded themselves to break through their cultivation realms.
Others focused upon mastering new techniques and treasures.
Everyone desperately tried to digest the opportunities they obtained during the Smelting Trial before the Cosmic Ascension Conference finally began three months later.
Max naturally planned to enter seclusion as well after returning to the Black Dragon Palace.

After all, although he had already broken through to the tenth level of the Law Awakening Realm and awakened the Vein of Speed, there were still countless things he needed to stabilize and comprehend further before the Cosmic Ascension Conference began.
However, before he could properly begin secluded cultivation, he suddenly received a summons from Lady Virelia.
Knowing it was his master calling for him, Max naturally did not delay.
Soon afterward, he arrived before Lady Virelia’s office located deep within the Black Dragon Palace.
After entering the room, Max immediately saw Lady Virelia seated calmly behind a large desk while several ancient scrolls floated quietly around the room.
The atmosphere inside the office felt peaceful yet dignified.
The moment Lady Virelia noticed him entering, she lightly nodded toward him.
"Sit down," she said calmly.
Max nodded respectfully afterward before taking a seat directly across from her.
For several moments, Lady Virelia simply observed him silently.
The more she looked at Max now, the more satisfied she became.
His performance during the Smelting Trial had honestly exceeded even her own expectations greatly.
Eventually, she finally spoke.
"The Cosmic Ascension Conference will begin in three months," Lady Virelia said calmly while looking directly toward Max. "How confident are you in entering the top one thousand?"
The moment those words entered his ears, Max almost laughed inwardly.
Top one thousand?
In truth, his own goal had long since surpassed something like that.
Max was aiming for the very peak of the Cosmic Ascension Conference itself.
The top ten.
However, despite those thoughts, Max still remained calm outwardly.
Because he understood very clearly why Lady Virelia viewed things this way.
After all, she still did not know his true strength completely.

To someone like her, merely entering the top one thousand among the countless monstrous geniuses participating in the Cosmic Ascension Conference would already be an astonishing achievement beyond imagination.
Because of that, Max naturally did not blame her for underestimating him.
Instead, he simply smiled faintly afterward.
"I should not have any problems entering the top one thousand," Max replied calmly. "Master does not need to worry too much about me."
Lady Virelia slowly nodded after hearing that response.
Clearly, she was already quite satisfied with his confidence.
Then suddenly, as though recalling something important, her expression became thoughtful afterward.
"Max," she said slowly, "back in the mortal realm where you came from, were there things called skills?"
Max’s eyes flickered slightly after hearing that question.
Then he nodded lightly.
"Yes," he replied honestly. "There were many skills in the mortal world."
A faint nostalgic expression appeared within his eyes briefly afterward.
"However, after ascending to the Divine Realm, most of those skills became practically useless."
Lady Virelia nodded calmly after hearing that.
"That is normal," she explained slowly.
"The so-called skills used in mortal worlds are ultimately powered through mana."
Her gaze gradually became more serious afterward.
"And mana itself is a power system belonging to the mortal realms."
"Because of that, after ascending into the Divine Realm, the strength produced by ordinary skills becomes extremely weak."
Max quietly listened while Lady Virelia continued explaining.

"The biggest issue is that skills are fundamentally designed to operate through mana pathways and mana laws. Even if someone ascends and begins cultivating Divine Essence afterward, the skills themselves still instinctively consume mana instead."
Lady Virelia lightly tapped the desk while continuing.
"And although Divine Essence technically contains traces of mana within it, that tiny amount is insignificant compared to true Divine Essence."
"That is why attempting to use ordinary mortal realm skills inside the Divine Realm becomes nearly pointless."
"No matter how much Divine Essence you possess, the skill itself will still prioritize consuming the mana hidden inside the Divine Essence rather than the Divine Essence directly."
Max slowly nodded afterward.
That explanation immediately made many things clearer for him.
Meanwhile, Lady Virelia continued calmly.
"However..."
A faint thoughtful expression appeared across her face.
"That does not mean the Divine Realm lacks alternatives."
Max’s eyes immediately sharpened slightly after hearing that.
Lady Virelia slowly leaned back in her chair before continuing.
"In the Divine Realm, there exists something far superior to ordinary mortal skills."
"Abilities specifically designed to operate through Divine Essence itself."
Her voice gradually became heavier afterward.
"However, unlike the common skills found throughout mortal worlds, these abilities are extremely rare."
"Not every force in the Divine Realm possesses them."
"In fact, many weaker forces may never even encounter one throughout their entire existence."

chapters.title: Chapter 1685: Divine Ability
paragraphs: After hearing Lady Virelia’s explanation, Max gradually fell into deep thought.
Everything she said immediately caused many things to make sense in his mind.
Back in the mortal world, skills had once been considered extremely important.

However, after ascending into the Divine Realm, Max quickly noticed that almost nobody here relied upon ordinary skills anymore. Instead, cultivators focused almost entirely upon cultivation arts, concepts, laws, bloodlines, physiques, and various inheritances.
At first, Max assumed this was simply because Divine Realm cultivators considered ordinary skills too weak.
But now, after hearing Lady Virelia’s explanation regarding mana and Divine Essence, he finally understood the true reason behind it.
The foundation of ordinary skills themselves simply could not properly support Divine Essence.
Because of that, their strength naturally became insignificant after ascension.
Meanwhile, Max slowly raised his head afterward before asking curiously,
"What exactly are these alternatives called?"
The moment those words were spoken, Lady Virelia’s expression gradually became more serious.
Then she slowly answered,
"They are called Divine Abilities."
The instant Max heard those two words, his eyes suddenly flickered sharply.
Divine Ability.
The name immediately triggered a memory deep within his mind.
Almost instantly, Max recalled the special Divine Ability he had previously obtained from the Chaos Fruit growing upon the flame branch of his Chaos Tree.
Back then, after refining the Chaos Fruit, he had directly awakened a genuine Divine Ability connected to flames.
At that time, Max still did not fully understand the true significance of that power.
However now—
After hearing Lady Virelia explain everything regarding skills and Divine Abilities, Max finally realized just how extraordinary that ability actually was.
Unlike ordinary skills powered through mana, Divine Abilities were powers specifically created to utilize Divine Essence directly.
In other words—
The Divine Ability he obtained from the Chaos Fruit was a true Divine Realm level power.
Meanwhile, Lady Virelia naturally did not know what Max was thinking internally.
She simply continued speaking calmly afterward.
"Divine Abilities are incredibly precious throughout the Divine Realm. Most of them are inherited through bloodlines, ancient inheritances, special physiques, or extremely rare heavenly treasures."
Her gaze slowly focused upon Max afterward.
"And the strength of a Divine Ability is usually far beyond ordinary skills."
Max silently listened while inwardly becoming increasingly thoughtful.
At that moment, he finally began realizing that the Chaos Tree inside him might be even more terrifying than he originally imagined.
Meanwhile, Lady Virelia continued speaking calmly while Max silently listened.
"Divine Abilities themselves are also divided into different ranks," she explained slowly. "The Divine Realm categorizes them from Tier One to Tier Five."
Her expression gradually became more serious afterward.
"The higher the tier, the more terrifying the Divine Ability becomes."
"A Tier One Divine Ability might only grant some basic enhancement or special effect."
"However, once you reach the higher tiers, the abilities become increasingly monstrous."
Lady Virelia’s eyes narrowed faintly afterward.
"Some high-tier Divine Abilities are powerful enough to distort natural laws themselves."
"Others can destroy worlds, erase souls, manipulate dimensions, or overturn the heavens entirely."
The atmosphere inside the room gradually became heavier as she spoke.
"Even among the major powers of the Divine Realm, high-tier Divine Abilities are considered priceless treasures."
Then, after remaining silent briefly, Lady Virelia suddenly waved her hand.
The next moment, a fist-sized golden stone appeared above her palm.

The stone radiated ancient golden light while strange divine runes continuously flowed across its surface. Dense Divine Essence fluctuations spread from it endlessly while even the surrounding space distorted faintly around the stone itself.
The moment Max saw it, his eyes immediately sharpened slightly.
"This..." Max muttered softly.
Lady Virelia slowly looked toward the golden stone before speaking quietly.
"This is a Divine Ability Core Stone."
Her voice carried traces of nostalgia afterward.
"Inside this stone, a complete Divine Ability has been sealed."
The atmosphere inside the office immediately became solemn.
Meanwhile, Lady Virelia calmly continued.
"I obtained this Divine Ability Core Stone many years ago through sheer luck."
Her eyes remained fixed upon the stone while countless emotions flickered within them briefly.
"Since then, I have kept it with me all this time."
A faint bitter smile slowly appeared across her face afterward.
"However, despite possessing it for so many years, I could never fully decide whether I should absorb the Divine Ability for myself or preserve it for a future genius within the Black Dragon Clan."
Lady Virelia slowly raised her gaze toward Max afterward.
"Until I met you."
The moment those words were spoken, Max became slightly stunned.
Meanwhile, Lady Virelia calmly extended the golden stone toward him.
"I have already made my decision."
Her gaze carried complete seriousness now.
"Take this Divine Ability Core Stone."
Max’s expression immediately changed slightly afterward.
However, before he could speak, Lady Virelia continued firmly,
"Among the younger generation of the Black Dragon Clan, nobody possesses greater talent or potential than you."
"If this Divine Ability remains hidden with me any longer, it would simply be wasted."
The golden light emitted by the stone reflected across the room continuously while dense Divine Essence fluctuations spread outward.
Then Lady Virelia spoke the final words calmly.
"Absorb the Divine Ability inside this stone and make it your own."
Max slowly reached out his hand and accepted the golden stone from Lady Virelia.
The moment the Divine Ability Core Stone entered his palm, his expression immediately changed slightly.
An incomparably mysterious feeling instantly spread throughout his entire body.
The golden stone felt strangely alive.

Dense Divine Essence fluctuations continuously flowed from within it while countless ancient runes flickered faintly across its surface like living symbols. Merely holding the stone caused Max to feel an ancient and profound aura surrounding it completely.
At the same time, a strange instinctive feeling suddenly surfaced within Max’s mind.
Crush it.
The moment that thought appeared, Max immediately understood.
The method of inheriting the Divine Ability sealed within the stone was extremely simple.
He simply needed to destroy the Divine Ability Core Stone itself.
Without wasting any time afterward, Max slowly tightened his grip around the golden stone.
Then—
Crack.
The Divine Ability Core Stone shattered instantly within his hand.
The moment the stone broke apart, a dazzling golden light suddenly erupted throughout the entire office.
Boom!!!
A terrifying wave of Divine Essence fluctuations spread outward while the shattered fragments of the stone instantly transformed into a massive beam of golden light.
Before Max could even properly react, the golden beam shot directly toward him and entered straight into his forehead.
The next instant—
Max’s entire consciousness trembled violently.
Countless streams of information suddenly exploded throughout his mind like a raging flood.
Ancient symbols.
Mysterious laws.
Complex Divine Essence circulation pathways.
All of them continuously poured into Max’s consciousness one after another at astonishing speed.
At the same time, Max immediately felt a completely new power gradually forming deep within his body.
It was fundamentally different from cultivation arts or ordinary techniques.
This power felt far more mysterious.
Far more profound.
And far more terrifying.

chapters.title: Chapter 1686: Star Fist!
paragraphs: Meanwhile, Lady Virelia silently watched everything from nearby without interrupting him.
Clearly, the inheritance process had already begun successfully.
Inside Max’s mind, the enormous amount of information gradually began organizing itself automatically.
Soon afterward, several ancient golden words slowly appeared clearly within his consciousness.
[Tier 3 Divine Ability: Star Fist]
The moment Max saw those words, his pupils contracted sharply.
Then, more information rapidly surfaced afterward.
Star Fist.
A Divine Ability capable of condensing the power of stars directly into one’s fists.
The stronger the user’s Divine Essence and physical body became, the more terrifying the destructive power of the Star Fist would grow.
At higher mastery levels, every punch could contain the weight and explosive force of collapsing stars themselves.
The information flooding through Max’s mind continued increasing afterward.
The Divine Ability did not merely strengthen punches normally.
Instead, it transformed the fists themselves into vessels capable of channeling pure stellar destruction.
The moment Star Fist was activated, Divine Essence would condense into miniature star-like cores inside the fists before exploding outward upon impact with terrifying destructive force.
The more Max understood the Divine Ability, the more shocked he became internally.
Because this Divine Ability—
Was perfectly compatible with his terrifying physical body.
Especially now that he possessed five thousand Draconic Essences, the Vein of Strength, and the newly awakened Vein of Speed.
If those powers were combined together with the Star Fist—
Even Max himself could already vaguely imagine how horrifying the result would become.

The moment he opened them, a faint golden light briefly flashed through his pupils before disappearing completely.
Lady Virelia, who had been quietly observing everything from nearby, immediately looked toward him afterward.
"What Divine Ability did you obtain?" she asked calmly, although curiosity was clearly visible within her eyes.
After all, even she herself had never known what exact Divine Ability was sealed inside that Core Stone all these years.
Max slowly stood up afterward before answering honestly.
"It is called Tier 3 Divine Ability called Star Fist."
The moment those words entered her ears, Lady Virelia’s expression immediately changed slightly.
"Star Fist?" she repeated softly.
Then, after briefly sensing the aura surrounding Max now, she suddenly let out a slow breath of relief.
A faint smile gradually appeared across her face afterward.
"It seems I truly made the correct choice by giving that Divine Ability Core Stone to you," she said calmly.
Max looked slightly curious after hearing that.
Meanwhile, Lady Virelia slowly shook her head lightly before continuing.
"Star Fist is clearly a Divine Ability designed specifically for close combat physical fighters."
Her gaze slowly swept across Max’s body afterward.
"The stronger the physical body, the more terrifying the Divine Ability becomes."
Then she sighed softly afterward.
"If I had absorbed that Divine Ability for myself years ago, it would likely have been wasted completely."
A faint helpless smile appeared across her face.
"After all, I was never a close combat cultivator."
"My fighting style has always focused more upon long-range Divine Essence techniques and battlefield control."
Lady Virelia then looked directly toward Max once again.
"But you are different."
Her eyes gradually brightened slightly afterward.
"With your monstrous physical body, and the terrifying close combat abilities you already possess..."
A faint look of anticipation appeared within her eyes.
"The Star Fist Divine Ability will become far more terrifying in your hands than it ever could have in mine."
Hearing that, even Max himself slowly nodded internally.
He could already vaguely feel it as well.
The Star Fist Divine Ability truly suited him perfectly.
After sensing the terrifying potential hidden within the Star Fist Divine Ability, Max slowly raised his head toward Lady Virelia once again.
Genuine gratitude could clearly be seen within his eyes now.
"Thank you, Master," Max said seriously. "This Divine Ability is far too valuable."
He understood very clearly just how precious something like a Divine Ability truly was within the Divine Realm.
Even major powers treated such things as priceless inheritances.
Yet Lady Virelia had willingly handed the Divine Ability Core Stone over to him without hesitation.
Meanwhile, Lady Virelia simply waved her hand lightly afterward.
"There is no need to thank me for something like this," she replied calmly.
A faint smile gradually appeared across her face afterward.
"If a treasure is simply left unused forever, then it has no meaning."
Her gaze slowly focused upon Max once again.
"And compared to me, you clearly possess far greater potential."
Then her expression gradually became thoughtful afterward.
"Besides..."
A strange light flashed briefly within her eyes.
"There is actually a possibility that you may obtain even more Divine Abilities during the Cosmic Ascension Conference."
The moment those words entered his ears, Max’s expression immediately changed completely.
"What?" Max asked instinctively.
Even he could not completely hide the shock within his voice this time.
After all, based on everything Lady Virelia explained earlier, Divine Abilities were supposed to be extremely rare treasures throughout the Divine Realm.
Yet now—
She was saying he might actually obtain more of them during the Cosmic Ascension Conference?
Meanwhile, seeing Max’s reaction, Lady Virelia smiled faintly afterward.
"It is not impossible," she explained calmly.
"The Cosmic Ascension Conference is far more extraordinary than you currently imagine."
Her eyes gradually became deeper afterward.
"That place gathers not only countless monstrous geniuses but also unimaginable inheritances, opportunities, treasures, and ancient legacies left behind by terrifying existences from countless eras."
Lady Virelia slowly leaned back in her chair while continuing.
"Throughout history, there have been people who obtained Divine Abilities during the Cosmic Ascension Conference."
"Some inherited them from ancient ruins."
"Others awakened them through inheritances."
"And a few lucky monsters directly obtained Divine Ability Core Stones themselves."
The more Max listened, the more serious his expression gradually became.
At that moment, he finally began realizing once again just how enormous and terrifying the Cosmic Ascension Conference truly was.
Meanwhile, Lady Virelia calmly looked toward him before speaking once more.
"That is why the Cosmic Ascension Conference is viewed as the greatest opportunity for the younger generation throughout the Divine Realm."
Then a faint smile slowly appeared across her face afterward.
"And with your talent..."
Her eyes narrowed slightly.
"You may very well become one of the greatest beneficiaries there."

chapters.title: Chapter 1687: Three Months of More Training!
paragraphs: After hearing everything regarding the Cosmic Ascension Conference and the possibilities hidden within it, Max’s eyes gradually became brighter and brighter.
At that moment, even his anticipation toward the conference itself increased tremendously.
Divine Abilities.
Ancient inheritances.
Countless monstrous geniuses.
The Cosmic Ascension Conference was clearly far more extraordinary than he initially imagined.
Meanwhile, Max slowly looked toward Lady Virelia once again before speaking seriously,
"I will do my best during the Cosmic Ascension Conference."
A sharp determination gradually appeared within his eyes afterward.
"And I will not disappoint you, Master."
The confidence within his voice was extremely obvious.
After everything he had gained recently, Max’s ambitions toward the Cosmic Ascension Conference had already risen far beyond simply entering the top one thousand.
He wanted to stand at the very peak.
Meanwhile, after hearing his response, Lady Virelia slowly nodded in satisfaction.
A faint smile appeared across her face afterward.
"Good," she replied calmly.
Then her gaze slowly shifted toward Max’s fists briefly before continuing,
"Since you have already inherited the Star Fist Divine Ability, you should focus properly on mastering it before the Cosmic Ascension Conference begins."
Her expression gradually became more serious afterward.
"Divine Abilities are not ordinary techniques. Even if you inherit them successfully, fully mastering them still requires tremendous practice and comprehension."
Lady Virelia then added calmly,
"Especially for a close combat Divine Ability like Star Fist, compatibility with your physical body and battle instincts will matter greatly."
A faint meaningful look appeared within her eyes afterward.
"But considering your monstrous physique, I believe this Divine Ability will suit you perfectly."
Max nodded seriously after hearing that.
Naturally, he also understood how important it was to familiarize himself with the Star Fist Divine Ability before the conference began.
The stronger he became beforehand, the greater his chances would be during the Cosmic Ascension Conference.
Eventually, Lady Virelia lightly waved her hand afterward.
"Alright," she said calmly. "You may leave now."
"Use the remaining three months wisely."
Max slowly stood up afterward before respectfully bowing lightly toward her once again.
Then, without wasting any further time, he turned around and left Lady Virelia’s office completely.
At that moment, only a single thought remained within his mind.
He needed to master the Star Fist Divine Ability before the Cosmic Ascension Conference finally began.
After returning back to his room, Max did not waste even a single moment.
The instant he entered the training chamber once again, he immediately activated the Dimensional Sovereign Body.
Space distorted faintly around him while dense dimensional fluctuations spread throughout the room.
The next moment, Max directly entered the Dimension of Time.
Since there were still three entire months remaining before the Cosmic Ascension Conference officially began, Max naturally had no intention of wasting such precious time.
The moment he entered the endless training world inside the Dimension of Time, the atmosphere around him instantly became incomparably solemn.
Everything afterward revolved around cultivation and training.
Max began spending nearly all of his time inside the Dimension of Time continuously mastering everything he had recently obtained.
The Star Fist Divine Ability.
The Saint Origin Sword Art.
The Vein of Speed.
The newly reached tenth level of the Law Awakening Realm.
And even the power of the Dimension of Soul.
Every single one of those powers required enormous amounts of practice and comprehension before they could truly become part of Max’s combat strength completely.
Because of that, Max practically isolated himself inside the Dimension of Time entirely.
Days passed outside.
Meanwhile, inside the Dimension of Time, far greater amounts of time continuously flowed by.
Boom!!!
Again and again, terrifying shockwaves echoed throughout the endless training world.

Sometimes Max practiced the Star Fist Divine Ability endlessly while condensing terrifying stellar power into his fists. Every punch caused the surrounding space to tremble violently while star-like explosions erupted throughout the Dimension of Time continuously.

Other times, he combined the Vein of Speed with the Saint Origin Sword Art, causing countless afterimages to appear throughout the training grounds while sword light split apart the surrounding world at terrifying speed.
Occasionally, Max also entered deep meditation while comprehending the mysteries of the Dimension of Soul and stabilizing his newly strengthened soul force.
Almost all of his time was spent training relentlessly.
However, despite focusing so heavily upon cultivation, Max still did not completely isolate himself from everyone else.
From time to time, he would temporarily leave the Dimension of Time and head toward the Dimension of Genesis.
There, he would spend some peaceful time together with Alice and Lenavira.
Sometimes they simply ate dinner together quietly.
Other times Alice endlessly complained about how boring cultivation was while Lenavira calmly listened nearby with a faint smile on her face.
Those moments became one of the few peaceful breaks Max allowed himself during those intense months of cultivation.
Meanwhile, Jonathan, Julie, and Isabella also occasionally entered the Dimension of Genesis throughout those three months.
The Crown itself gradually began developing slowly from the shadows.
Jonathan and Julie occasionally reported new information regarding possible future recruits while Isabella continuously expanded and improved the secret domain itself.
Whenever necessary, Max would briefly leave the Dimension of Time to meet with them and discuss matters regarding the Crown.
However, aside from those occasional meetings and brief moments spent together with Alice and Lenavira—
Max spent nearly all remaining time cultivating endlessly inside the Dimension of Time.
The closer the Cosmic Ascension Conference approached, the more terrifying Max’s training gradually became.
Time passed quietly.
Inside the Black Dragon Palace, nearly all disciples who participated in the Smelting Trial remained in closed-door cultivation continuously throughout those three months.
The atmosphere across the entire clan gradually became increasingly tense as the date of the Cosmic Ascension Conference drew closer and closer.
Everyone understood very clearly—
The coming conference would determine the future fate of countless geniuses throughout the Divine Realm.
Meanwhile, during those three months, Max almost completely disappeared from public sight.
Very few people within the Black Dragon Clan actually saw him during that period.
Most only occasionally heard terrifying shockwaves erupting from the training areas assigned to him or sensed frightening soul fluctuations spreading from his residence from time to time.
Inside the Dimension of Time, however—
An enormous amount of time had already passed for Max.
During those months, his strength continuously improved at a terrifying pace.

chapters.title: Chapter 1688: Day of the Cosmic Ascension Conference!
paragraphs: The Star Fist Divine Ability gradually became increasingly mastered under his relentless training. By the end of those months, every punch Max unleashed carried terrifying stellar force capable of distorting the surrounding space itself.

The Vein of Speed also became completely integrated into his combat style. His movements had become so fast that ordinary cultivators at the same level could no longer properly follow his figure with their eyes.
Meanwhile, his comprehension of the Saint Origin Sword Art deepened continuously as well.
At times, Max remained inside the Dimension of Time for what felt like years entirely focused upon a single sword movement or a single circulation pathway of the Star Fist Divine Ability.
The closer the Cosmic Ascension Conference approached, the more terrifying his aura gradually became.
At the same time, the Crown also slowly continued developing quietly within the shadows.
Jonathan and Julie successfully brought several trustworthy individuals into contact with the organization while Isabella continued expanding the Dimension of Genesis steadily.
Although the Crown remained extremely small compared to the major powers of the Divine Realm, its foundations had finally begun forming properly.
And then—
Before anyone truly realized it—
Three entire months passed by in what felt like the blink of an eye.
Finally—
The day of the Cosmic Ascension Conference arrived.
On that day, the atmosphere throughout the entire Black Dragon Palace completely changed.
Countless disciples and elders gathered together while enormous excitement and tension filled the surroundings completely.
Even the sky above the clan seemed unusually solemn.
Because everyone knew—
The greatest gathering of geniuses within the Divine Realm was finally about to begin.
Max finally left the Dimension of Time after completing another long session of cultivation.
The moment he stepped back into reality, the terrifying aura surrounding him gradually calmed once again. However, compared to three months ago, the current Max felt vastly different.
His Divine Essence had become incomparably denser.
The pressure released unconsciously from his body had also become much heavier.
Most importantly—
His eyes themselves now carried a faint sharpness capable of making ordinary cultivators feel pressure instinctively merely by looking at him.
After stabilizing his aura briefly, Max once again entered the Dimension of Genesis.
Since the Cosmic Ascension Conference was finally about to begin, he wanted to meet Alice and Lenavira one final time before departing.
Soon afterward, Max arrived at the living area inside the Dimension of Genesis where the two of them were staying.
The moment Alice noticed him approaching, her eyes immediately brightened.
"You finally came out of training again," she complained while quickly walking toward him. "At this point I was starting to think you planned to stay inside the Dimension of Time forever."
Meanwhile, Lenavira also smiled gently afterward while looking toward Max quietly.
Compared to before, even the two of them could clearly sense how much stronger Max had become during these three months.
Max chuckled lightly after hearing Alice complain once again.
"The Cosmic Ascension Conference is finally starting," he replied calmly. "Naturally, I had to prepare properly."
Then a faint smile slowly appeared across his face afterward.
"Actually, I came here today because I want the two of you to meet several special individuals."
The moment those words were spoken, Alice immediately became curious again.
"Special individuals?" she repeated quickly.
Even Lenavira looked toward Max with slight interest afterward.
Max nodded lightly.
"They are people I care for them the most these days."
His eyes gradually became more thoughtful afterward.
"They will become very important to us in the future."
Alice immediately narrowed her eyes suspiciously afterward.
"Are these the same mysterious people you kept refusing to tell us about before?" she asked quickly.
Max only smiled calmly afterward.
"You will know soon enough."
Alice immediately pouted again after hearing that answer.
"You really enjoy keeping secrets," she muttered unhappily.
Meanwhile, Lenavira quietly smiled from the side while observing the two of them.
Clearly, she already understood that Max intentionally wanted the meeting itself to become a surprise.
A faint smile slowly appeared across Max’s face afterward.
"Come with me," he said calmly while looking toward Alice and Lenavira.
The two of them immediately became curious after hearing that.
However, before either of them could ask further questions, Max suddenly raised both hands and lightly touched their shoulders.
The next instant—
Space around them distorted violently.
Dense dimensional fluctuations erupted instantly while countless silver-blue runes spread throughout the surroundings.
Then—
The surrounding world disappeared completely.
Alice and Lenavira immediately felt the space around their bodies shifting rapidly as though they were crossing through countless layers of dimensions at once.
Only a brief moment later—
The distortion finally stopped.
And the three of them appeared inside an entirely different world.
The moment Alice and Lenavira opened their eyes fully afterward, both of them became completely stunned.
"This..." Alice muttered blankly.
Even Lenavira’s calm expression visibly froze slightly.
Because the world before them looked absolutely magical.
The sky above shimmered with countless streams of colorful spiritual light while enormous floating islands drifted peacefully throughout the heavens one after another.
Some islands were covered in vast forests glowing faintly with spiritual energy.
Others contained waterfalls flowing directly through the sky itself before scattering into glowing mist beneath the floating lands.
Countless spirit birds flew freely throughout the heavens while dense spiritual energy filled every corner of the world so heavily that merely breathing felt refreshing.
Massive spirit trees towered throughout the distant islands while rivers of pure spiritual energy flowed through portions of the world like glowing silver streams.
The entire Dimension of Spirit resembled a divine paradise existing beyond reality itself.
At that moment, even Alice completely forgot how to speak properly for several seconds.
"This place..." she muttered while staring around in disbelief. "What exactly is this place?!"
Meanwhile, Lenavira’s eyes continuously swept across the floating islands and endless spiritual scenery around them while shock filled her gaze completely.
Even she had never seen a world this beautiful before.
The dense spiritual energy present here alone far surpassed most cultivation holy lands.
Then suddenly, Alice pointed upward excitedly.
"There are islands floating in the sky!"
Her voice carried complete astonishment.
"And look over there! Even the waterfalls are floating!"
Meanwhile, Max simply smiled faintly while observing their reactions quietly.
Clearly, he already expected them to react this way.
After all, the Dimension of Spirit truly looked like a fantasy world created from dreams itself.

His eyes gradually became more thoughtful afterward.
"They will become very important to us in the future."
Alice immediately narrowed her eyes suspiciously afterward.
"Are these the same mysterious people you kept refusing to tell us about before?" she asked quickly.
Max only smiled calmly afterward.
"You will know soon enough."
Alice immediately pouted again after hearing that answer.
"You really enjoy keeping secrets," she muttered unhappily.
Meanwhile, Lenavira quietly smiled from the side while observing the two of them.
Clearly, she already understood that Max intentionally wanted the meeting itself to become a surprise.
A faint smile slowly appeared across Max’s face afterward.
"Come with me," he said calmly while looking toward Alice and Lenavira.
The two of them immediately became curious after hearing that.
However, before either of them could ask further questions, Max suddenly raised both hands and lightly touched their shoulders.
The next instant—
Space around them distorted violently.
Dense dimensional fluctuations erupted instantly while countless silver-blue runes spread throughout the surroundings.
Then—
The surrounding world disappeared completely.
Alice and Lenavira immediately felt the space around their bodies shifting rapidly as though they were crossing through countless layers of dimensions at once.
Only a brief moment later—
The distortion finally stopped.
And the three of them appeared inside an entirely different world.
The moment Alice and Lenavira opened their eyes fully afterward, both of them became completely stunned.
"This..." Alice muttered blankly.
Even Lenavira’s calm expression visibly froze slightly.
Because the world before them looked absolutely magical.
The sky above shimmered with countless streams of colorful spiritual light while enormous floating islands drifted peacefully throughout the heavens one after another.
Some islands were covered in vast forests glowing faintly with spiritual energy.
Others contained waterfalls flowing directly through the sky itself before scattering into glowing mist beneath the floating lands.
Countless spirit birds flew freely throughout the heavens while dense spiritual energy filled every corner of the world so heavily that merely breathing felt refreshing.
Massive spirit trees towered throughout the distant islands while rivers of pure spiritual energy flowed through portions of the world like glowing silver streams.
The entire Dimension of Spirit resembled a divine paradise existing beyond reality itself.
At that moment, even Alice completely forgot how to speak properly for several seconds.
"This place..." she muttered while staring around in disbelief.
"What exactly is this place?!"
Meanwhile, Lenavira’s eyes continuously swept across the floating islands and endless spiritual scenery around them while shock filled her gaze completely.
Even she had never seen a world this beautiful before.
The dense spiritual energy present here alone far surpassed most cultivation holy lands.
Then suddenly, Alice pointed upward excitedly.
"There are islands floating in the sky!"
Her voice carried complete astonishment.
"And look over there!
Even the waterfalls are floating!"
Meanwhile, Max simply smiled faintly while observing their reactions quietly.
Clearly, he already expected them to react this way.
After all, the Dimension of Spirit truly looked like a fantasy world created from dreams itself.

chapters.title: Chapter 1689: Cute Vormir!
paragraphs: Meanwhile, as Alice and Lenavira were still staring around the magical Dimension of Spirit in complete shock, several figures suddenly began approaching rapidly from the distance.
The first thing Alice noticed was a small black dragon flying proudly through the air.

The little dragon possessed glossy black scales that reflected faint purple light beneath the sky while tiny horns curved slightly upward atop his head. His movements carried obvious arrogance while his tiny chest remained puffed up proudly the entire time.
Behind him floated a small red-haired girl who looked around five years old.

Her crimson hair fluttered gently behind her while her large bright eyes radiated pure innocence and curiosity. The little girl wore a beautiful white dress while dense spiritual energy unconsciously flowed around her body continuously.
At the same time, another spirit floated calmly nearby.

Unlike the red-haired little girl, this spirit appeared older, around ten years old. She possessed long silver-black hair and deep dark eyes while strange devouring aura occasionally flickered around her quietly.
The moment Alice and Lenavira saw the three approaching, both immediately became stunned again.
However—
The instant the red-haired little girl noticed Max, her eyes immediately brightened.
"Father!"
The little girl instantly rushed toward Max happily before directly hugging him tightly.
The moment Alice and Lenavira heard that word, both of them froze completely.
"Father?" Alice repeated blankly while staring at Max.
Even Lenavira looked genuinely shocked now.
Meanwhile, Max himself coughed awkwardly afterward.
"Yes... there is a reason for that," he muttered helplessly.
However, before he could explain properly, Alice immediately narrowed her eyes suspiciously.
"A reason?" she repeated slowly. "You suddenly have a child now and you are saying there is a reason?"
Meanwhile, the little red-haired girl tilted her head cutely afterward while hugging Max tightly.
Max immediately sighed afterward before beginning his explanation.
"Lily is not actually my daughter," he said helplessly. "She is a spirit."
Then he lightly patted the little girl’s head while continuing.
"She was born from my blood and spiritual origin, so she naturally formed a connection with me."
Max’s expression became increasingly awkward afterward.
"That is why she calls me father."
Alice and Lenavira slowly blinked afterward while processing that explanation.
Meanwhile, Lily continued clinging happily to Max without caring about the situation at all.
Then suddenly, Max remembered something else.
"Actually..." he muttered awkwardly, "when she was first born, she did not call me father."
Alice immediately became curious again.
"Then what did she call you?"
Max’s face twitched slightly afterward.
"She called me mother."
The moment those words fell—
Alice instantly burst into laughter.
"Hahahaha!"
Even Lenavira, who normally remained calm and graceful, could not stop herself from laughing softly afterward.
The image of Max being called "mother" by a little spirit was simply too ridiculous.
Meanwhile, Max himself looked completely helpless.
"It was not my fault," he muttered defensively. "She had just been born at that time."
Meanwhile, Lily tilted her head innocently afterward.
"Father, who are these two?" she asked curiously while looking toward Alice and Lenavira.
The moment she asked that, Max casually replied without thinking too much.
"They are your two future mothers."
Silence instantly fell afterward.
Then—
Lily’s eyes immediately brightened completely.
"Mothers!"
Before Alice and Lenavira could react properly, Lily instantly rushed toward them happily.
Alice immediately became flustered afterward.
"W-Wait—!"
Meanwhile, Lenavira’s face also became slightly red unexpectedly.
However, Lily completely ignored their reactions while hugging both of them happily.
"Mothers!" she repeated excitedly once again.
Meanwhile, while all attention completely focused upon Lily, the little black dragon nearby gradually became dissatisfied.
The proud little dragon immediately puffed out his chest proudly afterward before flying directly before Alice and Lenavira.
"Ahem!"
He deliberately coughed loudly while spreading his tiny wings arrogantly.
Clearly, he was trying very hard to attract their attention as well.
After all, he considered himself extremely majestic and handsome.
Surely these two women would immediately praise him afterward.
However—
Neither Alice nor Lenavira even looked at him.
Both remained completely focused upon the adorable Lily instead.
"Awww, she is too cute..."
Alice muttered while patting Lily’s head happily.
Meanwhile, Lenavira gently smiled while speaking softly to the little spirit as well.
The little black dragon froze completely afterward.
Then his expression instantly darkened.
He immediately flew around them several times dramatically while releasing tiny draconic roars proudly.
Still—
Nobody paid attention to him.
At that moment, the little dragon finally became completely devastated.
"Big Brother Max!"
Vormir immediately flew toward Max afterward while shouting angrily.
"They are ignoring me!"
His tiny dragon face looked completely aggrieved.
"I am clearly much cooler than Lily!"
Meanwhile, Max almost laughed seeing the little dragon’s devastated expression.
However, before he could say anything, Alice casually replied while continuing to play with Lily,
"You are cute too."
The moment those words entered Vormir’s ears, the little black dragon froze again.
Cute?
Not majestic?
Not mighty?
Cute?
At that moment, Vormir looked completely heartbroken.
Meanwhile, the atmosphere throughout the Dimension of Spirit gradually became increasingly lively afterward.
Lily remained completely attached to Alice and Lenavira almost instantly as though she had already known them for years.
The little spirit continuously talked excitedly while holding both of their hands happily.
"Mother Alice, your hair is really pretty!"
"And Mother Lenavira smells really nice too!"
The innocent words coming from Lily immediately caused both Alice and Lenavira to become slightly embarrassed once again.
Especially every single time Lily called them "mother."
Meanwhile, Alice eventually gave up trying to correct her entirely.
Instead, she simply sighed helplessly while patting Lily’s head affectionately.
"You really are too adorable," Alice muttered while smiling brightly.
Meanwhile, Lenavira’s usually calm expression had also softened greatly.
The gentle way Lily clung to them made it genuinely difficult not to become fond of her almost immediately.
Soon afterward, the three of them gradually began chatting happily together.
Lily excitedly explained countless random things about the Dimension of Spirit while continuously dragging Alice and Lenavira around energetically.
At one moment, she proudly introduced the floating islands.
The next moment, she talked about spirit rivers and magical fruits growing throughout the Dimension of Spirit.
Meanwhile, Alice and Lenavira listened patiently while occasionally laughing at Lily’s endless excitement.
The entire scene felt unusually warm and peaceful.
However—
Not far away—
A certain proud little black dragon sat completely alone atop a floating rock.
Vormir looked utterly devastated.
His tiny dragon wings drooped lifelessly while he stared toward the happily chatting group with a deeply wounded expression.
"They completely ignored me..." he muttered heartbrokenly.
At that moment, the proud little dragon genuinely could not understand reality anymore.
Clearly, he was majestic.
Clearly, he was cool.
Clearly, he was a mighty black dragon.
So why—
Why was all attention focused entirely upon Lily instead?
Meanwhile, the conversation between Alice, Lenavira, and Lily only became increasingly lively.
"Mother Alice, Father is actually really boring when he trains," Lily whispered secretly.
Alice immediately laughed afterward.
"I can already tell."
Meanwhile, Lenavira smiled softly while asking Lily more questions about life inside the Dimension of Spirit.
Not a single person remembered Vormir still existed nearby.
The little dragon immediately became even more depressed afterward.
Then finally—
Unable to endure it anymore—
Vormir slowly turned toward Max nearby with an aggrieved expression.
"Big Brother Max..." he muttered weakly.
His tiny dragon eyes looked almost ready to cry.
"They do not appreciate dragons at all."
Meanwhile, Max finally could not hold back his laughter anymore after seeing Vormir’s utterly defeated appearance.

chapters.title: Chapter 1690: A Small Gathering!
paragraphs: A faint smile slowly appeared across Max’s face while quietly watching the lively scene before him.
Alice and Lenavira had already completely become immersed in playing together with Lily and Mimi.

Meanwhile, Mimi, who normally remained calm and somewhat distant, had also gradually relaxed around the two of them. Although she still spoke far less compared to Lily, even she occasionally revealed faint smiles while talking with Alice and Lenavira.
The peaceful atmosphere throughout the floating islands felt unusually warm.
For a brief moment, Max simply stood there quietly while watching them.
Then eventually, he slowly spoke once again.
"There is actually something important I should tell the two of you."
The moment those words entered their ears, Alice and Lenavira both looked toward him curiously.
Meanwhile, Lily remained sitting happily beside Alice while Mimi quietly floated nearby.
Max calmly continued afterward.
"I already connected the Dimension of Genesis with the Dimension of Spirit."
The moment those words were spoken, both Alice and Lenavira became slightly surprised.
Max then explained further.
"From now onward, the two of you can freely move between both dimensions whenever you want."
His gaze slowly swept across the surroundings afterward.
"If you become bored staying in one place, you may simply travel to the other dimension freely."
A faint smile appeared across his face afterward.
"There are no restrictions anymore."
After hearing that explanation, Alice’s eyes immediately brightened.
"Really?" she asked excitedly.
Clearly, she was extremely happy hearing that.
Meanwhile, Lenavira also nodded lightly afterward.
"That will make things much easier," she said softly.
Then Alice suddenly waved her hand dismissively toward Max afterward.
"Alright, alright," she said while shooing him away jokingly. "Now stop worrying about us so much."
Her expression gradually became more serious afterward.
"You should focus properly on the Cosmic Ascension Conference instead."
Meanwhile, Lenavira also looked toward him calmly before nodding gently.
"She is right," Lenavira said softly. "You have already prepared for this conference for a very long time."
Her eyes gradually softened afterward.
"So do not waste your attention worrying about us here."
Lily immediately nodded seriously afterward as well.
"Father must become super strong!" she declared confidently.
Even Mimi quietly nodded in agreement nearby.
Seeing all of them looking toward him like that, Max could not help but smile faintly once again.
At that moment, the warm atmosphere inside the Dimension of Spirit quietly eased much of the pressure buried deep within his heart before the coming Cosmic Ascension Conference.
Max quietly looked toward the four of them for several moments afterward.
Alice.
Lenavira.
Lily.
Mimi.
And even the still somewhat depressed Vormir sitting nearby.
A faint warmth gradually spread through his heart while watching the peaceful scene before him.
Then eventually, Max slowly nodded.
"I understand," he said calmly.
A sharp yet confident light gradually appeared within his eyes afterward.
"I will do my best during the Cosmic Ascension Conference."
His voice was not loud, yet it carried unquestionable determination.
After all, the Cosmic Ascension Conference was not merely an opportunity for him anymore.
It was the beginning of everything.
The beginning of his rise within the Divine Realm.
The beginning of the Crown’s future.
And the beginning of the path that would eventually lead him toward the Elf Race and the truth regarding his parents.
Meanwhile, after hearing his response, Alice smiled brightly afterward.
"That is more like it," she said proudly.
Lenavira also gently nodded while looking toward him quietly.
Meanwhile, Lily immediately raised her tiny fist excitedly.
"Father will definitely become the strongest!" she declared confidently.
Even Mimi softly nodded from the side in agreement.
As for Vormir—
The little black dragon finally regained some of his spirit afterward.
"Hmph," he muttered proudly while lifting his head again. "Big Brother Max naturally cannot lose to anyone."
Hearing that, Max could not help but chuckle lightly.
Then, after one final glance toward everyone, Max slowly turned around.
The next moment, dimensional fluctuations quietly spread around his body.
Before leaving completely, Max spoke one final sentence calmly.
"Wait for me to return."
Soon afterward, his figure gradually disappeared from the Dimension of Spirit altogether, leaving behind the peaceful floating world once again.
Once Max left the Dimension of Spirit, he directly returned back to his residence inside the Black Dragon Palace.
The moment he stepped outside his house, he immediately noticed that the atmosphere throughout the palace had become completely different compared to before.
Almost all disciples of the Black Dragon Palace had already gathered together within the enormous hall outside the residential area.
The expressions on everyone’s faces carried obvious excitement, nervousness, and anticipation.
After all—
Today was finally the day the Cosmic Ascension Conference would officially begin.
Meanwhile, many disciples also quickly noticed Max’s arrival.
The moment they sensed the terrifying aura unconsciously leaking from his body, numerous people immediately revealed solemn expressions.
Clearly, after three months of secluded cultivation, Max had become even more frightening than before.
At the same time, Lucia and Isabella also arrived nearby shortly afterward.
Then suddenly—
A terrifying pressure descended throughout the entire hall.
Boom!!!
The surrounding air trembled faintly while countless disciples instinctively straightened their backs.
The next moment, a tall middle-aged man slowly descended from the sky before everyone.
The man possessed sharp eyes and an imposing aura while terrifying Divine Essence fluctuations surrounded him naturally.
The moment many disciples saw him, their expressions immediately became respectful.
One of the Seven Family Heads of the Black Dragon Clan.
Mathew Grimes.
At that moment, Mathew Grimes calmly swept his gaze across the gathered disciples before speaking slowly.
"The Cosmic Ascension Conference is finally beginning."
His deep voice echoed clearly throughout the enormous hall.
The expressions of countless disciples immediately became serious afterward.
Meanwhile, Mathew Grimes continued calmly,
"All of you standing here are the younger generation geniuses selected by the Black Dragon Clan to participate in the greatest gathering within the Divine Realm."
His sharp gaze slowly swept across everyone afterward.
"The conference this time will determine not only your personal future but also the future standing and reputation of our Black Dragon Clan."
The atmosphere throughout the hall gradually became increasingly solemn.
Then Mathew Grimes suddenly added something else.
"Naturally, the clan will not treat your efforts unfairly."
The moment those words were spoken, many disciples immediately focused their attention completely upon him.
"The better your ranking during the Cosmic Ascension Conference, the greater the rewards you will receive afterward from the Black Dragon Clan."
A faint pressure gradually spread from his body afterward.
"If anyone manages to achieve an extraordinary ranking, the clan will reward that person heavily."
The moment those words entered everyone’s ears, many disciples immediately became excited.
After all, rewards from one of the Seven Families of the Black Dragon Clan would naturally not be ordinary.
Meanwhile, Max silently listened from the side calmly.
Then Mathew Grimes eventually continued explaining the conference itself.
"The Cosmic Ascension Conference will be held inside the Eternal Hourglass."
The moment those words were spoken, many disciples immediately became attentive again.
"Once all participating geniuses throughout the Divine Realm gather within the Eternal Hourglass, the conference itself will officially begin."
Then Mathew Grimes calmly looked toward everyone once again.
"As for what all of you need to do now, it is simple."
His voice remained calm yet authoritative.

"Once all participating geniuses throughout the Divine Realm gather within the Eternal Hourglass, the conference itself will officially begin."
Then Mathew Grimes calmly looked toward everyone once again.
"As for what all of you need to do now, it is simple."
His voice remained calm yet authoritative.

chapters.title: Chapter 1691: Start of the Cosmic Ascension Conference!
paragraphs: "You will head toward your assigned houses of lodging and remain there quietly."
"There is no need for anyone to move around recklessly."
"When the Cosmic Ascension Conference officially begins..."
A faint mysterious look appeared within his eyes afterward.
"You will naturally know what to do."
After Mathew Grimes finished speaking, the enormous hall gradually became noisy once again.
Clearly, many disciples still looked confused after hearing his explanation regarding the Cosmic Ascension Conference.
Remain inside their residences?
And simply wait there?
How exactly were they supposed to participate in the conference like that?
Numerous disciples quietly began discussing among themselves afterward while slowly leaving the hall one after another.
"I still do not understand this at all," one disciple muttered with a frown. "How are we supposed to participate in the Cosmic Ascension Conference by staying inside our lodgings?"
Another disciple nearby also nodded helplessly afterward.
"Exactly. I originally thought we would directly enter the Eternal Hourglass somehow."
"Maybe the Eternal Hourglass itself will summon everyone automatically once the conference begins?" someone else guessed uncertainly.
"That should not be impossible," another disciple added thoughtfully. "After all, that treasure is one of the legendary Five Primal Treasures."
Meanwhile, several younger disciples looked increasingly nervous the more they talked.
"I heard trillions of geniuses participate in every Cosmic Ascension Conference."
"Forget trillions," another disciple muttered bitterly. "I am more worried about surviving at all after hearing about the monsters participating from the higher realms."
"I just hope I can survive long enough to gain some opportunities."
Various similar conversations continuously spread throughout the surroundings as disciples slowly returned toward their assigned residences.
Meanwhile, Max quietly walked away from the hall together with Lucia and Isabella.
The atmosphere around the three of them remained much calmer compared to the noisy discussions nearby.
After walking silently for some time, Max eventually looked toward the two women beside him before speaking calmly,
"Do your best during the Cosmic Ascension Conference."
His expression gradually became more serious afterward.
"This conference will likely become one of the greatest opportunities we encounter within the Divine Realm."
Lucia immediately snorted lightly afterward.
"You make it sound as though we planned to slack off," she replied while folding her arms proudly.
However, despite her confident tone, seriousness could still be seen within her eyes.
Clearly, even she understood how important the Cosmic Ascension Conference truly was.
Meanwhile, Isabella also softly nodded afterward.
"We understand," she replied calmly.
Then her gaze shifted briefly toward Max afterward.
"You should focus on yourself as well."
A faint smile slowly appeared across her face afterward.
"After all, with your personality, I would not be surprised if you end up causing chaos throughout the entire conference."
Hearing that, even Lucia immediately laughed lightly afterward.
Meanwhile, Max simply smiled faintly without denying it at all.
At that moment, although none of them fully knew what awaited them inside the Eternal Hourglass—
All three clearly understood one thing.
The moment the Cosmic Ascension Conference officially began—
Everything throughout the Divine Realm would change.
Soon afterward, Max said his goodbyes to Lucia and Isabella before finally returning back to his assigned residence.
At that moment, the entire Black Dragon Palace had already gradually become quiet once again.
Almost every disciple had returned to their lodgings while silently waiting for the Cosmic Ascension Conference to officially begin.
Meanwhile, after entering his room, Max directly sat down cross-legged inside the training chamber before entering meditation quietly.
Dense Divine Essence slowly circulated throughout his body while his mind gradually became completely calm.
Time slowly passed afterward.
One hour.
Then another.
It was not until roughly two hours later—
That something suddenly happened.
Buzz!!!
Without any warning whatsoever, the entire space surrounding Max suddenly trembled violently.
The next instant, a massive beam of golden light descended directly from above.
The dazzling golden light instantly engulfed Max completely before he could even properly react.
At the same time, terrifying spatial fluctuations exploded throughout the surroundings.
Then—
Everything around him disappeared completely.
The training chamber vanished.
The Black Dragon Palace disappeared.
Even the entire Verdant Sky Star Realm itself seemed to fade away instantly.
Only endless golden light remained.
The transportation process lasted only briefly.
Then suddenly—
The golden light surrounding Max finally disappeared.
The moment Max opened his eyes once again afterward, he immediately realized he had already arrived in an entirely different place.
At that moment, he stood outside an enormous ancient castle.

The gigantic castle towered into the heavens like a divine fortress while ancient golden runes covered its massive walls endlessly. Dense ancient aura spread from the castle continuously while countless streams of golden light drifted throughout the sky above it.
Meanwhile, outside the enormous castle existed a vast open area large enough to contain entire cities.
And most importantly—
Max quickly realized he was not alone.
Thousands upon thousands of figures already filled the surroundings completely.
The atmosphere throughout the area felt extremely chaotic.
However, what immediately caught Max’s attention was the races gathered there.
Humans naturally occupied a large portion of the crowd.
But aside from humans—
The demon race clearly possessed the greatest number of participants present there.
Everywhere Max looked, demons could easily be seen throughout the enormous gathering.

Most possessed dark black skin while terrifying demonic aura continuously spread from their bodies naturally. Two horns curved upward from their heads while many demons also possessed strange crimson eyes glowing faintly beneath the ancient golden light surrounding the castle.
Some demons carried gigantic weapons on their backs.
Others simply stood silently while releasing overwhelming pressure.
The sheer number of demon race geniuses gathered there honestly felt astonishing.
"It really includes geniuses from all over the Divine Realm," Max muttered softly while observing the enormous number of demons gathered throughout the surroundings.
At that moment, his gaze slowly swept across the vast crowd once again.
The Divine Realm was simply far too enormous.
Humans alone could never dominate every star realm within such an immeasurable world.
Aside from humanity, the Demon Race and the Elf Race also occupied countless territories and powerful star realms throughout the Divine Realm.
Naturally, since the Cosmic Ascension Conference encompassed the entirety of the Divine Realm itself, it was only normal for geniuses from those races to appear here as well.
Meanwhile, the demonic aura spreading throughout portions of the crowd honestly felt extremely oppressive.
Some demons radiated violent killing intent naturally.
Others stood silently while terrifying pressure distorted the surrounding air faintly around them.
Clearly, none of the individuals gathered here were ordinary.
At the same time, while Max silently observed the surroundings, something suddenly happened.
Buzz!!!
The sky above the enormous castle suddenly trembled violently.
The next moment, countless golden runes appeared throughout the heavens one after another before rapidly gathering together.
Then suddenly—
An enormous timer materialized high above everyone’s heads.
[59 Seconds]
[58 Seconds]
[57 Seconds]
The gigantic golden numbers floated throughout the sky while radiating ancient pressure continuously.
The moment the timer appeared, the atmosphere throughout the entire gathering changed instantly.
Originally, countless conversations and discussions filled the surroundings.
However now—
Almost everyone gradually became silent.
Because every participant immediately understood something.
Once that timer reached zero—
The Cosmic Ascension Conference would truly begin.
At that moment, even the surrounding demons gradually became more serious.
Countless sharp gazes lifted toward the timer floating high in the sky.
Meanwhile, Max himself also narrowed his eyes slightly afterward while silently watching the countdown continue decreasing.
[52 Seconds]
[51 Seconds]
[50 Seconds]
The pressure throughout the surroundings gradually became heavier and heavier.
Excitement.
Nervousness.
Anticipation.
Battle intent.
Countless emotions quietly spread throughout the enormous gathering while everyone waited for the timer to finally reach zero.

chapters.title: Chapter 1692: Complete Chaos!
paragraphs: The enormous golden timer floating throughout the sky continued decreasing relentlessly.
[10 Seconds]
The atmosphere throughout the entire area became incomparably tense.
Countless geniuses silently stared upward while terrifying auras gradually leaked from their bodies uncontrollably.
[9 Seconds]
Some participants slowly took out their weapons.
Others quietly circulated their Divine Essence already.
[8 Seconds]
The surrounding demons released increasingly violent killing intent while numerous humans also revealed solemn expressions.
Everyone understood very clearly—
The moment the countdown ended, the true Cosmic Ascension Conference would officially begin.
[5 Seconds]
At that moment, the enormous gathering had already become completely silent.
Only the countdown remained visible throughout the heavens.
[4 Seconds]
[3 Seconds]
[2 Seconds]
[1 Second]
Then—
Boom!!!
The instant the timer reached zero, the entire heavens suddenly exploded with dazzling golden light.
At the same time, an ancient voice echoed throughout the entire world.
[The Cosmic Ascension Conference Has Officially Begun.]
The notification resounded directly within everyone’s minds simultaneously.
And the very next instant—
Chaos erupted.
Boom!!! Boom!!! Boom!!!
Terrifying explosions instantly exploded throughout the enormous gathering area.
Without even a moment of hesitation, countless geniuses directly attacked one another.
Sword light erupted everywhere.
Demonic flames exploded violently across the battlefield.
Gigantic weapons smashed through the ground continuously.
The peaceful gathering area from moments earlier instantly transformed into an absolute war zone.
Many weaker geniuses were caught completely off guard.
Some died before they could even properly react.
Others desperately attempted escaping while terrifying attacks rained throughout the surroundings endlessly.
Meanwhile, the demon race participants became especially violent.
Roars echoed throughout the battlefield while numerous demons charged directly into nearby groups like savage beasts.
Blood immediately began splattering throughout the surroundings.
Screams echoed everywhere.
Some participants formed temporary alliances instantly while others directly betrayed people standing beside them moments earlier.
The entire area became pure chaos.
Literal chaos.
At that moment, nobody cared about rules or morality anymore.
Everyone only had one thought remaining.
Survive.
Max’s eyes immediately sharpened afterward while observing the battlefield erupting around him.
Even he had not expected the Cosmic Ascension Conference to begin this brutally.
There were no explanations.
No introductions.
No peaceful beginning.
The conference simply started with slaughter.
Boom!!!
A gigantic demonic axe suddenly descended nearby and instantly crushed several participants into blood mist.
Meanwhile, another human genius unleashed thousands of sword lights throughout the crowd, directly tearing apart countless nearby enemies.
Everywhere Max looked—
People were killing each other.
The battlefield had completely descended into madness within mere seconds after the conference began.
"This is only one part of the battlefield inside the Eternal Hourglass..."
Max muttered softly while observing the absolute chaos erupting throughout the surroundings.
Terrifying explosions continuously echoed throughout the heavens while countless geniuses slaughtered one another without hesitation.
Blood stained the ground everywhere.
Sword lights split apart the sky.
Demonic flames and destructive Divine Essence attacks continuously exploded throughout the battlefield endlessly.
And this—
Was merely one section of the Eternal Hourglass.
At that moment, even Max could not help but feel slightly shocked internally.
Compared to this place, the Soul Sealing Painting honestly looked insignificant.
Meanwhile, just as Max calmly observed the battlefield around him, one of the nearby demons suddenly noticed him.
The demon possessed dark black skin and two thick crimson horns atop his head while violent demonic aura surged around his massive body continuously.
The moment the demon sensed Max’s cultivation at merely the peak of the Law Awakening Realm, his crimson eyes immediately flashed greedily.
Clearly, in his eyes, Max had become easy prey.
"Hahaha! Die!"
The demon roared loudly afterward while directly charging toward Max.
Boom!!!
The ground exploded beneath his feet while the gigantic battle axe within his hands radiated terrifying destructive power.
The enormous weapon tore through the air violently before smashing directly downward toward Max’s head.
The pressure released by the attack alone was enough to crush ordinary cultivators completely.
However, Max never moved.
His expression remained completely calm.
Then the instant the gigantic battle axe descended before him, Max suddenly raised one hand casually.
Boom!!!
A terrifying shockwave exploded outward instantly.
The surrounding ground shattered violently while nearby participants looked toward the scene in shock.
Because Max had directly grabbed the gigantic battle axe with his bare hand.
The terrifying demonic weapon stopped completely above his head.
The demon’s expression instantly froze afterward.
"What?!"
His crimson eyes widened completely in disbelief.
Clearly, he never imagined that someone would actually stop his full-powered axe strike using nothing but physical strength alone.
Meanwhile, Max slowly raised his head afterward.
A faint cold smile gradually appeared across his face.
"You are too weak."
The next instant, Max directly unleashed a punch toward the demon’s chest.
Boom!!!
The terrifying power of the Star Fist Divine Ability instantly erupted completely.
A faint star-like glow condensed around Max’s fist before exploding outward violently upon impact.
The demon’s body immediately collapsed inward grotesquely.
Then another explosion echoed throughout the battlefield as his entire upper body exploded apart into blood mist instantly.
The gigantic demon died on the spot without even possessing the chance to scream properly.
At the same time, several golden notifications suddenly appeared before Max’s eyes.
[You Have Killed A Demon Race Participant.]
[Killing Points +100]
[Current Killing Points: 100]
The moment those notifications appeared, Max’s eyes narrowed slightly afterward.
"Killing Points..." he muttered thoughtfully.
Meanwhile, around him, the slaughter throughout the battlefield only continued becoming increasingly chaotic.
Max quietly looked toward the golden notifications floating before his eyes while slowly falling into thought.
Only one hundred Killing Points.
Clearly, the demon he killed earlier had not defeated many participants before targeting him.
Which meant one thing.
The stronger participants who survived longer and killed more people would naturally accumulate increasingly terrifying amounts of Killing Points over time.
The moment that realization surfaced within Max’s mind, a strange thought immediately appeared afterward.
"Maybe I should simply let everyone kill each other first..." Max muttered thoughtfully.
His eyes slowly swept across the chaotic battlefield surrounding him.
"Once enough Killing Points gather onto certain individuals, I can simply sweep them all afterward."
Honestly, that seemed far more efficient than hunting weaker participants one after another himself.
Meanwhile, just as Max continued pondering this idea, a furious roar suddenly echoed from nearby.
"You bastard! How dare you kill me?!"
The voice exploded with overwhelming anger.
