chapters.title: Chapter 1693: Three Lives!
paragraphs: Max immediately turned toward the source of the shout afterward.
However, the moment he saw the figure rushing toward him, even he became slightly surprised.
Because the one charging toward him was actually the exact same demon he had just killed moments ago.
The same dark black skin.
The same crimson horns.
Even the gigantic battle axe remained identical.
At that moment, Max’s brows instantly furrowed slightly.
He was certain he had already blown apart the demon’s upper body completely earlier.
The demon should have been eliminated entirely.
Yet now—
He was standing there alive once again.
Meanwhile, the demon himself clearly looked completely enraged now.
"You lowly human!" the demon roared furiously while charging toward Max once again. "I will split your body apart piece by piece!"
Boom!!!
The gigantic battle axe tore through the air violently while demonic aura exploded outward once more.
However, Max no longer even bothered speaking this time.
The instant the demon approached him, star-like light instantly condensed around Max’s fist once again.
Then—
Boom!!!
Max directly unleashed another Star Fist toward the demon.
The terrifying stellar force exploded outward instantly.
The demon’s body once again exploded apart into blood mist completely without possessing the slightest ability to resist.
At the same time, another notification appeared before Max’s eyes.
[Killing Points +50]
[Current Killing Points: 150]
Seeing this, Max’s eyes narrowed slightly afterward.
Only fifty points this time.
Meanwhile, before Max could continue thinking further, his Dimensional Sovereign Body instinctively activated.
Invisible dimensional perception instantly spread throughout the enormous battlefield and beyond it.
The range of his senses rapidly expanded outward.
Then suddenly—
Max saw something.
Inside the enormous castle standing in the distance, the demon he had just killed moments ago had appeared once again.
Alive.
Completely unharmed.
The moment Max realized this, his expression immediately became thoughtful.
"So that is how it works..."
At that moment, everything finally became clear to him.
Participants did not truly die after being killed here.
Instead, they revived again inside the castle afterward.
The battlefield outside merely functioned as a giant slaughter zone where everyone continuously fought and stole Killing Points from one another.
However—
That realization immediately caused another question to appear within Max’s mind.
"If participants revive after dying..." Max muttered softly.
"Then exactly how many times can one revive here?"
Just as Max continued wondering about the revival rules of the Cosmic Ascension Conference, his eyes suddenly narrowed slightly.
Because unlike earlier, the demon he killed twice did not charge back toward the battlefield immediately after reviving.
Instead, the demon appeared extremely panicked.
The moment he revived inside the castle, he immediately began rushing away from the battlefield area entirely as though terrified of something.
Seeing this, a sharp light instantly flashed through Max’s eyes.
Then without hesitation, Max directly withdrew from the chaotic battlefield and silently followed after the fleeing demon.
With the Vein of Speed and Dimensional Sovereign Body assisting him, Max moved through the surroundings silently without attracting much attention at all.
Meanwhile, the demon continuously looked behind himself nervously while leaving the castle area rapidly.
Clearly, the previous two deaths had already completely shattered his confidence.
However, just as the demon finally believed he had escaped safely—
A figure suddenly appeared directly before him.
The demon’s body instantly froze afterward.
Because standing before him calmly was none other than Max himself.
The demon’s crimson eyes widened completely in horror.
At that moment, his earlier arrogance had completely disappeared.
Instead, only fear remained.
Meanwhile, Max calmly looked toward him before speaking softly,
"So you really do revive after dying."
The demon instinctively took several steps backward afterward.
"No... no..." he muttered panickedly.
Then suddenly, the demon hurriedly shouted,
"Please do not kill me again!"
The sudden begging honestly surprised Max slightly.
After all, moments earlier, this same demon had looked eager to split him apart with a battle axe.
Yet now—
He looked completely terrified.
Max calmly looked toward him afterward before asking,
"And why exactly should I not kill you again?"
The demon’s expression immediately became even uglier afterward.

chapters.title: Chapter 1694: Four Times Killing Means True Death!
paragraphs: Seeing this, Max finally understood clearly.
"So that is how it works..." Max muttered thoughtfully.
"If everyone possesses three lives here, that means participants can die three separate times before being truly eliminated from the Cosmic Ascension Conference."
A faint smile slowly appeared across his face afterward.
At that moment, Max had finally grasped the true rules governing this battlefield.
Meanwhile, not far away, the revived demon looked completely terrified now.
The moment he revived inside the castle once again, he immediately began rushing toward the outer region desperately, clearly trying to escape from Max entirely.
However—
Boom!!!
Max’s figure suddenly blurred before disappearing instantly.
The next moment, he directly appeared before the fleeing demon once again.
The demon’s body froze completely afterward.
His crimson eyes widened in absolute horror.
The demon instinctively stepped backward repeatedly while his entire body trembled visibly now.
Clearly, the previous deaths had already completely shattered his courage.
Meanwhile, Max calmly looked toward him silently.
That calm expression only made the demon even more terrified.
"Please!" the demon suddenly shouted desperately. "Do not kill me again!"
Fear completely filled his face afterward.
"I was telling the truth! I swear I was not lying to you!"
The demon’s voice even began trembling slightly now.
"You already killed me three times! Please spare me just this once!"
At that moment, the demon no longer possessed even the slightest arrogance from earlier.
He looked completely broken.
Meanwhile, Max simply observed him quietly without the slightest change in expression.
Then eventually, Max slowly spoke.
"It seems your information was indeed correct."
The demon’s expression immediately brightened slightly afterward as though he had finally seen hope.
However, before he could say anything else—
Max’s eyes suddenly turned cold.
"But unfortunately for you..."
A faint star-like glow gradually condensed around Max’s fist once again.
"I already decided to test it completely."
The moment those words entered the demon’s ears, absolute panic instantly filled his face.
"No! Wait! Please!"
The demon desperately tried turning around to escape.
However, it was already too late.
Boom!!!
The Vein of Speed activated instantly.
Before the demon could even properly move, Max had already appeared directly before him once again.
Then—
Boom!!!
The Star Fist Divine Ability erupted completely.
Terrifying stellar force exploded outward instantly before smashing directly into the demon’s chest.
The demon’s body exploded apart completely into blood mist without leaving behind even the slightest trace.
At the same time, another notification appeared before Max’s eyes.
[Killing Points +10]
[Current Killing Points: 185]
Then—
Silence.
This time, even after several moments passed—
The demon never revived again.
"For one to truly die in this world..."
A faint smile slowly appeared across Max’s face afterward.
"They actually need to be killed four times in total."
At that moment, Max had finally completely understood the rules governing the battlefield outside the castle.
The first three deaths merely consumed lives.
Only the fourth death resulted in true elimination from the Cosmic Ascension Conference.
Meanwhile, as this realization fully settled within his mind, another thought immediately surfaced afterward.
A dangerous thought.
"This is actually a perfect way to farm Killing Points," Max muttered softly.
After all, every time someone was killed, Killing Points could still be earned from them.
Which meant participants could repeatedly hunt the same targets multiple times before eliminating them completely.
The more Max thought about it, the more absurd the rules of the Cosmic Ascension Conference appeared.
However—
If even Max could realize this method so quickly, then naturally other geniuses throughout the Eternal Hourglass would eventually realize it as well.
And once everyone understood this...
The battlefield would likely become even more terrifying than before.
At that moment, Max slowly lifted his gaze toward the enormous castle standing in the distance.
Countless participants continuously revived there before charging back into the battlefield again.
The atmosphere surrounding the castle honestly resembled a giant slaughterhouse.
"Hehe..."
Max suddenly laughed softly afterward.
"This really is quite fun."
A sharp dangerous light gradually appeared within his eyes afterward.
Meanwhile, his gaze slowly swept across the enormous castle thoughtfully.
At that moment, Max genuinely began wondering something.
Had someone already started hunting everyone within one castle region repeatedly?
Had some monstrous genius already begun wiping out entire groups of participants to harvest enormous amounts of Killing Points?
The more Max thought about it, the more excited he gradually became.
Because if that truly happened—
Then this Cosmic Ascension Conference would become far more brutal and interesting than he originally imagined.
Max no longer wasted his time afterward.
The moment he finished understanding the rules of this battlefield, the Vein of Speed activated instantly.
Boom!!!
His figure blurred before disappearing from the ground completely.
The next moment, Max directly appeared atop the enormous ancient castle overlooking the battlefield below.
From that height, the entire chaotic region became clearly visible before his eyes.
Countless participants slaughtered one another throughout the battlefield endlessly.
Explosions continuously echoed throughout the surroundings.
Sword lights tore through the heavens.
Demonic aura surged wildly everywhere.
Blood stained enormous portions of the battlefield while revived participants continuously rushed out from the castle repeatedly before diving back into the slaughter once again.
The scene honestly resembled complete madness.
Meanwhile, standing atop the highest point of the castle itself, Max quietly observed everything calmly.
The violent winds high above the battlefield caused his clothes to flutter continuously while countless flashes of destruction reflected within his eyes.
Then eventually—
Max slowly sat down atop the castle casually.
He did not immediately join the chaos again.
Instead, a faint smile gradually appeared across his face.
"There is no need to rush."
At that moment, Max had already made his decision.
Rather than wasting effort fighting countless weak participants repeatedly, it would be far more efficient to simply wait.
Wait until stronger participants gathered enormous amounts of Killing Points.
Wait until weaker geniuses gradually became eliminated one after another.
And then—
Sweep everyone remaining afterward.
Max calmly looked down toward the battlefield below while silently waiting.
Meanwhile, above the battlefield itself, enormous golden numbers could be seen floating throughout the sky.
Those numbers represented the total participants remaining alive within this region of the Eternal Hourglass.
And slowly—
The numbers continuously decreased.
Thousands became hundreds.
Hundreds continued dropping lower and lower as the slaughter intensified increasingly.
Every few moments, participants disappeared permanently after exhausting all four lives completely.
The battlefield only became more brutal over time.
Meanwhile, Max simply remained seated atop the castle silently observing everything like a hunter patiently watching prey weaken each other.
"I will move once the numbers drop low enough," Max muttered softly.
His eyes gradually narrowed afterward.
"Perhaps once only ten or so participants remain..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1695: Camouflage Demons!
paragraphs: Just as Max quietly remained seated atop the enormous castle while calmly observing the endless slaughter unfolding below him.
The battlefield only continued becoming increasingly brutal over time.
Participants continuously killed one another repeatedly while Killing Points shifted from person to person endlessly.
The weaker geniuses gradually began disappearing completely after exhausting all four lives while the stronger individuals continued growing increasingly dangerous.
At the same time, the number of surviving participants steadily decreased.
However, despite appearing relaxed outwardly, Max’s senses had never relaxed even slightly.
The Dimensional Sovereign Body continuously spread invisible perception throughout the surroundings while carefully observing everything nearby.
And eventually—
A faint smile slowly appeared across Max’s face afterward.
Then he lightly chuckled.
"How long do you three plan on hiding there?"
The moment those words left his mouth, the surrounding area immediately became silent once again.
Nothing happened.
No movement appeared anywhere nearby.
However, Max’s expression never changed in the slightest.
Instead, he simply continued looking calmly toward empty space nearby.
Several seconds passed afterward.
Then suddenly—
Buzz!!!
Space distorted faintly nearby.
The next moment, three figures slowly emerged out of nowhere.
All three possessed dark black skin and two demonic horns atop their heads.
Demons.
Terrifying demonic aura continuously leaked from their bodies while dense killing intent filled the surroundings instantly.
Meanwhile, after appearing, the three demons immediately looked toward Max with cold expressions.
Clearly, they never expected someone to notice them hiding there beforehand.
At the same time, Max’s eyes quietly narrowed slightly afterward while carefully observing the three demons.
Unlike the weaker demon he killed earlier, these three were clearly much stronger.
Much more dangerous.
One of the three demons slowly stepped forward afterward.

The demon possessed a massive body covered in dark black muscles while a gigantic crimson saber rested casually upon his shoulder. Dense demonic aura continuously leaked from his body while several scars covered portions of his face, giving him an especially savage appearance.
Meanwhile, the demon calmly looked toward Max before speaking.
"We saw everything earlier," he said with a cold grin. "The way you dealt with Jong was honestly quite impressive."
A faint dangerous light flashed within his crimson eyes afterward.
"Although that fool was not our friend, he was still a member of the Demon Race."
The demon slowly pointed the gigantic saber toward Max afterward.
"And more importantly..."
A greedy smile gradually spread across his face.
"He left quite a few Killing Points on you before dying."
The other two demons nearby also released faint killing intent afterward while quietly surrounding Max from different directions.
However, Max himself remained completely calm.
Instead, he simply looked toward the three demons casually before replying,
"If you wanted to fight, then you should have simply attacked directly."
A faint mocking smile slowly appeared across his face afterward.
"Why bother hiding in the shadows like cowards?"
The moment those words entered their ears, the surrounding demonic aura instantly became colder.
However, instead of becoming angry, the saber-wielding demon simply laughed.
"Hahaha..."
His laughter sounded rough and dangerous.
"We may be demons, but that does not mean we are idiots."
The demon’s crimson eyes narrowed afterward while staring directly toward Max.
"We already saw how easily you killed Jong repeatedly."
The atmosphere around the three demons gradually became increasingly dangerous afterward.
"A peak Law Awakening Realm cultivator capable of casually slaughtering someone like Jong is obviously not normal."
The demon then slowly grinned afterward.
"So naturally, we decided using a more careful approach would be better."
The moment those words fell—
Buzz!!!
The bodies of all three demons suddenly blurred strangely.
Then, before Max could even blink properly, the three demons completely disappeared from sight once again as though they had never existed there at all.
"Invisibility?" Max muttered softly while slightly raising his brows.
However, only a moment later, he slowly shook his head.
A faint smile gradually appeared across his face afterward.
"This is merely camouflage."
The moment those words left his mouth, Max suddenly moved his right hand sideways casually.
Bang!!!
A violent explosion instantly erupted nearby.
One of the hidden demons, who had been silently approaching Max from the side while concealed beneath the camouflage ability, was directly blasted away violently before he could even properly react.
The demon’s body smashed across the top of the castle while his camouflage immediately shattered apart completely.
At that moment, shock clearly filled the demon’s crimson eyes.
Meanwhile, before the injured demon could stabilize himself, another demon still hidden beneath the camouflage suddenly attacked from the front.
Boom!!!
A gigantic battle axe tore through the air violently while terrifying demonic aura exploded outward.
The enormous weapon descended directly toward Max’s shoulder with enough force to split apart mountains.
However—
Max never moved.
He simply remained standing there calmly.
Then the battle axe slammed directly onto his shoulder.
Clang!!!
A metallic collision sound echoed throughout the surroundings instantly.
The demon’s expression immediately froze afterward.
Because the terrifying battle axe failed to even leave a scratch upon Max’s skin.
The axe stopped completely against his body as though it had struck an indestructible divine metal wall.
At that moment, the demon’s shocked voice echoed throughout the surroundings.
"How is this possible?!"
Meanwhile, Max slowly turned his head toward the demon afterward.
A faint smile appeared across his face.
Then—
Boom!!!
Star-like light instantly condensed around Max’s fist.
The next moment, Max directly unleashed the Star Fist Divine Ability toward the demon standing before him.
Terrifying stellar force exploded outward instantly.
The surrounding space distorted violently from the sheer power released by the punch.
The demon did not even possess the slightest chance to escape.
Boom!!!
His entire body exploded apart instantly into countless golden fragments before disappearing completely from the battlefield.
At that moment, the final remaining demon finally revealed himself completely.
Buzz!!!
The camouflage surrounding his body gradually disappeared while dense demonic aura erupted outward violently.
The gigantic demon slowly stepped forward afterward while the enormous crimson saber resting upon his back radiated terrifying killing intent continuously.
However, unlike earlier, the demon’s expression now looked extremely dark.
Clearly, after witnessing Max casually destroy the other two demons, even he no longer remained calm.
Meanwhile, the demon stared directly toward Max before speaking coldly,
"You can actually see through our concealment?"
His crimson eyes narrowed dangerously afterward.
Meanwhile, Max simply looked toward him calmly before replying casually,
"It is merely a trash camouflage technique."
A faint mocking smile gradually appeared across his face afterward.
"Even if the three of you truly possessed invisibility abilities..."
His eyes slowly sharpened slightly.
"I still would have found you easily."
The moment those words entered the demon’s ears, terrifying rage instantly exploded from his body.
Boom!!!
Violent demonic aura surged wildly throughout the surroundings while killing intent filled the top of the castle completely.
"You arrogant human!"
The demon roared furiously afterward.
The next instant, he directly pulled out the gigantic crimson saber from his back.

His laughter sounded rough and dangerous.
"We may be demons, but that does not mean we are idiots."
The demon’s crimson eyes narrowed afterward while staring directly toward Max.
"We already saw how easily you killed Jong repeatedly."
The atmosphere around the three demons gradually became increasingly dangerous afterward.
"A peak Law Awakening Realm cultivator capable of casually slaughtering someone like Jong is obviously not normal."
The demon then slowly grinned afterward.
"So naturally, we decided using a more careful approach would be better."
The moment those words fell—
Buzz!!!
The bodies of all three demons suddenly blurred strangely.
Then, before Max could even blink properly, the three demons completely disappeared from sight once again as though they had never existed there at all.
"Invisibility?" Max muttered softly while slightly raising his brows.
However, only a moment later, he slowly shook his head.
A faint smile gradually appeared across his face afterward.
"This is merely camouflage."
The moment those words left his mouth, Max suddenly moved his right hand sideways casually.
Bang!!!
A violent explosion instantly erupted nearby.
One of the hidden demons, who had been silently approaching Max from the side while concealed beneath the camouflage ability, was directly blasted away violently before he could even properly react.
The demon’s body smashed across the top of the castle while his camouflage immediately shattered apart completely.
At that moment, shock clearly filled the demon’s crimson eyes.
Meanwhile, before the injured demon could stabilize himself, another demon still hidden beneath the camouflage suddenly attacked from the front.
Boom!!!
A gigantic battle axe tore through the air violently while terrifying demonic aura exploded outward.
The enormous weapon descended directly toward Max’s shoulder with enough force to split apart mountains.
However—
Max never moved.
He simply remained standing there calmly.
Then the battle axe slammed directly onto his shoulder.
Clang!!!
A metallic collision sound echoed throughout the surroundings instantly.
The demon’s expression immediately froze afterward.
Because the terrifying battle axe failed to even leave a scratch upon Max’s skin.
The axe stopped completely against his body as though it had struck an indestructible divine metal wall.
At that moment, the demon’s shocked voice echoed throughout the surroundings.
"How is this possible?!"
Meanwhile, Max slowly turned his head toward the demon afterward.
A faint smile appeared across his face.
Then—
Boom!!!
Star-like light instantly condensed around Max’s fist.
The next moment, Max directly unleashed the Star Fist Divine Ability toward the demon standing before him.
Terrifying stellar force exploded outward instantly.
The surrounding space distorted violently from the sheer power released by the punch.
The demon did not even possess the slightest chance to escape.
Boom!!!
His entire body exploded apart instantly into countless golden fragments before disappearing completely from the battlefield.
At that moment, the final remaining demon finally revealed himself completely.
Buzz!!!
The camouflage surrounding his body gradually disappeared while dense demonic aura erupted outward violently.
The gigantic demon slowly stepped forward afterward while the enormous crimson saber resting upon his back radiated terrifying killing intent continuously.
However, unlike earlier, the demon’s expression now looked extremely dark.
Clearly, after witnessing Max casually destroy the other two demons, even he no longer remained calm.
Meanwhile, the demon stared directly toward Max before speaking coldly,
"You can actually see through our concealment?"
His crimson eyes narrowed dangerously afterward.
Meanwhile, Max simply looked toward him calmly before replying casually,
"It is merely a trash camouflage technique."
A faint mocking smile gradually appeared across his face afterward.
"Even if the three of you truly possessed invisibility abilities..."
His eyes slowly sharpened slightly.
"I still would have found you easily."
The moment those words entered the demon’s ears, terrifying rage instantly exploded from his body.
Boom!!!
Violent demonic aura surged wildly throughout the surroundings while killing intent filled the top of the castle completely.
"You arrogant human!"
The demon roared furiously afterward.
The next instant, he directly pulled out the gigantic crimson saber from his back.

chapters.title: Chapter 1696: Killing Points Skyrocketing!
paragraphs: The moment the weapon appeared fully, terrifying saber pressure instantly descended throughout the surroundings.
Compared to the previous demons, this demon was clearly far stronger.
Much stronger.
Dense crimson demonic flames immediately erupted around the saber while strange demonic runes began glowing throughout its blade continuously.
Then—
The demon suddenly raised the enormous saber high into the sky.
Boom!!!
The surrounding heavens instantly darkened slightly.
Terrifying demonic power rapidly gathered around the gigantic blade while enormous saber intent spread outward endlessly.
Then the demon roared once again.
"Demonic Saber Art!"
The gigantic crimson saber directly slashed downward toward Max afterward.
The moment the attack descended, a massive crimson saber phantom instantly tore through the sky itself.
The terrifying pressure released by the attack honestly far surpassed every demon Max fought earlier.
Even the surrounding space distorted violently beneath the overwhelming force of the saber strike.
Meanwhile, seeing the incoming attack, Max merely smiled faintly afterward.
Then slowly—
He clenched his fist once again.
Dense star-like light instantly began condensing around his hand while terrifying physical power surged throughout his body completely.
At the same time, the power of five thousand Draconic Essences erupted within him.
The Vein of Strength activated.
The Star Fist Divine Ability circulated completely.
Then, deep within his mind, Max silently muttered one sentence.
"Power of One Star."
The next instant—
Boom!!!
Max directly punched toward the descending gigantic saber attack.
The moment his fist collided with the enormous crimson saber phantom, terrifying stellar force exploded outward completely.
The gigantic saber attack shattered instantly.
Not weakened.
Not pushed back.
Completely obliterated.
The massive crimson saber phantom exploded apart like fragile glass beneath Max’s fist.
Then the terrifying stellar force continued surging forward without slowing down even slightly.
The demon’s expression instantly transformed into absolute horror.
"What—?!"
He did not even finish speaking.
Boom!!!
The remaining force of Max’s punch directly swallowed both the demon and his gigantic crimson saber completely.
The demon’s body exploded apart instantly into countless golden fragments before disappearing entirely from existence.
Meanwhile, after obliterating the saber-wielding demon completely, Max slowly turned his gaze toward the first demon he blasted away earlier.
That demon had only barely managed to survive the previous attack and was currently struggling to stand up properly atop the ruined castle.
However, the moment he saw Max looking toward him, fear instantly filled his crimson eyes.
The demon instinctively stepped backward repeatedly afterward.
Unfortunately for him, Max no longer had any interest in wasting time.
Boom!!!
The Vein of Speed activated instantly.
Before the demon could even react, Max had already appeared directly before him.
Then—
Boom!!!
Another Star Fist erupted outward violently.
The demon’s body exploded apart instantly into countless golden fragments before disappearing completely.
At that moment, silence gradually returned atop the enormous castle once again.
Meanwhile, Max slowly walked toward the edge of the castle afterward before calmly looking down toward the battlefield below.
The chaotic slaughter still continued endlessly.
However, compared to earlier, the number of surviving participants had already drastically decreased.
Max quietly waited there afterward.
Minutes slowly passed.
Then eventually—
The enormous golden numbers floating throughout the sky finally changed once again.
[Remaining Participants: 5]
Seeing this, a faint smile slowly appeared across Max’s face.
Only five participants remained alive within this battlefield region now.
At the same time, not far below the castle, the demons Max killed earlier also gradually revived once again before reappearing around the battlefield.
Clearly, they still intended to continue surviving somehow.
Unfortunately—
The moment Max saw them gathering below once again, his eyes gradually turned cold.
"That should be enough."
The next instant—
Boom!!!
Terrifying black flames suddenly erupted throughout Max’s body violently.
The dark flames surged wildly around him while dense destructive aura spread throughout the entire battlefield instantly.
At that moment, everyone below immediately sensed overwhelming danger.
Then slowly—
Max raised one hand high toward the sky.
The next instant, the heavens themselves suddenly darkened.
Boom!!!
Countless black flames gathered throughout the sky rapidly before condensing together into an absolutely gigantic flaming sword.
The sword was enormous beyond imagination.
It towered throughout the heavens itself while black flames burned endlessly around its blade.
Compared to the gigantic castle below—
The flaming sword itself was countless times larger.
The terrifying pressure released by the sword immediately caused the surrounding space to tremble violently.
Meanwhile, below the castle—
The remaining five participants instantly froze completely.
Three humans.
Two demons.
And even the three recently revived demons.
All of them slowly raised their heads afterward.
Then—
Despair instantly appeared across every single one of their faces.
"What... is that..."
One of the humans muttered blankly.
Meanwhile, the demons Max killed earlier immediately became completely horrified after recognizing him standing above the castle.
The saber demon’s revived form looked utterly terrified now.
At that moment, beneath the enormous black flaming sword hanging throughout the heavens, everyone felt unbelievably small.
Meanwhile, high above the battlefield, Max calmly looked downward before lowering his hand slowly.
Then—
The gigantic black flaming sword descended.
Boom!!!
The heavens themselves seemed to collapse.
The enormous sword smashed downward toward the battlefield with terrifying destructive force beyond imagination.
Then—
The world exploded.
BOOOOOOMMMMMM!!!!
A catastrophic explosion instantly swallowed the entire battlefield completely.
The gigantic ancient castle exploded apart instantly beneath the terrifying impact.
Countless kilometers of land flattened completely.
The catastrophic explosion continued raging throughout the battlefield endlessly.
Black flames devoured everything in sight while enormous shockwaves spread throughout the flattened land continuously.
The gigantic castle had completely disappeared.
Not even ruins remained behind.
Only a massive destroyed crater stretching across the battlefield could now be seen beneath the burning black flames.
Meanwhile, high above the devastated battlefield, Max calmly stood within the sky while silently observing the destruction below.
At that moment, countless golden notifications suddenly began appearing rapidly before his eyes one after another.
[Killing Points +350]
[Killing Points +420]
[Killing Points +500]
[Killing Points +280]
[Killing Points +610]
[Killing Points +150]
[Killing Points +300]
The notifications continued increasing endlessly.
Because the attack earlier had not merely killed the final remaining participants.
It had also completely wiped out the demons he previously killed multiple times after they exhausted their remaining lives entirely.
Soon afterward—
A final notification finally appeared before Max’s eyes.
[Current Killing Points: 28,450]
Seeing the enormous amount of Killing Points he gained instantly, even Max’s eyes slightly brightened afterward.
Then a faint smile gradually spread across his face.
"Hehe..."
"This really is efficient."
Meanwhile, Max slowly looked down toward the completely obliterated battlefield afterward while calmly analyzing the situation internally.
"If the number of surviving participants had still been large..."
His eyes narrowed slightly afterward.
"And if many of them still possessed multiple lives remaining..."
A faint helpless smile appeared across his face.
"Then using such a large-scale attack would honestly have been somewhat wasteful."
After all, the more remaining lives participants possessed, the less effective such a massive extermination attack became.
However now—
Only a handful of participants remained alive before the attack.
And most had already died several times beforehand during the chaotic slaughter.
Which meant Max’s final attack had essentially harvested all remaining Killing Points within this battlefield region completely.
At that moment, while black flames still burned throughout the destroyed land below—
Max quietly stood in the sky with a satisfied expression on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 1697: Terrifying Rainbow Rabbits!
paragraphs: Meanwhile, after the catastrophic explosion gradually settled down, the endless black flames slowly began disappearing from the battlefield one after another.
Dust and debris still filled enormous portions of the surroundings while the flattened land stretched endlessly beneath the devastated sky.
The once gigantic castle had completely vanished without leaving behind even the slightest trace.
At that moment, Max calmly floated high above the destroyed battlefield while observing everything below quietly.
Since the battlefield region here had already been completely cleared, Max naturally had no intention of remaining any longer.
After all, the Eternal Hourglass was unimaginably vast.
There were undoubtedly countless other battlefield regions similar to this one scattered throughout the Cosmic Ascension Conference.
And naturally—
There were also countless Killing Points waiting to be harvested elsewhere.
"Time to move to another area," Max muttered softly.
However, just as Max was about to leave the battlefield completely—
His expression suddenly changed slightly.
Because the Dimensional Sovereign Body suddenly sensed a strange fluctuation from the exact location where the gigantic castle had originally stood before being destroyed.
The fluctuation felt extremely unusual.
It was faint.
Yet strangely mysterious.
Max immediately narrowed his eyes afterward.
"What is that?"
Curiosity instantly surfaced within his mind.
Without hesitation, Max directly descended from the sky afterward before landing near the center of the destroyed battlefield.
The surrounding ground remained filled with enormous cracks and burning destruction everywhere from the previous attack.
Meanwhile, guided by the Dimensional Sovereign Body, Max slowly walked toward the source of the strange fluctuation.
Soon afterward—
He discovered something unexpected.
A small hidden cave had appeared beneath the destroyed remains of the battlefield.
Clearly, the cave had originally been hidden beneath the castle itself and only became exposed after the entire region was flattened completely.
Seeing this, Max’s curiosity immediately increased further.
Then without hesitation, he directly entered the cave.
The inside of the cave looked surprisingly peaceful compared to the devastated battlefield outside.
Soft rainbow-colored light continuously glowed throughout the surroundings while dense spiritual energy quietly filled the cave completely.
Meanwhile, after walking deeper inside briefly—
Max suddenly stopped.
Because inside the cave—
Several strange rainbow-colored rabbits quietly sat there.
Max quietly looked toward the strange rainbow-colored rabbits gathered inside the cave.
The rabbits honestly looked harmless.
Their fur shimmered with countless rainbow colors beneath the glowing spiritual light surrounding the cave while their tiny eyes looked unusually pure and innocent.
At first glance, they appeared almost cute.
And unfortunately for Max—
That became his very first mistake here.
Meanwhile, just as Max continued observing the rabbits curiously, one of them suddenly moved.
Buzz!!!
Without any warning whatsoever, the rainbow rabbit instantly disappeared from its original position.
The next moment—
It directly appeared before Max.
Teleportation.
The speed of the movement honestly shocked even Max slightly.
At the same time, the small rabbit suddenly swung one of its claws directly toward him.
The claw itself looked tiny and harmless.
However, the moment it attacked, terrifying fluctuations erupted from it instantly.
Fortunately, Max’s Dimensional Sovereign Body reacted immediately.
His eyes instantly captured the trajectory of the rabbit’s attack.
Then without hesitation, Max directly responded with a punch of his own.
Bang!!!
A violent collision instantly echoed throughout the cave.
The surrounding ground shattered slightly while terrifying force exploded outward from the impact point.
However—
Max’s expression instantly changed afterward.
Because after colliding with the rabbit’s claw, his body was actually pushed backward several steps.
"What?!"
Max genuinely became shocked.
He immediately stabilized himself afterward while staring directly toward the small rainbow rabbit before him.
"I was actually pushed back by a rabbit?"
At that moment, even Max found the situation difficult to believe.
After all, his physical strength was absolutely monstrous.

Even without activating the Divine Veins or using the power of the five thousand Draconic Essences, his body alone still ranked among the strongest younger generation geniuses participating in the Cosmic Ascension Conference.
Yet now—
Against a small rainbow-colored rabbit—
He had actually been overpowered physically.
This honestly shocked Max greatly.
However, the true horror only arrived moments later.
Just as Max was still processing the absurd strength of the rainbow rabbit, his expression suddenly froze.
Because he suddenly felt something warm rising within his throat.
The next instant—
Cough!
Max directly spat out a mouthful of blood onto the ground.
The bright crimson blood immediately stained portions of the cave floor.
Seeing this, Max’s pupils instantly contracted sharply.
At that moment, genuine horror finally appeared across his face.
"How did this happen?"
He immediately looked back toward the rainbow rabbit he clashed with earlier.
Meanwhile, the rabbit simply stood there quietly while looking toward him calmly with its rainbow-colored eyes.
Then suddenly—
A terrifying possibility surfaced within Max’s mind.
"Did it..."
His expression gradually became increasingly serious.
"Did that attack ignore my outer body completely and directly damage my internal organs?"
Understanding this instantly, Max’s expression immediately became incomparably solemn.
Without hesitation, he directly stepped backward several times while widening the distance between himself and the rainbow-colored rabbits.
At that moment, all traces of carelessness had completely disappeared from his face.
Instead, only caution remained.
Meanwhile, the tens of rainbow rabbits inside the cave quietly stared toward him with their colorful eyes while strange fluctuations continuously spread around their bodies faintly.
"They can teleport..."
Max muttered while narrowing his eyes seriously.
"And their attacks can directly bypass external defenses and strike internal organs instead."
The more Max analyzed the earlier clash, the more dangerous these seemingly harmless rabbits appeared.
After all, no matter how terrifying someone’s physical defense was, it would become meaningless if the attack ignored the outer body entirely.
At that moment, even Max felt genuine danger from these creatures.
However—
A faint smile slowly appeared across his face afterward.
"I suppose the best solution is simply immobilizing them first."
The next instant, terrifying spatial fluctuations instantly erupted from Max’s body.
Dense Space Concept rapidly spread throughout the entire cave while countless silver-blue dimensional runes appeared around him one after another.
Then Max calmly raised one hand afterward.
"Void Genesis Art..."
The surrounding space immediately began trembling violently.
Then Max’s eyes sharpened completely.
"Space Freeze."
Boom!!!
The full power of Max’s Space Concept exploded outward instantly.
The next moment, the entire surrounding space within nearly a one-kilometer radius completely froze.
Not ordinary freezing.
Space itself became solidified completely.
The air stopped moving.
Spatial fluctuations completely ceased.
Even dimensional movement itself became restricted entirely.
Meanwhile, inside the cave, all the rainbow rabbits instantly froze in place one after another beneath the terrifying power of the Void Genesis Art.
Even their strange teleportation fluctuations stopped completely.

chapters.title: Chapter 1698: A hidden trial?
paragraphs: Seeing this scene, Max finally smiled lightly afterward.
"It is fortunate that I finally fully mastered the Void Genesis Art during these past months."
His gaze quietly swept across the frozen rabbits afterward.
At that moment, Max genuinely felt somewhat emotional internally.
The Void Genesis Art had originally been given to him long ago by his very first master.
Back then, that same master had even helped him create a separate clone body in order to allow him to pursue the path of time independently.
However, after ascending into the Divine Realm, Max became occupied with countless other powers and inheritances.
The Seven Divine Veins.
His bloodline.
And countless other opportunities.
Because of that, he never truly gave the Void Genesis Art the attention it deserved.
As a result, the art gradually became almost useless compared to his other abilities.
Only during these recent three months of secluded cultivation inside the Dimension of Time did Max finally dedicate himself toward completely comprehending the Void Genesis Art to its highest layer.
And now—
After truly mastering it—
Max finally realized exactly what he had been missing all this time.
The Void Genesis Art was far more terrifying than he originally imagined.
Meanwhile, after completely freezing the surrounding space with the Void Genesis Art, the entire cave became deathly silent.
The rainbow-colored rabbits remained frozen in place completely.
Even their strange teleportation fluctuations had entirely stopped beneath the terrifying suppression of the frozen space.
Seeing this, Max no longer hesitated afterward.
A seven-colored lightning sword instantly condensed within his hand.
Crackle! Crackle! Crackle!
Violent lightning continuously surged around the sword blade while terrifying sharpness spread throughout the cave.
Then Max slowly walked toward the nearest frozen rabbit.
At that moment, despite the rainbow rabbit being immobilized completely, Max still did not underestimate it in the slightest.
After all, he already personally experienced how terrifying these creatures truly were.
Without hesitation, Max directly thrust the lightning sword downward.
Puchi!
The sword pierced directly through the rabbit’s body instantly.
The rainbow-colored rabbit immediately exploded apart into countless fragments of rainbow light before disappearing completely.
At the same time—
Several golden notifications instantly appeared before Max’s eyes.
[Killing Points +5,000]
[Current Killing Points: 33,450]
Seeing this, even Max’s expression changed slightly afterward.
"Five thousand Killing Points from a single rabbit?"
At that moment, even he became genuinely surprised.
Clearly, these rainbow rabbits were far more valuable than ordinary participants outside.
Meanwhile, after realizing this, Max’s eyes immediately brightened slightly afterward.
Without wasting any more time, Max directly moved toward the next frozen rabbit.
Puchi!
Another rabbit exploded apart into rainbow fragments instantly.
[Killing Points +5,000]
Then another.
And another.
The entire cave soon became filled with flashing golden notifications continuously as Max slaughtered the immobilized rainbow rabbits one after another effortlessly.
Puchi!
Puchi!
Puchi!
Every rabbit he killed immediately granted enormous amounts of Killing Points.
Meanwhile, the frozen space surrounding the cave remained completely stable beneath the power of the Void Genesis Art, preventing any of the rabbits from escaping through teleportation whatsoever.
Eventually—
After the final rainbow rabbit was killed completely—
A massive final notification suddenly appeared before Max’s eyes.
[Current Killing Points: 110,000]
Seeing the enormous number floating before him, even Max himself became slightly stunned for a brief moment.
Then slowly—
A bright smile gradually spread across his face afterward.
"One hundred and ten thousand Killing Points..."
Even after slaughtering countless participants throughout the battlefield earlier, his points had never increased this absurdly fast.
Clearly—
The true opportunities hidden inside the Eternal Hourglass were not merely the battlefield regions outside.
There were treasures and hidden encounters hidden throughout this place as well.
"The strange energy fluctuations I sensed earlier still have not disappeared..."
Max muttered softly while narrowing his eyes toward the deeper parts of the cave.
Even after slaughtering all the rainbow-colored rabbits nearby, the mysterious fluctuations remained extremely clear beneath the perception of his Dimensional Sovereign Body.
That immediately meant one thing.
"There is definitely something else hidden here aside from those rabbits."
Understanding this instantly, Max no longer wasted any time afterward.
He directly continued moving deeper into the cave.
The deeper he traveled, the denser the strange spiritual fluctuations became.
At the same time, the surroundings gradually became increasingly beautiful as well.
Rainbow-colored light continuously reflected throughout the cave walls while dense spiritual energy filled the air almost like liquid itself.
Meanwhile, during his journey deeper inside, Max encountered several more rainbow rabbits hidden throughout different parts of the cave.
However, after suffering earlier because of underestimating them, Max naturally no longer acted carelessly.
The instant he sensed the rabbits preparing to attack, terrifying spatial fluctuations immediately erupted outward.
"Void Genesis Art."
"Space Freeze."
Boom!!!
The surrounding space instantly solidified once again.
The rainbow rabbits immediately froze in place before even possessing the chance to teleport.
Then Max casually slaughtered them one after another using his lightning sword.
Compared to earlier, handling them now became vastly easier.
Eventually, after traveling deeper for quite some time, Max finally reached the very end of the cave.
The moment he arrived there, his footsteps slowly stopped.
Because floating silently before him—
Was an enormous tetragonal crystal.
The crystal was gigantic.
At least several dozen meters tall.
Its entire body shimmered with beautiful deep blue light while incomparably pure energy continuously flowed throughout its surface endlessly.
At the same time, the strange mysterious fluctuations Max sensed earlier clearly originated from this crystal itself.
Meanwhile, countless strange runes continuously floated around the crystal while dense spatial energy distorted portions of the surroundings faintly.
The moment Max saw the crystal clearly, even his eyes slightly narrowed afterward.
Because he could immediately feel it.
The energy contained within this giant blue crystal was absolutely extraordinary.
Meanwhile, Max quietly stood before the enormous blue crystal while carefully observing it with narrowed eyes.
Dense mysterious energy continuously flowed throughout the crystal while strange spatial fluctuations distorted the surrounding area faintly.
At the same time, the Dimensional Sovereign Body continuously warned him that this crystal was absolutely extraordinary.
"This thing..." Max muttered softly.
The closer he looked at the giant tetragonal crystal, the more ancient and mysterious it appeared.
Countless blue runes slowly circulated throughout its surface while deep inside the crystal itself, faint flashes of starlike light could occasionally be seen flickering endlessly.
At that moment, Max genuinely could not determine exactly what this crystal was.
However, just as he was still observing the giant crystal curiously—
Buzz!!!
The surrounding space suddenly trembled lightly.
The next instant, several enormous golden notifications abruptly appeared before Max’s eyes.
[Hidden Trial Detected.]
[Genesis Trial]
[Requirement To Enter: 500,000 Killing Points]
[Would You Like To Spend 500,000 Killing Points To Begin The Genesis Trial?]
The moment Max saw those notifications, his expression instantly froze slightly.
"Five hundred thousand Killing Points?"
Even Max became genuinely shocked afterward.
After all, obtaining one hundred and ten thousand Killing Points already required him to wipe out an entire battlefield region and slaughter dozens of strange rainbow rabbits.
Yet now—
This hidden trial actually required five hundred thousand Killing Points merely to enter.
At that moment, Max immediately understood something.
This so-called Genesis Trial was undoubtedly an unbelievably high-level opportunity hidden within the Eternal Hourglass.
Otherwise, the entrance requirement would never be this absurdly expensive.
Meanwhile, Max slowly looked back toward the giant blue crystal afterward while his eyes gradually became increasingly solemn.
Because now—
He finally understood.
This crystal itself was likely the entrance to the mysterious Genesis Trial.

chapters.title: Chapter 1699: A Peaceful Zone!
paragraphs: The moment Max saw the requirement displayed before him, he could not help but fall silent.
Five hundred thousand Killing Points.
The number honestly felt absurd.
Even after everything he had gone through since entering the Eternal Hourglass, his current total only stood at one hundred and ten thousand.
That meant he still lacked nearly four hundred thousand Killing Points before he could even qualify to enter the Genesis Trial.
Meanwhile, Max slowly looked back toward the gigantic blue crystal floating quietly before him.
The crystal continued radiating mysterious blue light while ancient runes circulated endlessly across its surface.
Just looking at it made Max feel that the opportunity hidden within was extraordinary.
After all, anything requiring half a million Killing Points merely to enter could not possibly be ordinary.
A faint smile slowly appeared across Max’s face afterward.
"It seems I discovered something incredible."
His eyes gradually brightened.
Although he could not enter the Genesis Trial immediately, simply knowing its location was already a tremendous gain.

After all, the crystal was hidden beneath an entire battlefield region and guarded by those strange rainbow rabbits. If he had not accidentally destroyed the castle and investigated the fluctuations afterward, he might never have discovered this place at all.
Meanwhile, Max calmly began calculating his situation.
"One hundred and ten thousand Killing Points..."
He muttered thoughtfully.
"I still need another three hundred and ninety thousand."
At that moment, Max naturally had no intention of giving up on the Genesis Trial.
On the contrary—
The enormous requirement only made him more interested.
Because the greater the entry cost, the greater the reward was likely to be.
Eventually, Max nodded to himself.
"The Genesis Trial is not going anywhere."
His gaze slowly swept across the enormous crystal one final time.
"I can always come back later."
At that moment, a clear plan gradually formed within his mind.
The Eternal Hourglass was unimaginably vast.

If one battlefield region could provide tens of thousands of Killing Points and even hide treasures such as the rainbow rabbits, then there were undoubtedly countless other opportunities scattered throughout the conference.
First, he would continue exploring.
He would hunt participants.
Search for hidden opportunities.
Farm as many Killing Points as possible.
And once he accumulated the required five hundred thousand Killing Points—
He would return here and enter the Genesis Trial.
A faint grin appeared across his face afterward.
"Looks like I need to work a little harder."
With that, Max memorized the location of the cave completely using the Dimensional Sovereign Body.
Then he slowly turned around and began walking toward the exit.
The mysterious blue crystal continued floating silently behind him while ancient blue light illuminated the cave endlessly.
Meanwhile, Max’s attention had already shifted toward his next objective.
Gathering enough Killing Points to unlock the Genesis Trial.
A lot of Killing Points.
Only after accumulating five hundred thousand of them could he return and uncover the secrets hidden inside the Genesis Trial.
Soon afterward, Max exited the cave completely.
The next moment, the Vein of Speed activated.
Boom!!!
His figure shot into the sky like a streak of light before disappearing into the horizon.
The Eternal Hourglass was unimaginably vast.
Mountains.
Forests.
Battlefields.
Ancient ruins.
Cities.
Countless landscapes continuously flashed beneath Max as he flew through the world at astonishing speed.
Meanwhile, the Dimensional Sovereign Body continuously remained active while searching the surroundings for areas containing large concentrations of participants.
After all, where there were participants, there would be opportunities.
And where there were opportunities, there would be Killing Points.
It did not take very long before Max finally discovered something.
"Hm?"
His eyes narrowed slightly.
Far in the distance, he sensed an enormous concentration of life signatures.
Not thousands.
Not tens of thousands.
Hundreds of thousands.
The sheer number immediately attracted Max’s attention.
Without hesitation, he adjusted his direction and flew toward it.
Several minutes later, a gigantic city gradually appeared before him.
The city was absolutely enormous.
Its walls stretched beyond the horizon while countless buildings filled the interior. Ancient towers rose into the sky while enormous roads crossed throughout the city like a massive network.
However—
The moment Max arrived above the city, his expression immediately became strange.
Because the scene before him was completely different from what he expected.
Hundreds of thousands of participants filled the city.
Humans.
Demons.
Elves.
And even members of other races.
The entire city was crowded with geniuses from across the Divine Realm.
Yet—
Nobody was fighting.
Not a single battle could be seen anywhere.
Participants calmly walked through the streets.
Some sat within restaurants.
Others entered various buildings.
Many gathered in groups while discussing things quietly.
The atmosphere honestly felt more like a bustling marketplace than a battle royale.
At that moment, Max genuinely became confused.
He slowly descended onto a rooftop while observing the city below.
"What is going on here?"
His brows gradually furrowed.
Earlier, the battlefield outside the castle had resembled absolute hell.
People slaughtered one another without hesitation.
Yet here—
Hundreds of thousands of participants occupied the same city peacefully.
No fighting.
No killing.
No chaos.
The contrast was so extreme that it honestly felt bizarre.
"How can nobody be fighting in a battle royale?"
Max muttered softly.
His gaze slowly swept across the city once again.
The more he observed, the stranger the situation appeared.
Because not only were people not fighting—
Many participants actually appeared completely relaxed.
As though they were not even participating in the Cosmic Ascension Conference at all.
At that moment, curiosity instantly filled Max’s mind.
Clearly—
There was something very unusual about this city.
Meanwhile, after observing the city from above for some time, Max finally decided to investigate personally.
After all, merely watching from a distance would not reveal the true reason behind such a strange situation.
The next moment, his figure descended from the rooftop before entering the city directly.
As soon as Max crossed through the city boundaries—
Buzz!!!
A strange fluctuation suddenly swept across his body.
At the same time, several golden notifications immediately appeared before his eyes.
[You Have Entered A Peaceful Zone.]
[All Forms Of Combat Are Strictly Prohibited Within This Region.]
[Participants Are Forbidden From Attacking One Another.]
[Violators Will Be Punished By The Eternal Hourglass.]
The moment Max saw those notifications, everything instantly became clear.
"So that is the reason."
A look of realization appeared across his face afterward.
He finally understood why hundreds of thousands of participants could gather inside this city without trying to kill one another.
It was not because they suddenly became friendly.
Nor was it because they reached some kind of agreement.
Rather—
The Eternal Hourglass itself prohibited fighting inside the city.
And judging from the wording of the notification, the punishment seemed serious enough that nobody was willing to test it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1700: Starfall Haven!
paragraphs: Meanwhile, Max quietly looked around afterward.
Now that he understood the rules, the scene before him immediately made much more sense.
Participants walked through the streets calmly.
Many entered shops and buildings.
Others gathered together to exchange information or rest after fighting outside.
Some wounded participants could even be seen recovering peacefully without worrying about being ambushed.
At that moment, the city suddenly felt completely different from the battlefield regions outside.
Outside the city—
The world was filled with slaughter.
Inside the city—
A strange order existed.
Almost like a temporary sanctuary amidst endless chaos.
Max slowly walked through the streets afterward while observing everything around him carefully.
A faint smile gradually appeared across his face.
"Interesting."
This city clearly possessed a purpose beyond merely providing shelter.
Otherwise, the Eternal Hourglass would never create an entire peaceful zone containing hundreds of thousands of participants.
Which meant one thing.
There were likely opportunities hidden within this city as well.
Meanwhile, after walking through the city for some time, Max realized that simply observing the surroundings would not answer all the questions in his mind.

There were simply too many unusual things about this place. The peaceful zone, the enormous crowds, and the countless shops and buildings all made the city feel far too organized to be a random part of the Eternal Hourglass.
Eventually, Max approached a small group of human participants standing near a large plaza. The moment one of the men saw him, he frowned slightly.

For some reason, Max seemed familiar to him. He felt as though he had seen his face somewhere before, yet no matter how much he thought about it, he could not recall where. Nevertheless, he did not dwell on it for long.
Max directly asked, "Can you tell me what exactly this city is?"

The man looked at him with surprise before replying, "You really do not know? This place is one of the neutral cities scattered throughout the Eternal Hourglass. You can think of it as a giant hub for all participants. As long as you possess enough Killing Points, you can buy almost anything here. Resources, cultivation treasures, rare medicines, powerful weapons, information, maps, inheritances, Divine Ability and even opportunities can all be found within this city. Some people have even obtained legendary treasures here before. Of course, whether you can afford them is another matter entirely."
Max’s eyes narrowed slightly as he listened.

The man continued, "This city is not unique either. There are many neutral regions throughout the Eternal Hourglass, although each one is different. Participants eventually visit them because everyone needs resources or information at some point. Fighting is strictly forbidden here because the Eternal Hourglass itself enforces the rules. That is why you see hundreds of thousands of people walking around peacefully despite this being a battle royale."
Max nodded thoughtfully before asking, "What is this city called?"

The man smiled faintly and replied, "This city is called Starfall Haven. It is one of the largest neutral cities in this region of the Eternal Hourglass. Most participants pass through it sooner or later. Looking at you, I would guess you have been spending all your time fighting and hunting Killing Points rather than exploring."
Max chuckled lightly after hearing that.
The man was not wrong.
Ever since entering the Eternal Hourglass, Max had done little besides fight, kill, and search for opportunities.
Now, however, it seemed he had finally discovered a completely different side of the Cosmic Ascension Conference.
After understanding the purpose of Starfall Haven, Max thanked the man and continued exploring the city on his own.

The more he walked through the bustling streets, the more amazed he became by the scale of the place. Everywhere he looked, participants were buying treasures, exchanging information, or searching for opportunities. Some shops sold rare cultivation resources while others specialized in weapons, armor, maps, pills, and inheritances.
Eventually, Max arrived before an enormous pavilion unlike anything he had seen before.
Above the entrance hung a massive golden sign.
Divine Ability Pavilion
The moment Max read those words, his interest was immediately piqued.
Without hesitation, he entered.
Inside, a massive crystal screen floated in the center of the pavilion. Thousands upon thousands of names continuously scrolled across its surface.
Max walked closer and began browsing through them.
Soon, a list of Divine Abilities appeared before him.
[Tier I Divine Ability - Stone Skin]
Effect: Greatly increases physical defense.
Price: 10,000,000 Killing Points.
[Tier I Divine Ability - Swift Wind]
Effect: Increases movement speed.
Price: 12,000,000 Killing Points.
[Tier I Divine Ability - Iron Bones]
Effect: Strengthens skeletal structure and durability.
Price: 15,000,000 Killing Points.
[Tier II Divine Ability - Blood Burning]
Effect: Temporarily doubles combat strength.
Price: 35,000,000 Killing Points.
[Tier II Divine Ability - Thunder Step]
Effect: Allows instantaneous bursts of lightning movement.
Price: 42,000,000 Killing Points.
[Tier III Divine Ability - Void Shatter]
Effect: Creates destructive spatial fractures.
Price: 150,000,000 Killing Points.
[Tier III Divine Ability - Heavenly Flame Wings]
Effect: Condenses wings of divine flames capable of flight and combat.
Price: 180,000,000 Killing Points.
[Tier IV Divine Ability - Starfall Cataclysm]
Effect: Summons falling stars from the heavens.
Price: 750,000,000 Killing Points.
[Tier IV Divine Ability - Eternal Phoenix Body]
Effect: Grants terrifying regenerative abilities.
Price: 920,000,000 Killing Points.
[Tier V Divine Ability - World Devourer]
Effect: Consume all energy within a designated region.
Price: 5,000,000,000 Killing Points.
[Tier V Divine Ability - Heavenly Genesis Hand]
Effect: Create and destroy matter through divine authority.
Price: 8,500,000,000 Killing Points.
[Tier V Divine Ability - Infinite Star Sovereign Physique]
Effect: Transform the body into a vessel of endless stellar power.
Price: 12,000,000,000 Killing Points.
As Max continued scrolling through the endless list, his expression gradually became stranger and stranger.
The Divine Abilities themselves were shocking enough.
However—
The prices were even more absurd.
Ten million Killing Points.
That was merely the entry price for the weakest Tier I Divine Ability.
And the higher-tier abilities quickly climbed into hundreds of millions and even billions of Killing Points.
At that moment, Max suddenly looked at his own Killing Point count.
[Current Killing Points: 110,000]
Silence.
A strange expression immediately appeared on his face.
He had previously thought that one hundred and ten thousand Killing Points was already a considerable amount.
After all, he had slaughtered an entire battlefield, farmed multiple lives from participants, and wiped out dozens of rainbow rabbits just to accumulate that amount.
Yet now—
Looking at the Divine Ability Pavilion’s prices, Max suddenly felt unbelievably poor.
Very poor.
In fact, he was so poor that even the cheapest Divine Ability was nearly one hundred times beyond his reach.
The corner of Max’s mouth twitched slightly.
"I thought I was rich."
He looked once more at the ten-million-Killing-Point price tag of the cheapest Divine Ability.
Then he looked at his own one hundred and ten thousand points.
"I should have known this isn’t much when the requirement to enter the secret trial was 500k KP."
For the first time since entering the Eternal Hourglass, Max genuinely felt as though he possessed almost nothing.

Now that he understood the rules, the scene before him immediately made much more sense.
Participants walked through the streets calmly.
Many entered shops and buildings.
Others gathered together to exchange information or rest after fighting outside.
Some wounded participants could even be seen recovering peacefully without worrying about being ambushed.
At that moment, the city suddenly felt completely different from the battlefield regions outside.
Outside the city—
The world was filled with slaughter.
Inside the city—
A strange order existed.
Almost like a temporary sanctuary amidst endless chaos.
Max slowly walked through the streets afterward while observing everything around him carefully.
A faint smile gradually appeared across his face.
"Interesting."
This city clearly possessed a purpose beyond merely providing shelter.
Otherwise, the Eternal Hourglass would never create an entire peaceful zone containing hundreds of thousands of participants.
Which meant one thing.
There were likely opportunities hidden within this city as well.
Meanwhile, after walking through the city for some time, Max realized that simply observing the surroundings would not answer all the questions in his mind.
There were simply too many unusual things about this place.
The peaceful zone, the enormous crowds, and the countless shops and buildings all made the city feel far too organized to be a random part of the Eternal Hourglass.
Eventually, Max approached a small group of human participants standing near a large plaza.
The moment one of the men saw him, he frowned slightly.
For some reason, Max seemed familiar to him.
He felt as though he had seen his face somewhere before, yet no matter how much he thought about it, he could not recall where.
Nevertheless, he did not dwell on it for long.
Max directly asked, "Can you tell me what exactly this city is?"
The man looked at him with surprise before replying, "You really do not know?
This place is one of the neutral cities scattered throughout the Eternal Hourglass.
You can think of it as a giant hub for all participants.
As long as you possess enough Killing Points, you can buy almost anything here.
Resources, cultivation treasures, rare medicines, powerful weapons, information, maps, inheritances, Divine Ability and even opportunities can all be found within this city.
Some people have even obtained legendary treasures here before.
Of course, whether you can afford them is another matter entirely."
Max’s eyes narrowed slightly as he listened.
The man continued, "This city is not unique either.
There are many neutral regions throughout the Eternal Hourglass, although each one is different.
Participants eventually visit them because everyone needs resources or information at some point.
Fighting is strictly forbidden here because the Eternal Hourglass itself enforces the rules.
That is why you see hundreds of thousands of people walking around peacefully despite this being a battle royale."
Max nodded thoughtfully before asking, "What is this city called?"
The man smiled faintly and replied, "This city is called Starfall Haven.
It is one of the largest neutral cities in this region of the Eternal Hourglass.
Most participants pass through it sooner or later.
Looking at you, I would guess you have been spending all your time fighting and hunting Killing Points rather than exploring."
Max chuckled lightly after hearing that.
The man was not wrong.
Ever since entering the Eternal Hourglass, Max had done little besides fight, kill, and search for opportunities.
Now, however, it seemed he had finally discovered a completely different side of the Cosmic Ascension Conference.
After understanding the purpose of Starfall Haven, Max thanked the man and continued exploring the city on his own.
The more he walked through the bustling streets, the more amazed he became by the scale of the place.
Everywhere he looked, participants were buying treasures, exchanging information, or searching for opportunities.
Some shops sold rare cultivation resources while others specialized in weapons, armor, maps, pills, and inheritances.
Eventually, Max arrived before an enormous pavilion unlike anything he had seen before.
Above the entrance hung a massive golden sign.
Divine Ability Pavilion
The moment Max read those words, his interest was immediately piqued.
Without hesitation, he entered.
Inside, a massive crystal screen floated in the center of the pavilion.
Thousands upon thousands of names continuously scrolled across its surface.
Max walked closer and began browsing through them.
Soon, a list of Divine Abilities appeared before him.
